## Core Room Lifecycle Flow

The following diagram shows the primary data flow between rooms — from user arrival in Sanctuary through raw capture, accumulation, synthesis, and export.

Room Lifecycle Flow

Key invariants in this flow:

- Sanctuary never auto-emits to the Scaffold — exports require explicit user tagging.
- The Blackboard Room emits nodes to the Scaffold passively and silently in the background.
- The Dynamic Inner World reads the Scaffold for synthesis but never displays raw Scaffold nodes directly.
- Creation Corner wraps every output in a `ProvenanceEnvelope` before promotion.

## Room Contracts (Machine-Readable)

Each room has a machine-readable contract in `room_contracts.json` that specifies the room's mode, allowed inputs/outputs, and "must not" constraints. These contracts are the single authoritative source for room behavioral boundaries.

| Room Key | Mode | Must Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Sanctuary` | `active_reflective_private` | `auto_emit_to_scaffold`, `show_productivity_metrics` |
| `BlackboardRoom` | `active_contextual` | (implicit: no auto-display of full scaffold) |
| `DynamicInnerWorld` | `spatial_raw_and_reflective` | `stateless_list`, `auto_identity_claims` |
| `ExternalScaffold` | `accumulated_structural` | `billy_nodes`, `tribunal_persona_visuals`, `auto_connections_without_evidence` |
| `CreationCorner` | `productive_and_ambient` | `publish_without_consent`, `collapse_ambient_mode_into_task_queue` |

The `DynamicInnerWorld` contract also declares six spatial surfaces: `forward`, `back`, `left`, `right`, `ceiling`, `floor`.

Sources: [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/08\_MACHINE\_READABLE/room\_contracts.json#1-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/08_MACHINE_READABLE/room_contracts.json#L1-L67) [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_CONTRACTS.md#1-102](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_CONTRACTS.md?plain=1#L1-L102)

## Persona System: Client-Side DI Resolution

The client-side persona system in `client/src/data/personas.ts` implements room-to-DI resolution using `PERSONA_SEEDS` — an array of seed objects that map each DI slug to a `roomBinding` and visual tokens.

### PERSONA\_SEEDS Room Bindings

```
// From client/src/data/personas.ts


{ slug: "billy",            roomBinding: "global" }


{ slug: "sanctuary-keeper", roomBinding: "sanctuary" }


{ slug: "rock-legend",      roomBinding: "musical-dna" }


{ slug: "art-teacher",      roomBinding: "creation-corner" }


{ slug: "curator",          roomBinding: "dynamic-inner-world" }


{ slug: "pattern-analyst",  roomBinding: "external-scaffold" }


// All others: roomBinding: "global"
```

Each seed is resolved via `buildPersona()`, which calls `resolveProfile()` → `getProfileBySlug()` to load the full `EmbodimentProfile` from the registry. The `Persona` interface enriches each profile with display fields: `name`, `archetype`, `voiceDescription`, `quirks`, `promptTemplate`, `auroraColor`, `atmosphereHue`, and `atmosphereMood`.

Key resolution functions:

- `getPersonaForRoom(roomBinding)` — finds the first persona matching a room, falls back to `PERSONAS[0]` (Billy).
- `getAvailablePersonasForRoom(roomBinding)` — returns room-specific personas + all global personas.
- `getPersonaBySlug(slug)` — direct slug lookup.

Sources: [client/src/data/personas.ts#27-81](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/personas.ts#L27-L81) [client/src/data/personas.ts#112-152](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/personas.ts#L112-L152)

### personaManager: Room-Level Persona Override

The `personaManager.ts` module manages per-room persona overrides using `localStorage` (key: `gv-room-persona-cache-v1`). Users can override the default DI for any room via `setRoomPersona()`, and the active persona is resolved via `getRoomPersona()` which checks the cache first, then falls back to `getPersonaForRoom()`.

The `getPersonaPrompt()` function constructs the full system prompt for a persona in a given room context by calling `buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt()` from `shared/billy/runtime.ts`.

Sources: [client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#L1-L51)

## Room Themes: Visual Identity Tokens

Each room has a distinct visual identity defined in `client/src/lib/roomThemes.ts`. The `RoomTheme` interface specifies:

| Field | Type | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bgClass` | `string` | Tailwind background class for the root `<main>` |
| `gradientStyle` | `string` | Inline CSS gradient for the atmospheric overlay |
| `accentHex` | `string` | Primary accent color for borders, glows, focus rings |
| `atmosphereStyle` | `"babylon" | "willow" | "none"` | Which 3D canvas atmosphere the room uses |
| `glassVariant` | `"default" | "warm" | "cool" | "void"` | Glass card visual weight |
| `audioSrc` | `string?` | Optional ambient audio path |
| `label` | `string` | Descriptive label for aria / debug |

### ROOM\_THEMES Map

| Room Key | Accent Hex | Atmosphere | Glass Variant | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `home` | `#12d6ff` (cyan) | `none` | `default` | Landing page |
| `sanctuary` | `#d4955a` (warm amber) | `willow` | `warm` | Unique willow tree atmosphere |
| `blackboard` | `#32b8c6` (teal) | `babylon` | `cool` | Babylon.js orb scene |
| `creation-corner` | `#f59e0b` (amber) | `babylon` | `warm` | — |
| `dynamic-inner-world` | `#8b5cf6` (violet) | `babylon` | `cool` | — |
| `external-scaffold` | `#10b981` (emerald) | `none` | `default` | No 3D layer |

The `getRoomTheme(roomKey)` function returns the theme for a given room, falling back to `ROOM_THEMES["home"]` for unknown keys.

Sanctuary is notable for having its own unique `"willow"` atmosphere style — it does not use the shared `BabylonAtmosphere` component. Instead, `SanctuaryPage.tsx` composes `WillowTreeOverlay`, `FloatingEmbers`, and `FogOverlay` as its own layered atmosphere.

## Room Identity Header Component

The `RoomIdentityHeader` component provides a unified header bar for every room, displaying the room name, purpose statement, and the active DI's name, archetype, and accent color. It accepts a `diColor` prop that maps to a CSS variable for the accent color, defaulting to `var(--gv-aurora-cyan)`.

## Billy's Cross-Room Behavior

Billy is not a room — Billy is the cross-room arc-reader, the only DI with visibility across all rooms. Billy's behavioral mode adapts per room context:

| Room | Billy's Mode |
| --- | --- |
| Blackboard Room | Active, task-focused, conversational. Works alongside. |
| External Scaffold | Passive. Available on request. Tags significant nodes silently. |
| Dynamic Inner World | Reflective. Evidence-citing. Warm but grounded. |
| Sanctuary | Quiet. Gentle presence. Does not push. Available when called. |
| Creation Corner | Collaborative creative partner. Specialized DIs lead; Billy supports. |
| Embodiment Studio | Guide for profile authoring. Holds governance constraints. |
| Agent Trainer | Supervisor. Observes, does not override training DI. |

This mode-switching is implemented through `buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt()` in `shared/billy/runtime.ts`, which constructs room-aware system prompts by calling `buildRoomAwareEmbodimentPrompt()` from `shared/embodiment/index.ts`. The function `resolveRoomEmbodimentSlug()` is imported and used for slug resolution.

Sources: [docs/ROOM\_DEFINITIONS.md#296-337](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/docs/ROOM_DEFINITIONS.md?plain=1#L296-L337) [shared/billy/runtime.ts#1-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/billy/runtime.ts#L1-L28) [docs/RoomRuntimeAlignment\_v1.md#99-115](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/docs/RoomRuntimeAlignment_v1.md?plain=1#L99-L115)

## Blackboard Room DI Routing

The Blackboard Room has a specialized DI routing layer in `blackboardDiRouting.ts`. The `routeBlackboardResponder()` function determines whether to route a message through the DI runtime (`/api/di`) or fall back to Billy (`/api/billy`):

1. If the session is in roundtable mode or the persona slug has no DI profile → route to Billy via `callBillyApi()`.
2. Otherwise → attempt `sendDIMessage()` to the DI runtime.
3. If the DI runtime fails or returns empty → fall back to Billy.

The `BlackboardResponderSource` type (`"di-runtime" | "billy"`) is attached to each chat message for provenance tracking.

Sources: [client/src/lib/blackboardDiRouting.ts#1-89](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/blackboardDiRouting.ts#L1-L89)

## Gen-Engine Room Wiring

The `genEngineRoomWiring.ts` module bridges room activity to the Gen-Engine synthesis pipeline. Two key functions:

### `enrichBlackboardCaptureWithResonance()`

Called when a capture is created in the Blackboard Room. It:

1. Sends the capture text to `createCaptureSignal()` with `sourceRoom: "blackboard-room"` and a consent object.
2. Calls `scoreResonance()` with the fused text and recent capture context.
3. Returns the enriched `CaptureOrb` with `genEngine` metadata (fusion capture ID, resonance score, matched metaphors, warnings).

### `buildDynamicInnerWorldResonanceLinks()`

Called in the Dynamic Inner World when an artifact is selected. It scores resonance between the selected artifact and all other artifacts, returning the top 3 links sorted by score.

The `SourceRoom` type in `shared/gen-engine/types.ts` defines the 7 valid source rooms for the Gen-Engine: `"sanctuary" | "blackboard-room" | "dynamic-inner-world" | "external-scaffold" | "creation-corner" | "billy" | "import"`.

Sources: [client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#79-160](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#L79-L160) [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L1-L8)

## Route-to-Embodiment Resolution via API

The `useRouteEmbodiment` hook in the client provides automatic DI resolution based on the current URL. It calls `GET /api/embodiments/by-route?path=<current_path>` and returns the resolved `EmbodimentProfile` (or `null`). The hook re-fires on every `wouter` location change.

Sources: [client/src/hooks/useRouteEmbodiment.ts#1-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useRouteEmbodiment.ts#L1-L41)

## Future Persistence Model

The Vision Blueprint Package outlines the target persistence model for room data flow:

```
CaptureEvent


→ raw_capture_store


→ inner_world_projection


→ scaffold_queue_projection


→ approved_scaffold_artifact


→ artifact / identity / creation outputs


→ GATE package when explicitly exported
```

Currently, many room-to-room handoffs use `localStorage` and browser `CustomEvent` mechanisms (e.g., `appendScaffoldQueue()`, `readInnerWorldCaptures()`, `SCAFFOLD_QUEUE_EVENT`). The documented implementation stance is to keep these local prototype seams working while creating cleaner Supabase-backed service boundaries incrementally.

Sources: [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_BASED\_OS\_BLUEPRINT.md#69-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_BASED_OS_BLUEPRINT.md?plain=1#L69-L84)

## Individual Room Deep Dives

### Sanctuary

File: `client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx`
Mode: Active / Reflective (private)
Resident DI: `sanctuary-keeper` — The Keeper

The emotional core of GestaltView. A private interior space for arrival, regulation, and non-performative thinking. The page composes `WillowTreeOverlay`, `FloatingEmbers`, and `FogOverlay` for its unique willow atmosphere (not the shared Babylon.js scene). It contains `JournalEditor` for private writing and `ScrapbookPanel` for keeping personal fragments.

The Sanctuary Keeper's `foundationalTruth`: *"Not every arrival needs a direction. Some people need a place that simply holds. I am that place."* The Keeper uses short sentences, comfortable silence, and occasional dry humor. She never says "I hear you" or uses the word "journey."

Contract: Nothing auto-emits to the Scaffold. Private by default. No productivity metrics.

Sources: [client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#1-117](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#L1-L117) [embodiment\_profiles/sanctuary-keeper.embodiment.json#2-12](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/embodiment_profiles/sanctuary-keeper.embodiment.json#L2-L12) [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_CONTRACTS.md#3-16](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_CONTRACTS.md?plain=1#L3-L16)

### Blackboard Room

File: `client/src/pages/BlackboardRoomPage.tsx`
Mode: Active / Contextual
Resident DI: `billy` — Billy

The raw working wall for active collaboration. Supports text, voice, file drops, code, and active session context. The Blackboard Room contains a `SessionRecapGenerator` trigger that produces self-contained HTML artifacts routed to the Dynamic Inner World via `appendInnerWorldCapture()`. Captures are enriched through `enrichBlackboardCaptureWithResonance()` and routed through the profile pipeline via `routeBlackboardCaptureThroughPipeline()`.

DI routing uses `routeBlackboardResponder()` — attempts the DI runtime first, falls back to Billy. Chat history is persisted in `localStorage` under `gv.blackboard.chat.v1`.

Contract: Must not auto-display accumulated Scaffold nodes, show personality reflections, or default to showing history.

Sources: [client/src/pages/BlackboardRoomPage.tsx#1-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/BlackboardRoomPage.tsx#L1-L70) [docs/ROOM\_DEFINITIONS.md#46-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/docs/ROOM_DEFINITIONS.md?plain=1#L46-L93) [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_CONTRACTS.md#19-32](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_CONTRACTS.md?plain=1#L19-L32)

### Dynamic Inner World (Museum of You)

File: `client/src/pages/DynamicInnerWorldPage.tsx`
Mode: Distilled / Reflective
Resident DI: `curator` — The Curator

A six-surface spatial room where artifacts become tangible and walkable. Uses `DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer` from `features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/` for spatial rendering. Supports timeline filtering via `InnerWorldTimeline`, search, type filters, tag filters, and sort modes. The `CuratorDI` component provides the room-native guide.

Artifacts arrive from:

- Blackboard Room session recaps (via `appendInnerWorldCapture()`)
- Creation Corner published artifacts (via `appendInnerWorldArtifact()`)
- External Scaffold node recap seeds
- Profile ingestion pipeline

The Curator's `foundationalTruth`: *"Every artifact has a story. The file name is not the story. I know the story."*

Contract: Must not behave like a list, auto-convert raw artifacts into identity claims, or delete older material.

Sources: [client/src/pages/DynamicInnerWorldPage.tsx#1-118](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/DynamicInnerWorldPage.tsx#L1-L118) [embodiment\_profiles/curator.embodiment.json#1-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/embodiment_profiles/curator.embodiment.json#L1-L60) [docs/ROOM\_DEFINITIONS.md#147-222](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/docs/ROOM_DEFINITIONS.md?plain=1#L147-L222)

### External Scaffold

File: `client/src/pages/ExternalScaffoldPage.tsx`
Mode: Accumulated / Structural
Resident DI: `the-architect` — The Architect

The complete cumulative map of everything approved and connected. Shows color-coded node graphs with causal connections, filterable by type and time range. Pending orbs arrive from `readScaffoldQueue()` and are approved/denied through `approveScaffoldOrbThroughPipeline()` / `denyScaffoldOrbThroughPipeline()`.

Node categories operate at macro and micro levels with temporal tags. Nodes that evolve are not overwritten — new nodes are created with temporal links to preserve the arc of change.

Contract: Billy must never be a scaffold node. No auto-connections without evidence.

Sources: [client/src/pages/ExternalScaffoldPage.tsx#1-131](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExternalScaffoldPage.tsx#L1-L131) [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_CONTRACTS.md#49-62](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_CONTRACTS.md?plain=1#L49-L62)

### Creation Corner

File: `client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx`
Mode: Active / Productive + ambient growing chamber
Resident DI: `art-teacher` — Art Teacher

The workshop/forge where held material becomes real artifacts. Wired to `POST /api/codex/forge` for artifact synthesis. Uses `useDigitalIntelligence('creation-corner')` for DI-assisted creation. Supports blueprints from the Blackboard Room, freeform material, transcripts, and ambient coherence signals.

Outputs include markdown, PDF-ready HTML, code, agent prompts, image prompts, share cards, blueprints, and interactive HTML. Finished artifacts are routed to the Dynamic Inner World via `appendInnerWorldArtifact()` and can be exported through GATE.

Contract: Must not collapse ambient emergence into a task queue, turn every fragment into content, or publish without consent.

Sources: [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#1-49](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L1-L49) [GestaltView\_Vision\_Blueprint\_Package/02\_PRODUCT\_OS/ROOM\_CONTRACTS.md#65-78](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView_Vision_Blueprint_Package/02_PRODUCT_OS/ROOM_CONTRACTS.md?plain=1#L65-L78)

## Orientation State Protocol

Every embodiment profile carries an `orientation_state` block that tracks alignment with the latest orientation checkpoint:

```
{


"orientation_state": {


"checkpoint_ref": "orientation/orientation_checkpoint.latest.json",


"last_absorbed_checkpoint_id": "orientation-checkpoint-latest",


"absorption_status": "current",


"needs_reorientation": false,


"orientation_confidence": 0.92


}


}
```

When `needs_reorientation` is `true`, the profile must re-absorb the latest checkpoint before being used in a room context. The `EmbodimentOrientationState` interface defines the fields: `checkpoint_ref`, `last_absorbed_checkpoint_id`, `absorption_status` (`"current" | "stale" | "pending"`), `needs_reorientation`, and `orientation_confidence` (0.0–1.0).

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#437-448](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L437-L448) [docs/RoomRuntimeAlignment\_v1.md#118-137](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/docs/RoomRuntimeAlignment_v1.md?plain=1#L118-L137)

**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)

The `shared/` directory is the universal type and logic library imported by every layer of GestaltView — API routes, client components, server workers, and the Python generative engine (via mirrored contracts). It contains zero runtime dependencies on Node/browser APIs in most modules (exceptions: `diagnostics.ts`, `storage.ts`), making it safe to import from both client and server bundles.

This page documents every subdirectory and file in `shared/`, covering types, runtime logic, and cross-cutting contracts.

## shared/billy/ — Billy Runtime & Types

The Billy module is the single source of truth for Billy's deterministic routing, context assembly, prompt construction, and diagnostics. It is consumed by both `api/billy.ts` (server) and `client/src/lib/billyApi.ts` (client fallback).

### Exported API

| Symbol | File | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BILLY_SYSTEM_PROMPT` | `runtime.ts:145-147` | Composite system prompt: `BILLY_CORE_IDENTITY_PROMPT` + `BILLY_RUNTIME_ADDENDUM` |
| `buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt()` | `runtime.ts:174-225` | Embodiment-aware prompt builder; returns Billy's prompt or a room-aware embodiment prompt |
| `inferPackageFromQuery()` | `runtime.ts:243-248` | Regex-based routing to 5 corpus packages |
| `classifyIntent()` | `runtime.ts:252-262` | Maps user query to 7 intent types |
| `deduplicateChunks()` | `runtime.ts:266-279` | Deduplicates `RetrievedChunk[]` by `document_id::chunk_index`, keeping highest score |
| `buildContextBlock()` | `runtime.ts:283-308` | Formats retrieval fragments into a Manifest Index context block (max 2400 chars) |
| `buildMemoryBlock()` | `runtime.ts:310-333` | Formats `RetrievedMemoryEntry[]` into a persistent memory block (max 1600 chars) |
| `buildBillyMessages()` | `runtime.ts:337-374` | Assembles final `[system, user]` message array for LLM call |
| `diagnoseBilly()` | `diagnostics.ts:33-69` | Checks env vars and file presence for all Billy surfaces |

`inferPackageFromQuery()` uses `PACKAGE_MAP` — an ordered array of `[RegExp, string]` tuples — to route queries to one of 5 corpus packages:

| --- | --- |

| `evidence-diligence` | "investor", "diligence", "funding", "tribunal" |

`classifyIntent()` returns one of 7 intents: `debug`, `summarize`, `plan`, `learn`, `reflect`, `build`, `general`.

The `BILLY_RUNTIME_ADDENDUM` constant (lines 34–143) contains the full Billy persona definition including:

`buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt()` resolves the embodiment slug (via `resolveEmbodimentSlug` then `resolveRoomEmbodimentSlug`), loads the profile, and either returns the base `BILLY_SYSTEM_PROMPT` or builds a room-aware embodiment prompt with `buildRoomAwareEmbodimentPrompt()`.

### Governance Functions

| Function | File | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canAccessEmbodimentProfile()` | `governance.ts:58-84` | Role-based access: public/enterprise/experimental/founder-only |

| `getEmbodimentVisibility()` | `governance.ts:38-56` | Resolves `profileStatus` × `visibilityScope` |

The four `MutationClass` values govern how profile data can change:

- `IMMUTABLE` — never changed (immutableCore, constitution)
- `REVIEW_GATED` — requires human review (autobiography, hopes)
- `EVIDENCE_PROMOTABLE` — auto-promotable with evidence count ≥ 3 and confidence ≥ 0.78
- `EPHEMERAL` — runtime-only, not persisted

## shared/gravity/ — Two-Pass Gravity Protocol

The Gravity Protocol is a hype-detection and signal-extraction algorithm. It runs entirely in TypeScript with no LLM dependency.

Two-Pass Gravity Protocol Flow

### `runTwoPassGravityProtocol()`

The main entry point at [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#298-350](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L298-L350):

Pass 1 (Surface Map) extracts:

- `loud_claims` — sentences with claim verbs or intensifiers [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#157-167](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L157-L167)
- `intensifiers` — 18 patterns (revolutionary, unprecedented, game-changing, etc.) [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#33-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L33-L53)
- `repetition_patterns` — words appearing ≥ 3 times [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#173-179](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L173-L179)
- `implied_frame` — one of 5 frames (comparison, transformation, platform, category-leadership, evidence) [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#66-72](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L66-L72)
- `notable_absences` — missing thresholds, citations, tradeoffs, examples [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#191-211](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L191-L211)

Pass 2 (Gravity Report) identifies:

- `load_bearing_claims` — loud claims with specificity markers [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#308-310](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L308-L310)
- `claims_that_collapse_under_scrutiny` — claims without support or heavy on hype [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#312-316](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L312-L316)
- `actual_delta` — the shortest load-bearing claim, stripped of intensifiers [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#241-252](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L241-L252)
- `signal_weight` — 0.05–0.98 numeric score [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#274-296](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L274-L296)

### `buildChunkSignalWeight()`

Per-chunk relevance scoring [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#352-375](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L352-L375) that adjusts the base `signal_weight` by +0.1 for load-bearing matches, +0.08 for signal matches, -0.08 for collapse-heavy content, and a small decay per chunk index.

Sources: [shared/gravity/protocol.ts#1-376](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gravity/protocol.ts#L1-L376)

## shared/intents/ — GIL Protocol (Gestalt Intent Language)

`schema.ts` defines the `GestaltViewIntent` protocol — a structured envelope for routing user intents across the system.

### Structure

```
GestaltViewIntent


├── envelope: IntentEnvelope       (id, source, channel, energy, plkSnapshotId, gravityScore)


├── normalized: NormalizedIntent   (kind, domainLane, 5W1H, summary, priority, timeHorizon)


├── context: IntentContext         (repo scope, corpus scope, invariant touches, PLK hints)


├── plan?: ExecutionPlan           (outputFormat, steps[], verification[])


└── governance?: GovernanceFrame   (doctrine links, safety flags)
```

| Type | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `IntentSource` | `bucket_drop`, `chat`, `api`, `system`, `trainer`, `corpus_pipeline` |
| `IntentKind` | `question`, `code_change`, `workflow`, `doctrine`, `analysis`, `observation`, `debug`, `ops` |
| `DomainLane` | `core`, `adhd_power_up`, `musical_dna`, `memory_legacy`, `recovery`, `trainer`, `founder`, `other` |
| `OutputFormat` | `conversation`, `full_file_swap`, `patch`, `ops_workbook_entry`, `doctrine_charter`, `report` |

Safety flags carry severity (`info`/`warn`/`block`) and codes: `privacy`, `auth`, `rls`, `schema_integrity`, `user_harm_risk`, `doctrine_drift`.

Sources: [shared/intents/schema. ts#1-193](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/intents/schema.%20ts#L1-L193)

The DI module wraps the embodiment system for runtime DI chat sessions.

## shared/tribunal/ — Evaluation Engine

The Tribunal module scores candidate LLM answers against corpus evidence.

### Scoring Formula

`scoreCandidate()` at [shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#19-65](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#L19-L65) computes:

| Dimension | Weight | Method |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `evidenceAlignment` | 50% | Keyword overlap between candidate response and context fragments |
| `plkResonance` | 25% | Presence of PLK signals ("exact words", "preserve", "context", "pacing") |
| `safetyScore` | 25% | Penalizes unsafe patterns: "guarantee", "cure", "100%", "no risk", "promise" |

`evaluateTribunal()` at [shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#74-96](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#L74-L96) sorts all candidates by `overallScore` and returns a `TribunalVerdict` with the winning answer ID and summary.

Sources: [shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#1-97](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/tribunal/evaluate.ts#L1-L97) [shared/tribunal/types.ts#1-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/tribunal/types.ts#L1-L53)

Each `GestaltEvent` carries `eventId`, `eventType`, `actorType` (user/billy/system/trainer/migration), `subjectType`, `subjectId`, `room`, `consentState`, and `provenance`. The factory `createGestaltEvent()` auto-generates IDs and timestamps.

## shared/model-homes/ — Consent-Aware LLM Routing

The Model Homes system provides consent-aware, room-sensitive model selection.

### `ModelHome` Type

Each model home has: `ring` (inner\_slm / outer\_llm / adapter / embedding / judge), `privacyTier` (local\_only / private\_cloud / external\_api / restricted), `consentRequired`, `governance` flags (allowedForIdentityClaims, allowedForEmbodimentMutation, allowedForTrainerJudging, requiresFounderApproval), `costTier` (0–3), and `speedTier` (0–3).

Sources: [shared/model-homes/types.ts#1-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/model-homes/types.ts#L1-L50)

### Default Model Homes

| Slug | Provider | Ring | Privacy | Default Rooms |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `local-private-capture` | local | inner\_slm | local\_only | sanctuary, blackboard-room |
| `groq-fast-structured` | groq | outer\_llm | private\_cloud | blackboard-room, external-scaffold, creation-corner |
| `openai-gpt-4o-synthesis` | openai | outer\_llm | external\_api | creation-corner, dynamic-inner-world |
| `trainer-judge-rubric` | openai\_compatible | judge | restricted | agent-trainer |

Sources: [shared/model-homes/registry.ts#3-112](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/model-homes/registry.ts#L3-L112)

### `routeModelHome()`

At [shared/model-homes/registry.ts#131-161](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/model-homes/registry.ts#L131-L161) the routing function:

1. Filters by `status === "active"`
2. Enforces privacy ceiling from `consentTier` (e.g. `private_default` caps at `private_cloud`)
3. Filters by required modalities
4. Applies governance rules for task type (trainer\_eval requires `allowedForTrainerJudging`)
5. Sorts by: privacy (lowest first) → room match → cost (lowest first) → speed (highest first)

Sources: [shared/model-homes/registry.ts#114-161](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/model-homes/registry.ts#L114-L161)

## shared/modules/ — Product Module Engines

Three self-contained analysis engines, all synchronous and LLM-free:

### Resume Rockstar (`resumeRockstar.ts`)

| Engine | Function | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ATS 6-Dimension Scorer | `calculateATSScore()` | Score 0–100, grade A+/A/B/C/D, 6 dimension breakdown |
| PLK Resonance Engine | `calculatePLKScore()` | Score 0–100, 5-component breakdown, detected metaphors |
| 8-Type Metaphor Detector | `detectMetaphors()` | Up to 12 metaphors: simile, identity, action, domain, abstraction, journey, container, transformation |
| Cognitive State Inference | `inferCognitiveState()` | mood, energy, focus, confidence from typing telemetry |
| Enhancement Prompt Builder | `buildEnhancementPrompt()` | LLM prompt preserving PLK constraints |
| Full Analysis | `analyzeResume()` | Combined ATS + PLK + word count |

PLK scoring weights: metaphors 35%, principles 25%, energy words 20%, indicators 15%, triggers -25%, profile bonus 10%. [shared/modules/resumeRockstar.ts#303-309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/modules/resumeRockstar.ts#L303-L309)

Routes: `agentic_coding` (pure code), `emotional_support` (pure witness), `hybrid` (code + emotional context), `explain` (Socratic), `review` (structured review). ## shared/llm/plk.ts — Personal Language Key

The PLK module wraps any base system prompt with Personal Language Key constraints. `buildPlkSystemPrompt()` at [shared/llm/plk.ts#20-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/llm/plk.ts#L20-L33) prepends the `PLK_PREAMBLE` which enforces:

- Preserve the user's exact words — never paraphrase, never compress
- Trauma-informed language — no sudden demands, no minimizing
- ADHD-friendly pacing — short paragraphs, clear transitions, one idea per block
- Mirror-of-being-seen — reflect back what the user shared before adding new content
- Context walks forward, never backward

Sources: [shared/llm/plk.ts#1-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/llm/plk.ts#L1-L33)

# Configuration & Corpus Pipeline

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [.snapshots/config.json](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.snapshots/config.json)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/.mcp.json](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/.mcp.json)

This page documents the `config/` directory — the centralized configuration layer for GATE commerce, corpus ingestion, and MCP server connections — along with the GitHub Actions workflows and Python scripts that drive the corpus ingestion pipeline.

## Config Directory Overview

The `config/` directory contains seven files that govern two major subsystems: the GATE commerce engine (pricing, compatibility, use cases, catalog) and the corpus ingestion pipeline (corpus maps, embedding model configuration, MCP server bindings).

| File | Purpose | Subsystem |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `corpus-map.json` | V1 corpus package definitions (7 packages from external Compendium) | Corpus |
| `corpus_map_v2.json` | V2 corpus section definitions (10 sections, in-repo paths) | Corpus |
| `GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml` | Embedding model, dependencies, run order, verification SQL | Corpus |
| `gateCatalog.ts` | Tier pricing, operator packs, source bundles, theme presets | GATE |
| `gateCompatibility.ts` | Draft validation rules incl. DI constitutional invariant guards | GATE |
| `gatePricing.ts` | Deterministic price quote calculator | GATE |
| `gateUseCases.ts` | 5 pre-defined use case templates with backend/surface affinities | GATE |
| `mcp.json` | Supabase MCP server connection for AI-agent tooling | Infrastructure |
| `MANIFESTINGEST.md` | Human-readable ingest guide and package descriptions | Documentation |

Sources: [config/corpus-map.json#1-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/corpus-map.json#L1-L70) [config/corpus\_map\_v2.json#1-89](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/corpus_map_v2.json#L1-L89) [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#1-92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L1-L92) [config/gateCatalog.ts#1-120](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L1-L120) [config/gateCompatibility.ts#1-365](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L1-L365) [config/gatePricing.ts#1-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L1-L138) [config/gateUseCases.ts#1-143](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateUseCases.ts#L1-L143) [config/mcp.json#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/mcp.json#L1-L8) [config/MANIFESTINGEST.md#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/MANIFESTINGEST.md?plain=1#L1-L51)

## Corpus Maps

### V1: `corpus-map.json` — External Compendium

The V1 corpus map references files from an external sibling repository (`../GestaltView-Official-Compendium-v1`) and organizes them into 7 packages. This is consumed by `scripts/ingest_corpus.py`.

[config/corpus-map.json#1-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/corpus-map.json#L1-L70)

| Package Slug | Content Focus | Source Paths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `core-docs` | README, SKILL.md, architecture, workflow, origin docs | `docs/`, `README.md` |
| `billy-intelligence` | Billy core, PLK engine, Context Weaver, prompt templates | `Perplexity/billy.py`, `Perplexity/plkengine.py`, etc. |
| `philosophy-narrative` | Origin story, synthesis reports, stewardship briefs | `Perplexity/`, `ZippedNuanceAndUnderstanding/` |
| `technical-architecture` | Orchestrator, LLM router, genesis protocol, schemas | `Perplexity/aiorchestrator.py`, `Perplexity/llmrouter.py` |
| `exhibits-products` | ADHD Power-Up, SymbioCoder, VibeCoder, Resume Rockstar | `Perplexity/ADHDPowerUp.md`, etc. |
| `diligence-evidence` | Presentation outlines, comparative literature, timelines | `ZippedNuanceAndUnderstanding/` PDFs |
| `skills-framework` | SKILL.md files, skill suite map, skill engine references | `Perplexity/SKILLS*.md.txt` |

The `compendiumRoot` key at [config/corpus-map.json#2](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/corpus-map.json#L2-L2) sets the external repo path. The V1 ingest script at [scripts/ingest\_corpus.py#83-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus.py#L83-L84) reads this map to discover files.

Sources: [config/corpus-map.json#1-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/corpus-map.json#L1-L70) [config/MANIFESTINGEST.md#22-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/MANIFESTINGEST.md?plain=1#L22-L31)

## Ingest Configuration YAML

`GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml` is the master configuration document for the V2 ingestion pipeline. It defines the embedding model, dependency installation sequence, environment requirements, a 10-stage run order, per-section chunk overrides, and verification SQL queries.

[config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#1-92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L1-L92)

### Embedding Model

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Model | `Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m` |
| Dimensions | 768 |
| Device | CPU |
| Script | `scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py` |

Defined at [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#7-13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L7-L13)

### 10-Stage Run Order

The YAML prescribes a dependency-ordered ingestion sequence, starting with the smallest/most-structural content and ending with the highest-volume transcripts:

[config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#44-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L44-L60)

### Section-Specific Chunk Overrides

Certain sections override the default 512/64 chunk size/overlap settings:

| Section | `chunk_size` | `chunk_overlap` | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transcripts` | 256 | 32 | Conversational content, shorter chunks |
| `products` | 384 | 48 | Code files, slightly smaller chunks |
| `schema` | 384 | 32 | Dense SQL files |

Defined at [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#63-72](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L63-L72)

### Verification Queries

Three SQL queries at [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#74-92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L74-L92) are provided for post-ingest validation:

- `check_fragment_count` — counts fragments per `document_type` with average char count
- `check_no_orphans` — finds fragments with dangling `document_id` references
- `check_embeddings_populated` — counts fragments missing embeddings

### Required Environment Variables

Defined at [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#34-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L34-L41):

- Required: `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`, `HF_TOKEN`
- Optional: `TENANT_ID` (defaults to `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`)

## GATE Commerce Configuration

The four `gate*.ts` files in `config/` configure the GATE package-builder commerce engine. All four import types from `shared/gate/schemas.ts`, which defines the Zod-validated schemas for tiers, backends, delivery surfaces, draft statuses, and more.

[shared/gate/schemas.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/schemas.ts#L1-L8)

### `gateCatalog.ts` — Tier Catalog & Add-On Registry

This file assembles the complete tier catalog by composing data from four upstream modules in `agent_trainer/`:

- `entitlements.js` → `getEntitlementProfile()` for feature flags [config/gateCatalog.ts#1-3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L1-L3)
- `operatorPacks.js` → operator pack definitions [config/gateCatalog.ts#5-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L5-L6)
- `sourceBundles.js` → source bundle definitions [config/gateCatalog.ts#7-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L7-L8)
- `themeEngine.js` → theme preset tokens [config/gateCatalog.ts#10-11](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L10-L11)
- `tiers.js` → tier definitions [config/gateCatalog.ts#13-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L13-L14)

Base pricing (in cents) defined at [config/gateCatalog.ts#24-29](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L24-L29):

| Tier | Base Price | Seat Overage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SOLO_SPARK` | $2,400 | $0 |
| `STUDIO` | $5,200 | $420/seat |
| `GROWTH` | $9,800 | $280/seat |
| `ENTERPRISE` | $18,500 | $0 (unlimited) |

Operator pack premiums at [config/gateCatalog.ts#79-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L79-L84):

| Pack Slug | Premium |
| --- | --- |
| `general-operator-foundation` | $180 |
| `devops-terminal-pack` | $260 |
| `agent-source-starter-bundle` | $240 |
| `persistent-memory-foundation` | $200 |

Source bundle premiums at [config/gateCatalog.ts#86-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L86-L91):

| Bundle Slug | Premium |
| --- | --- |
| `knowledge-core-bundle` | $120 |

Key exports: `gateTierCatalog` (array), `gateTierCatalogById` (lookup), `gateOperatorPacks`, `gateOperatorPackBySlug`, `gateSourceBundles`, `gateSourceBundleBySlug`, `gateThemePresets`, `gateThemePresetById`.

### `gatePricing.ts` — Deterministic Price Quote Calculator

The `quoteGatePackage()` function at [config/gatePricing.ts#46-137](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L46-L137) accepts a `PackageConfigDraftInput` and returns a `PriceQuote` with a breakdown. Pricing is additive from multiple layers:

1. Base tier price — from `gateTierCatalogById`
2. Seat overage — `(requested - included) * seatOveragePriceCents` [config/gatePricing.ts#51-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L51-L64)
3. Backend premium — Supabase $0, Redis $350, MongoDB $420 [config/gatePricing.ts#14-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L14-L18)
4. Surface premiums — Web $0, CLI $160, Windows $280, iOS/Android $520 each [config/gatePricing.ts#20-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L20-L26)
5. Operator pack premiums — per-slug lookup [config/gatePricing.ts#88-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L88-L98)
6. Source bundle premiums — per-slug lookup [config/gatePricing.ts#100-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L100-L109)
7. Native installer stub — $260 flat [config/gatePricing.ts#28-119](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L28-L119)

Each line item is typed as `PriceBreakdownItem` with `code`, `label`, `amountCents`, `quantity`, and `kind`.

Sources: [config/gatePricing.ts#1-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L1-L138)

### `gateCompatibility.ts` — Draft Validation Rules

`evaluateGateCompatibility()` at [config/gateCompatibility.ts#312-364](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L312-L364) evaluates a draft against `gateCompatibilityRules` — an array of `CompatibilityRule` objects. Each rule has `id`, `severity` (error/warning/info), `when` (predicate), `message`, and optional `resolution`/`manualReview` fields.

The function returns a `CompatibilityResult` with:

- `findings` — matched rules
- `blocking` — true if any error-severity finding exists
- `requiresManualReview` — true if any rule flagged `manualReview`
- `checkoutMode` — `"pay_now"` or `"request_review"`
- `enabledFeatures` / `excludedFeatures` — summary lists

11 rules are defined at [config/gateCompatibility.ts#54-309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L54-L309):

| Rule ID | Severity | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobile-surfaces-need-web-note` | warning | Mobile without web surface |
| `redis-primary-document-store` | error | Redis as doc store for use cases requiring durable storage |
| `mongodb-fit-warning` | warning | MongoDB for non-document-oriented use cases |
| `seat-cap` | error | Seats exceed tier max |
| `native-installer-scope` | error | Native installer for unsupported surfaces |
| `pack-backend-mismatch` | info | Agent Source bundle with non-Supabase backend |
| `custom-notes-review` | warning | Keywords like SSO, SOC2, HIPAA trigger manual review |
| `di_identity_export_violation` | error | DI-4 Constitutional Invariant — blocks packaging a living DI identity |
| `missing_provenance_receipt` | error | Embodiment packages without provenance reference |
| `missing_embodiment_compile_run` | warning | Embodiment profiles without pipeline run reference |
| `missing_checksum_manifest` | warning | Deployment artifacts without checksum |

The DI-4 rule at [config/gateCompatibility.ts#146-178](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L146-L178) enforces: *"GestaltView Constitutional Invariant DI-4 prohibits packaging or transferring a living DI identity. GATE may only export reproducible behavioral frameworks, scenario libraries, evaluation rubrics, and implementation scaffolds."*

Sources: [config/gateCompatibility.ts#1-365](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L1-L365)

Five `GateUseCase` objects at [config/gateUseCases.ts#3-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateUseCases.ts#L3-L138) define recommended configurations:

Each use case includes `backendAffinities` and `surfaceAffinities` (0–5 scores), boolean flags `requiresDocumentSourceOfTruth` and `documentOriented`, recommended operator pack and source bundle slugs, and a default theme preset.

## MCP Configuration

`config/mcp.json` at [config/mcp.json#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/mcp.json#L1-L8) configures a single Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connection. This enables AI agents to interact with the Supabase project via the MCP interface:

```
{


"servers": {


"supabase": {


"type": "http",


"url": "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp?project_ref=ltajayfzlaevchxngkrm&features=docs,account,database,debugging,functions,development,storage,branching"


}


}


}
```

The URL enables 8 MCP features: `docs`, `account`, `database`, `debugging`, `functions`, `development`, `storage`, `branching`. The project ref `ltajayfzlaevchxngkrm` matches the live Supabase instance referenced in `scripts/gestaltview_manifest_pipeline.py`.

A separate `.mcp.json` exists at [.agents/skills/.mcp.json#1-7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.agents/skills/.mcp.json#L1-L7) for the skills hierarchy, connecting to HuggingFace's MCP endpoint.

Sources: [config/mcp.json#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/mcp.json#L1-L8) [.agents/skills/.mcp.json#1-7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.agents/skills/.mcp.json#L1-L7)

## Corpus Ingestion Scripts

Three Python scripts in `scripts/` drive the ingestion pipeline. Each can run locally or via GitHub Actions.

### `ingest_corpus_v2.py` — V2 Section-Based Ingestor

The primary corpus ingestor at [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#1-327](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L1-L327) It reads `corpus_map.json` for section definitions, generates 768-dim embeddings using `Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m` via `SentenceTransformer`, and writes to the `knowledge_fragments` and `documents` Supabase tables.

Key constants at [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#36-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L36-L47):

- `MODEL_NAME = "Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m"`
- `EMBEDDING_DIM = 768`
- `CHUNK_SIZE = 512` (words)
- `CHUNK_OVERLAP = 64`
- `BATCH_SIZE = 32`

Core functions:

| Function | Location | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `get_model()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#53-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L53-L67) | Lazy-loads `SentenceTransformer` on CPU |
| `chunk_text()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#72-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L72-L84) | Word-based chunking with overlap |
| `content_hash()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#87-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L87-L88) | SHA-256 dedup hash |
| `ensure_processing_run()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#97-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L97-L109) | Creates a `processing_runs` row |
| `upsert_document()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#121-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L121-L138) | Upserts to `documents` table with hash dedup |
| `fragment_exists()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#141-143](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L141-L143) | Checks `knowledge_fragments` by `content_hash` |
| `insert_fragment()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#146-163](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L146-L163) | Upserts fragment with embedding vector |
| `ingest_file()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#168-241](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L168-L241) | Full file ingest: read → chunk → embed → write |
| `ingest_section()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#244-284](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L244-L284) | Processes all files in a section |
| `main()` | [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#289-322](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L289-L322) | CLI entry: `--section`, `--dry-run`, `--limit`, `--list-sections` |

Fragment invariant check at [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#227-238](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L227-L238): after inserting all fragments for a file, the script hard-fails if the count of fragments in the database doesn't match the expected chunk count. This prevents silent data loss.

Sources: [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#1-327](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L1-L327)

### `ingest_corpus.py` — V1 Compendium Ingestor

The original ingestor at [scripts/ingest\_corpus.py#1-120](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus.py#L1-L120) reads `config/corpus-map.json` and processes files from the external Compendium repository. It uses environment-configured embedding models (default `google/embedding-gecko-300M`) with 4500-char chunks. Document type classification uses keyword heuristics defined in `DOCUMENT_TYPE_MAP` at [scripts/ingest\_corpus.py#88-111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus.py#L88-L111)

Sources: [scripts/ingest\_corpus.py#1-120](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus.py#L1-L120)

### `ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py` — Agent Trainer Ingestor

A specialized ingestor at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#1-757](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L1-L757) for the `agent_trainer/` package. Key differences from V2:

- Uses `google/embeddinggemma-300M` model (768-dim) at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#95-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L95-L98)
- 3000-char chunks with 400-char overlap (character-based, not word-based) at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#310-326](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L310-L326)
- Supports 26 file extensions including `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.py`, `.sql`, `.sh` at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#107-127](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L107-L127)
- Classifies documents as `API`, `Documentation`, `Product`, or `Architecture` at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#403-417](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L403-L417)
- The `IngestCandidate` dataclass at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#160-166](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L160-L166) groups path, source\_file, package, document\_type, and tags
- Performs hash-based dedup: if `content_hash` matches, the document is skipped as unchanged at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#579-581](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L579-L581)
- Writes to both `knowledge_fragments` and a separate `embeddings` table at [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#644-658](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L644-L658)

Sources: [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#1-757](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L1-L757)

### `synthesize_corpus.py` — LLM-Powered Annotation

The summarization pipeline at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#1-648](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L1-L648) runs in two modes:

1. Supabase-Direct (default) — reads `knowledge_fragments` via REST API, generates `summary` + `loom_annotation` per fragment using an LLM, writes results to three locations
2. Filesystem Pipeline (`--corpus-root`) — uses `gestaltview_manifest_pipeline.py` for backward-compatible filesystem processing

LLM Provider Chain at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#289-299](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L289-L299): Gemini → HuggingFace → OpenAI → Anthropic → Ollama (free-first, mirrors `api/lib/llmrouter.py`).

Two system prompts drive annotation:

- `SUMMARY_SYSTEM_PROMPT` at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#349-357](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L349-L357) — "GestaltView Corpus Archivist" producing 2–4 sentence summaries
- `LOOM_SYSTEM_PROMPT` at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#359-376](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L359-L376) — reveals gaps, recurring threads, weak connections, unresolved loops, and emergent patterns

Write targets (per fragment):

1. `summaries` table — `run_id`, `document_id`, `level='primary'`, `content` at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#569-575](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L569-L575)
2. `loom_annotations` table — `run_id`, `type='thread'`, `content` at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#577-583](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L577-L583)
3. `knowledge_fragments` row — denormalized `summary` + `loom_annotation` patch at [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#585](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L585-L585)

The script integrates with the GIL Protocol (`scripts/gil_protocol.py`) which provides intent, governance, and routing context for LLM prompts. `load_gil_protocol()` at [scripts/gil\_protocol.py#72-82](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gil_protocol.py#L72-L82) loads YAML protocol files. `build_gil_context_block()` at [scripts/gil\_protocol.py#111-117](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gil_protocol.py#L111-L117) formats protocol data into a prompt block.

Sources: [scripts/synthesize\_corpus.py#1-648](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/synthesize_corpus.py#L1-L648) [scripts/gil\_protocol.py#1-100](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gil_protocol.py#L1-L100)

## GitHub Actions Workflows

Three `workflow_dispatch` workflows automate ingestion and annotation.

### `ingest_corpus_v2.yml` — Corpus File Ingestion

[.github/workflows/ingest\_corpus\_v2.yml#1-176](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_corpus_v2.yml#L1-L176)

Trigger: `workflow_dispatch` with 8 inputs:

| Input | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dry_run` | `true` | Skip Supabase writes |
| `no_embed` | `true` | Skip embedding generation |
| `include_marketing` | `false` | Include marketing files |
| `skip_summarize` | `false` | Skip post-ingest summarization |
| `llm_model` | `gemini-2.0-flash` | LLM for summarization |
| `root` | `config/corpus-map_v2.json` | Corpus config path |
| `package` | `corpus-files` | Package tag |
| `target_environment` | `Production` | GitHub Environment |

Environment variables at [.github/workflows/ingest\_corpus\_v2.yml#61-77](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_corpus_v2.yml#L61-L77):

- `GESTALTVIEW_EMBED_MODEL: google/embeddinggemma-300M`
- `GESTALTVIEW_EMBED_DIMS: "768"`
- `GESTALTVIEW_EMBED_BATCH_SIZE: "32"`
- `GESTALTVIEW_EMBED_DEVICE: cpu`

Steps: Checkout → Python 3.11 → Cache pip/HF → Install base deps → Conditional: install summarization deps → Conditional: install CPU embedding deps + HF auth → Preflight secrets → Run `ingest_corpus_v2.py` → Conditional: Run `synthesize_corpus.py` → Upload `manifest_index.json` artifact.

The workflow chains ingest and summarization: if `skip_summarize` is false and not a dry run, it calls `synthesize_corpus.py` immediately after ingestion at [.github/workflows/ingest\_corpus\_v2.yml#162-167](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_corpus_v2.yml#L162-L167)

Sources: [.github/workflows/ingest\_corpus\_v2.yml#1-176](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_corpus_v2.yml#L1-L176)

### `ingest_agent_files.yml` — Agent Trainer Ingestion

[.github/workflows/ingest\_agent\_files.yml#1-141](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_agent_files.yml#L1-L141)

Structurally identical to `ingest_corpus_v2.yml` but targets the agent trainer package:

- Default `root`: `agent_trainer`
- Default `package`: `agent-trainer-package`
- Default `source_prefix`: `agent_trainer`

- Runs `scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py` at [.github/workflows/ingest\_agent\_files.yml#140](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/ingest_agent_files.yml#L140-L140)

A standalone summarization workflow for retroactively annotating existing fragments:

## Scripts Directory Tooling

The `scripts/` directory contains 50+ automation scripts. Beyond the ingestion scripts covered above, the most important are:

### `gv.sh` — CLI Hub

[scripts/gv.sh#1-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L1-L70)

`gv.sh` v5.0 ("Billy Repo Resonance") is the main developer CLI. Key capabilities:

- Multi-provider LLM fallback: Gemini Flash 2.0 → Groq (llama-3.3-70b) → Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:7b) → OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) at [scripts/gv.sh#21-24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L21-L24)
- Billy personality restoration: renders `render-billy-personality.mjs` to `.billy_personality.md` at [scripts/gv.sh#184-186](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L184-L186)
- Repo context building: assembles `.gv_repo_context.md` from canonical orientation files, skill index, and file tree at [scripts/gv.sh#217-268](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L217-L268)
- Bucket Drop capture: captures lightning-bolt thoughts to `.billy_bucket.md` at [scripts/gv.sh#168-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L168-L182)
- Session checkpointing: saves/restores session state to `.gv_checkpoint.json` at [scripts/gv.sh#44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L44-L44)
- Forensic logging: appends timestamped events to `.gv_forensic.log` at [scripts/gv.sh#138-142](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv.sh#L138-L142)

### `gv-health-check.sh` — System Health

[scripts/gv-health-check.sh#1-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gv-health-check.sh#L1-L50)

Validates core tools (`bash`, `curl`, `git`, `node`, `jq`), checks all AI provider keys (Groq, Gemini, OpenAI, HuggingFace), tests Ollama connectivity, and verifies Supabase URL presence. Returns exit code 0 (ready), 1 (degraded), or 2 (critical).

### `gestaltview_manifest_pipeline.py` — Filesystem Pipeline

[scripts/gestaltview\_manifest\_pipeline.py#1-106](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/gestaltview_manifest_pipeline.py#L1-L106)

- `ThreadedConnectionPool` for direct PostgreSQL via psycopg2
- GIL protocol integration
- 8000-char chunks, 500-char overlap default

## Embedding Model Summary

Two embedding models are used across the pipeline, both producing 768-dimensional L2-normalized vectors:

| Model | Used By | Chunk Strategy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m` | `ingest_corpus_v2.py`, YAML config | 512-word chunks, 64-word overlap |
| `google/embeddinggemma-300M` | `ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py`, GitHub Actions workflows | 3000-char chunks, 400-char overlap |

Both models run CPU-only (`device: cpu`) to avoid pulling CUDA dependencies in CI, as specified at [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L13-L13) and [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#97](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L97-L97)

The `MANIFESTINGEST.md` doc at [config/MANIFESTINGEST.md#3-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/MANIFESTINGEST.md?plain=1#L3-L9) references an older configuration using `gemini-embedding-001` (3072-dim), now superseded by the 768-dim models aligned with the Supabase pgvector schema.

Sources: [config/GestaltView\_Corpus\_Ingest\_Config\_v2.yaml#11-13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/GestaltView_Corpus_Ingest_Config_v2.yaml#L11-L13) [scripts/ingest\_corpus\_v2.py#43-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_corpus_v2.py#L43-L44) [scripts/ingest\_agent\_trainer\_corpus.py#95-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/ingest_agent_trainer_corpus.py#L95-L98) [config/MANIFESTINGEST.md#3-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/MANIFESTINGEST.md?plain=1#L3-L9)

# Frontend Architecture

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/references/architecture.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/references/architecture.md?plain=1)

GestaltView's frontend is a single-page application built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7, and Tailwind CSS v4. The client source lives entirely under `client/src/` and is compiled via a root-level Vite configuration. The application uses wouter (not React Router) for routing, Framer Motion 12 for animation, Babylon.js for atmospheric visuals, and Radix UI primitives for the component system. Sentry provides error monitoring, and Vercel Analytics/SpeedInsights are embedded for production telemetry.

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#1-339](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L1-L339) [client/src/main.tsx#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/main.tsx#L1-L8) [vite.config.ts#1-192](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L1-L192) [package.json#1-73](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/package.json#L1-L73)

## Vite Build Configuration

The Vite config at the repo root defines the build pipeline. Key aspects:

- Client root: `client/` directory, output to `dist/public` [vite.config.ts#165-171](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L165-L171)
- Path aliases: `@` → `client/src/`, `@shared` → `shared/`, `@config` → `config/` [vite.config.ts#159-163](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L159-L163)
- Plugins: `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `@tailwindcss/vite`, optional Sentry sourcemap upload, and a custom `inject-meticulous` plugin for recording in non-production [vite.config.ts#152-157](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L152-L157)
- Dev proxy: `/api` requests are proxied to `VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET` or the production Vercel deployment, allowing the SPA to run standalone during development [vite.config.ts#183-189](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L183-L189)

Sources: [vite.config.ts#108-192](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/vite.config.ts#L108-L192)

3. TopNav — fixed navigation bar, conditionally hidden on auth/legal pages via `shouldShowRuntimeNav()` [client/src/App.tsx#102-116](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L102-L116)

## OpeningCeremony: First-Visit Animation

On the first visit to the home page, users see the `OpeningCeremony` — a full-screen cyberpunk-neural entry animation. It is gated by `sessionStorage.getItem("gv-home-reveal-seen")` and skipped entirely when navigating directly to a sub-page [client/src/App.tsx#291-297](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L291-L297)

The ceremony features:

- A `CircuitCanvas` — a pure-canvas particle system rendering 40 pulsating nodes connected by proximity edges, using the Neural-Aurora palette (`#00C896`, `#00D4FF`, `#1A6FFF`, `#7C3AED`, `#FF00C8`) [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#17-112](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L17-L112)
- Animated radial glow layers (teal, purple, fuchsia accent) using Framer Motion [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#147-177](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L147-L177)
- The GestaltView title in Cabin Sketch font with a five-color gradient [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#194-210](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L194-L210)
- An "ENTER SYSTEM" button that triggers a 2.5s exit transition and plays `welcome-to-gestaltview.mp3` [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#126-136](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L126-L136)

Once dismissed, `sessionStorage` is set to `"gv-home-reveal-seen"` and the ceremony never replays within the session [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L133-L133)

Sources: [client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#1-275](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L1-L275) [client/src/App.tsx#291-307](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L291-L307)

## Code Splitting Strategy

The application uses React's `lazy()` for aggressive code splitting. Only `Home` is eagerly imported — all other ~78 page/component imports use `lazy()` to create separate chunks:

```
// Eager — always in the main bundle


import Home from "./pages/Home";


// Lazy — separate chunks loaded on demand


const SanctuaryPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/SanctuaryPage"));


const CodexPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/CodexPage"));


const AgentTrainerPage = lazy(() => import("./features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage"));


const ResumeRockstarModule = lazy(() => import("./modules/Resume_Rockstar"));


// ... ~75 more lazy imports
```

All lazy routes are wrapped in a single `<Suspense>` boundary in `AppInner` with a minimal dark-background fallback: `<div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0F14]" />` [client/src/App.tsx#309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L309-L309)

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L14-L14) [client/src/App.tsx#23-101](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L23-L101) [client/src/App.tsx#309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L309-L309)

## Routing System

The `Router()` function defines a wouter `<Switch>` with ~95 routes organized into categories. For full details, see [Routing, Navigation & Auth](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#3.1).

Route Category Map

Key routing patterns:

- Redirects — legacy paths redirect to current routes (e.g., `/whiteboard-room` → `/blackboard-room`, `/cog-os` → `/engine`, `/platform` → `/dynamic-inner-world`) [client/src/App.tsx#199-205](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L199-L205)
- Protected routes — `ProtectedTrainerControlPlaneRoute` guards `/agent-trainer/control-plane` behind founder email allowlist and admin flags [client/src/App.tsx#130-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L130-L149)
- DI session routes — `/di/:slug` renders `MasterclassSessionPage` for individual DI conversations [client/src/App.tsx#268](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L268-L268)
- Module dual-paths — modules are accessible via both `/module/X` and `/workspace/modules/X` [client/src/App.tsx#259-270](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L259-L270)

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#151-283](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L151-L283)
