## Subsystem Overview

### Routing, Navigation & Auth

The routing layer uses wouter `<Switch>` and `<Route>` components. The `TopNav` component provides a fixed glass-morphism navigation bar with room links, a session tier badge (Guest/Free/Core/Pro/Enterprise/Founder), a `DIPresenceIndicator`, and a mobile hamburger menu [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#57-119](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L57-L119) Authentication flows through `AuthContext`, supporting 5 tiers (`anonymous`, `free`, `core`, `pro`, `enterprise`), Supabase PKCE/implicit OAuth, magic link login, and cookie-based sessions [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#11-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L11-L51)

For details, see [Routing, Navigation & Auth](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#3.1).

### Design System & UI Components

The application uses the Neural-Aurora design system defined in `styles/tokens.css` — with CSS custom properties for colors (obsidian, void-navy, electric-cyan, ultraviolet, neon-magenta), typography (Cabin Sketch, Josefin Sans, Geist Mono, Manrope), spacing, timing, and easing [client/src/styles/tokens.css#35-103](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/styles/tokens.css#L35-L103) The `cn()` utility from `lib/utils.ts` combines `clsx` and `tailwind-merge` for class composition [client/src/lib/utils.ts#1-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/utils.ts#L1-L6) The Babylon.js atmospheric layer (`BillyBabylon`, `AuroraBackground`, `FogOverlay`, `FloatingEmbers`) renders at z-index 0 with React UI at z-index 1, forming the Two-Layer Rendering Model [client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#12-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#L12-L18)

For details, see [Design System & UI Components](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#3.2).

### Pages, Exhibits & Product Modules

The `pages/` directory holds 75+ page components covering rooms (Sanctuary, Blackboard, Dynamic Inner World), exhibits (ADHD Power-Up, Alzheimer's Legacy, Musical DNA), tools (Codex, Tribunal, Gravity Inspector), and commerce (Pricing, GATE Package Builder). The `modules/` directory contains three self-contained product modules — `Resume_Rockstar`, `Symbio_Coder`, `Vibe_Coder` — each with their own `components/`, `lib/`, `pages/`, and `store/` (Zustand) directories. The `features/` directory groups domain-specific UI like the Agent Trainer control plane and the Dynamic Inner World spatial renderer.

For details, see [Pages, Exhibits & Product Modules](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#3.3).

### Hooks & Client Libraries

The `hooks/` directory provides 24 custom hooks spanning session management (`useSession` with tier features), AI routing (`useLLMRouter`), Billy integration (`useBillyRuntimeReadiness`, `useBillyVoice`), DI system (`useDigitalIntelligence`, `useActiveDI`, `useRouteEmbodiment`), atmospheric effects (`useAmbientOrbs`, `useBinauralBeats`, `useBiofeedback`), and more [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#75-139](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L75-L139) The `lib/` layer includes `appFetch` (typed fetch with retry and error classification) [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#92-106](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L92-L106) `BillyEngine` (ManifestIndex, ContextWeaver, KnowledgeLoom running entirely in-browser) [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#1-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L1-L31) `billyApi`, `supabaseAuth`, `gateApi`, `genEngineClient`, `gestaltEventBus`, and Spotify integration.

For details, see [Hooks & Client Libraries](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#3.4).

---

## Key Architectural Patterns

### Billy: The Persistent AI Companion

Billy is not a page-specific chatbot — he is a platform-wide companion available on every surface. The `BillyProvider` at the root of the provider tree exposes context for the `BillyOrb` (floating presence indicator), `BillyPanel` (slide-in chat surface), and `BillyChip` (inline "Ask Billy" buttons) [client/src/components/Billy.tsx#1-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/Billy.tsx#L1-L17) The `BillyBabylon` avatar renders an SVG orb with mood-responsive colors (idle=cyan, listening=white, processing=purple, speaking=mint) [client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#3-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#L3-L9) Billy can operate in two modes: local-only via `BillyEngine.ts` (in-browser knowledge graph) or server-backed via `billyApi.ts` calling `/api/billy`.

### Session Tier & Feature Gating

The `useSession` hook fetches session state from `/api/session/state` and maps the user's tier to a `TierFeatures` object that gates specific capabilities — e.g., `billyUnlimited`, `claudeAccess`, `plkMemory`, `symbioCoderAccess` [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#30-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L30-L56) The `UpgradeBanner` component reads this to display remaining query counts and upgrade prompts for anonymous/free users [client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#11-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#L11-L26)

### Fail-Open Resilience

The frontend is designed to never block the user on infrastructure failures. `AuthProvider` falls back to a guest profile if `/api/auth/session` is unreachable [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#156-161](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L156-L161) `useSession` sets `degraded: true` on failure but still renders with defaults [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#87-94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L87-L94) `appFetchJson` classifies errors into typed codes (`timeout`, `network`, `supabase_paused`, `upstream_5xx`, etc.) with configurable retry and exponential backoff [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L1-L8)

Sources: [client/src/components/Billy.tsx#1-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/Billy.tsx#L1-L17) [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#30-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L30-L56) [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#1-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L1-L55)

# Routing, Navigation & Auth

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/[...path].ts](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/%5B...path%5D.ts)

This page documents the client-side routing architecture (wouter), the `TopNav` navigation component, and the full authentication flow — from Supabase OAuth/magic link through HMAC-signed cookie sessions and tier-based route protection.

## Routing Architecture Overview

GestaltView uses wouter (not React Router) for client-side routing. The `Router()` function in `App.tsx` defines ~95 routes inside a `<Switch>` block, with every page except `Home` lazy-loaded via `React.lazy()`. A `<Suspense>` boundary wraps the router to display a dark fallback during chunk loading.

Route registration and rendering flow in `App.tsx`:

The `App()` component establishes the provider tree: `ErrorBoundary → ThemeProvider → AuthProvider → TooltipProvider → BillyProvider → AppInner` [client/src/App.tsx#321-337](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L321-L337) `AppInner` conditionally renders `TopNav` based on `shouldShowRuntimeNav()`, then either the `OpeningCeremony` (first visit) or the `<Suspense>`-wrapped `Router()` [client/src/App.tsx#285-319](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L285-L319)

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#1-339](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L1-L339)

## Route Categories

The `Router()` function [client/src/App.tsx#151-283](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L151-L283) defines routes organized into the following categories:

| Category | Example Paths | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core | `/`, `/engine`, `/codex`, `/record`, `/billy`, `/billy/voicestudio` | Home is eagerly loaded; all others lazy |
| Workspace / Room | `/sanctuary`, `/blackboard-room`, `/transcriptory`, `/dynamic-inner-world`, `/creation-corner`, `/external-scaffold` | Map to the room-based OS model |
| Auth | `/login`, `/signup`, `/auth/callback`, `/auth/consent`, `/welcome` | Sign-in, callback, and consent flows |
| Monetization | `/pricing`, `/demo`, `/consulting`, `/app`, `/founder-runtime` | Commerce and dashboard pages |
| Agent Trainer | `/agent-trainer`, `/agent-trainer/runtime`, `/agent-trainer/pricing`, `/agent-trainer/control-plane`, `/agent-trainer/dev-cli`, `/lair` | Control plane is founder-protected |
| GATE Package Builder | `/agent-trainer/package-builder`, `/agent-trainer/orders/:id` | GATE commerce integration |
| Module | `/module/resume-rockstar`, `/module/symbio-coder`, `/module/vibe-coder`, `/module/masterclass`, `/di/:slug` | Self-contained product modules |
| Exhibit / Demo | `/alzheimers-legacy`, `/adhd-powerup`, `/addiction-recovery`, `/musical-dna`, `/brain-sparks`, `/heirloom-companion`, `/validation-wall`, `/gravity` | Showcase pages for product exhibits |
| Info / Framework | `/collaboration-proof`, `/resonance-loop`, `/ethics-framework`, `/tribunal`, `/orientation`, `/exhibits` | Framework and methodology pages |
| Legal / Utility | `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/404` | Static legal and informational pages |
| Dev / Internal | `/sandbox` | Development-only sandbox |

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#151-283](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L151-L283)

### Lazy Loading

Only `Home` is eagerly imported [client/src/App.tsx#14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L14-L14) All other page components are declared with `React.lazy()` [client/src/App.tsx#23-101](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L23-L101) For example:

- `const SanctuaryPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/SanctuaryPage"))` [client/src/App.tsx#82](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L82-L82)
- `const AgentTrainerPage = lazy(() => import("./features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage"))` [client/src/App.tsx#43](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L43-L43)
- `const ResumeRockstarModule = lazy(() => import("./modules/Resume_Rockstar"))` [client/src/App.tsx#94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L94-L94)

The `<Suspense>` boundary in `AppInner` provides a dark background fallback (`bg-[#0A0F14]`) during chunk loading [client/src/App.tsx#309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L309-L309)

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#14-101](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L14-L101) [client/src/App.tsx#309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L309-L309)

## TopNav Component

`TopNav` [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#57-338](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L57-L338) is a fixed, glass-morphism navigation bar pinned to the top of the viewport at `z-index: 50`. It renders conditionally based on `shouldShowRuntimeNav()` [client/src/App.tsx#304](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L304-L304)

### Structure

The nav bar uses a CSS linear gradient over `rgba(5,7,11,…)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)` for the glass-morphism effect [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#100-107](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L100-L107)

It is organized in a three-column grid (`grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto]`) [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L109-L109):

1. Left: GestaltView logo and v2 badge linking to `/`
2. Center (desktop, `xl:flex`): Pill-shaped nav items from `NAV_ITEMS` array
3. Right: Session tier badge, DI Presence Indicator, Founder Manifest button, Sign in/out, and mobile hamburger

### NAV\_ITEMS

The `NAV_ITEMS` array defines the 11 primary navigation destinations displayed as pills [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#35-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L35-L47):

| Label | Path | Icon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blackboard Room | `/blackboard-room` | `ClipboardList` |
| Transcriptory | `/transcriptory` | `FileAudio` |
| Sanctuary | `/sanctuary` | `Castle` |
| Dynamic Inner World | `/dynamic-inner-world` | `PanelsTopLeft` |
| Agent Council | `/agent-council` | `Users` |
| External Scaffold | `/external-scaffold` | `Shield` |
| Creation Corner | `/creation-corner` | `PenSquare` |
| Masterclass | `/module/masterclass` | `GraduationCap` |
| File Explorer | `/documents` | `FolderOpen` |
| Profile | `/profile` | `UserRound` |
| Settings | `/settings` | `Settings2` |

Active state is determined by `isActivePath()` [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#49-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L49-L55) which performs prefix matching.

Sources: [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#35-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L35-L55)

### Session Tier Badge

The right side of the nav displays a `sessionLabel` pill [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#208-212](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L208-L212) derived from `useAuth()`. The label resolves to `"Founder"` if the user's email matches `VITE_FOUNDER_EMAIL`, the uppercase tier name if authenticated, or `"Guest"` otherwise [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#75-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L75-L85)

Sources: [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#71-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L71-L85) [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#208-212](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L208-L212)

### DI Presence Indicator

When the user is authenticated, `<DIPresenceIndicator />` renders [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#214](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L214-L214) This component [client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#18-169](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#L18-L169) shows the currently active Digital Intelligence persona with an animated ping dot using the persona's presence color. Clicking it opens a modal panel listing available DI personas fetched via `useActiveDI()`, allowing quick persona switching [client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#20](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#L20-L20) The active DI slug is persisted in `localStorage` key `gv_active_di`.

Sources: [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#214](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L214-L214) [client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#1-169](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/DIPresenceIndicator.tsx#L1-L169)

### Masterclass Dropdown

The Masterclass nav item renders a special dropdown instead of a simple link. It lists the top 8 DI profiles (`quickDIProfiles`) from `EMBODIMENT_REGISTRY` for quick-launch navigation to `/di/:slug` [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#63-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L63-L70) [client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#128-189](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/TopNav.tsx#L128-L189)

## Authentication System

### AuthContext & Tier Model

The `AuthContext` [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#80](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L80-L80) provides the full authentication state to the React tree. It exposes the `AuthContextValue` interface [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#35-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L35-L51) with:

- `user: AuthUser | null` — id, email, role
- `session: AuthSession | null` — access token wrapper
- `profile: AuthProfile | null` — includes tier, isAdmin, billyQueryCount
- `tier: UserTier` — one of 5 tiers
- Methods: `signIn`, `signUp`, `signInWithMagicLink`, `signOut`, `refreshProfile`, `getAuthHeader`

The 5 user tiers are defined as `UserTier` [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#11](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L11-L11):

| Tier | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `anonymous` | No authentication; limited demo queries (2 Billy queries) |
| `free` | Authenticated but no paid subscription; 1 domain lane |
| `core` | Paid tier; unlimited Billy, PLK memory, ADHD full access |
| `pro` | Adds Claude access, all domain lanes, diligence exports, SymbioCoder |
| `enterprise` | All features including collaborator engine access |

Tier feature mappings are defined in `useSession` hook's `TIER_FEATURES` constant [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#30-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L30-L56)

Sources: [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#11-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L11-L51) [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#4-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L4-L56)

### Authentication Flow Diagram

Sources: [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#242-248](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L242-L248) [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#138-159](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L138-L159) [api/login.ts#39-102](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L39-L102) [client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#10-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#L10-L91) [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#161-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L161-L191) [api/auth/supabase/session.ts#25-78](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/auth/supabase/session.ts#L25-L78) [api/auth/session.ts#1-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/auth/session.ts#L1-L27)

### Magic Link Login

The `SignIn` page [client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#8-126](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#L8-L126) provides a single email field. On submit, it calls `signInWithMagicLink(email)` from `AuthContext` [client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#L34-L34) The context delegates to `requestInviteOnlyMagicLink()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#138-159](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L138-L159) which `POST`s to `/api/login` with `credentials: "include"`.

The server-side `api/login.ts` [api/login.ts#39-102](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L39-L102) enforces an invite-only allowlist:

1. Reads `MAGIC_LINK_ALLOWLIST` env var (comma-separated emails) [api/login.ts#7-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L7-L19)
2. Falls back to `getFounderAdminEmails()` (default: `keithsoyka@gmail.com`) [api/login.ts#18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L18-L18)
3. Rejects emails not on the allowlist with 403 [api/login.ts#70-75](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L70-L75)
4. Calls `supabase.auth.signInWithOtp()` with `shouldCreateUser: false` [api/login.ts#85-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L85-L91)

Sources: [client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#8-43](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SignIn.tsx#L8-L43) [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#138-159](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L138-L159) [api/login.ts#7-102](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/login.ts#L7-L102)

### OAuth Callback (PKCE & Implicit)

The `AuthCallback` page [client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#10-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#L10-L91) handles the Supabase redirect. It calls `establishBrowserSessionFromCallbackUrl()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#63-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L63-L93) which detects the token type via `readSupabaseCallbackTokens()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#44-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L44-L61):

- PKCE flow: URL contains `?code=...` → calls `exchangeCodeForSession(code)` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#68-73](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L68-L73)
- Implicit flow: URL hash contains `#access_token=...&refresh_token=...` → calls `setSession()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#76-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L76-L84)
- Neither: falls back to `getSession()` from existing browser state [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#87-92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L87-L92)

After establishing the Supabase browser session, `syncBrowserSessionToAppCookie()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#161-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L161-L191) sends the access token to `POST /api/auth/supabase/session` which verifies it server-side with `supabase.auth.getUser()`, then issues a `gv_admin_session` HMAC-signed cookie [api/auth/supabase/session.ts#55-68](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/auth/supabase/session.ts#L55-L68)

The callback page has an 8-second timeout (`AUTH_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT_MS`) — if the session cannot be established, it redirects to `/login?error=callback_failed` [client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#L8-L8) [client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#57](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#L57-L57)

Sources: [client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#10-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/AuthCallback.tsx#L10-L91) [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#39-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L39-L93) [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#161-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L161-L191) [api/auth/supabase/session.ts#25-78](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/auth/supabase/session.ts#L25-L78)

### Cookie-Based Sessions (`gv_admin_session`)

All server-side auth verification centers on the HMAC-signed cookie `gv_admin_session` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L5-L5)

The cookie contains an `AdminSessionPayload` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#20-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L20-L28):

```
{ version: 1, userId, email, role, tier, issuedAt, expiresAt }
```

Cookie creation (`createAuthSessionCookie`) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#206-237](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L206-L237):

- Payload is JSON-serialized, base64url-encoded
- Signed with HMAC-SHA256 using `SESSION_SECRET` env var [api/\_lib/auth.ts#161-162](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L161-L162)
- Format: `<base64url-payload>.<base64url-signature>`
- Cookie attributes: `Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure (in production)`
- Default TTL: 14 days [api/\_lib/auth.ts#11](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L11-L11) max 30 days [api/\_lib/auth.ts#72](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L72-L72)

Cookie verification (`verifySessionToken`) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#165-204](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L165-L204):

- Splits token on `.`, re-computes HMAC, uses `timingSafeEqual` for constant-time comparison [api/\_lib/auth.ts#176-179](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L176-L179)
- Validates payload version, role, field types, and expiry [api/\_lib/auth.ts#184-196](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L184-L196)

Auth user resolution (`getAuthUser`) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#368-458](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L368-L458) follows a two-path strategy:

1. Cookie-first: Check `gv_admin_session` cookie → `verifySessionToken()` → return user [api/\_lib/auth.ts#374-385](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L374-L385)
2. Bearer token fallback: If no cookie, extract `Authorization: Bearer <token>` → verify against Supabase Auth → query `profiles` table for tier/admin status → cache result for 60s [api/\_lib/auth.ts#389-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L389-L457)

Sources: [api/\_lib/auth.ts#1-543](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L1-L543)

### Session State & Rate Limiting

The `GET /api/session/state` endpoint [api/session/state.ts#16-38](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/session/state.ts#L16-L38) provides public session state (tier, query count, limits) to both authenticated and anonymous users. It builds a session fingerprint from IP + User-Agent + date (SHA-256 hashed, daily-rotating) [api/session/state.ts#5-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/session/state.ts#L5-L14) and delegates to `getSessionState()` from the rate limiter. On error, it fails open with a permissive anonymous state [api/session/state.ts#30-36](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/session/state.ts#L30-L36)

The client-side `useSession` hook [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#75-139](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L75-L139) fetches this state and provides `features`, `tierLabel`, `hasFeature()`, and `decrementRemaining()` for Billy query gating.

The `UpgradeBanner` component [client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#11-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#L11-L93) uses both `useSession` and `useAuth` to display a soft upgrade nudge to anonymous/free users showing remaining queries. It is dismissable and never blocks interaction.

Sources: [api/session/state.ts#1-38](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/session/state.ts#L1-L38) [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#75-139](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L75-L139) [client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#11-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/UpgradeBanner.tsx#L11-L93)

### Startup Initialization

On mount, `AuthProvider` fires a parallel load of two API calls [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#164-204](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L164-L204):

1. `GET /api/session/state` → public session (tier, query limits)
2. `GET /api/auth/session` → authenticated session (user identity, tier, admin flag)

If the auth session returns `authenticated: true`, the user, session, and profile are populated. Otherwise, a guest profile is built from the public session state. `isLoading` remains `true` until both calls resolve [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#196](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L196-L196)

Sources: [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#164-204](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L164-L204)

### Logout

`signOut()` in `AuthContext` [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#251-263](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L251-L263) calls `POST /api/logout`, which clears the `gv_admin_session` cookie by setting `Max-Age=0` [api/logout.ts#11](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/logout.ts#L11-L11) The client then resets user/session to null and refreshes the public session state.

Sources: [client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#251-263](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx#L251-L263) [api/logout.ts#1-13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/logout.ts#L1-L13) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#243-257](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L243-L257)

## Route Protection Patterns

### ProtectedTrainerControlPlaneRoute

The `ProtectedTrainerControlPlaneRoute` component [client/src/App.tsx#130-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L130-L149) guards `/agent-trainer/control-plane`. It:

1. Reads `isLoading`, `isAdmin`, `session`, `user` from `useAuth()` [client/src/App.tsx#131](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L131-L131)
2. While loading or waiting for auth token, renders a blank dark screen to prevent layout shift [client/src/App.tsx#134-137](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L134-L137)
3. Checks access via `hasFounderTrainerControlPlaneAccess()` [client/src/App.tsx#139-142](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L139-L142)
4. Redirects unauthorized users to `/agent-trainer` (the pricing page) [client/src/App.tsx#144-146](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L144-L146)
5. Renders `<AgentTrainerPage />` only if authorized [client/src/App.tsx#148](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L148-L148)

Sources: [client/src/App.tsx#130-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/App.tsx#L130-L149)

### Founder Email Allowlist

The `hasFounderTrainerControlPlaneAccess()` function [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#16-29](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L16-L29) grants access if:

- `input.isAdmin` is `true`, OR
- The user's email is in the `VITE_FOUNDER_ADMIN_EMAILS` env var (comma-separated), falling back to `["keithsoyka@gmail.com"]` [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#1-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L1-L14)

The server-side equivalent is `getFounderAdminEmails()` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#49-52](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L49-L52) and `isFounderAdminEmail()` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#54-57](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L54-L57) used by helpers like `requireFounderOrAdmin()` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#491-504](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L491-L504) and `requireAdmin()` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#476-489](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L476-L489) for API route protection.

Sources: [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#1-29](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L1-L29) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#49-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L49-L61) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#476-504](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L476-L504)

### Hosted Agent Trainer Access

`hasHostedAgentTrainerAccess()` [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#31-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L31-L47) is a separate tier-based gate for `/agent-trainer/runtime`. It grants access to admins, users with `core`/`pro`/`enterprise` tier, or users with `active`/`trialing` subscription status. `resolveHostedAgentTrainerPlan()` [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#49-105](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L49-L105) maps tiers to runtime plan labels (`SOLO_SPARK`, `STUDIO`, `ENTERPRISE`).

Sources: [client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#31-105](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/agentTrainerAccess.ts#L31-L105)

### Server-Side Auth Guards

The `api/_lib/auth.ts` module exports composable guard functions:

| Guard | Behavior | Line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getAuthUser(req)` | Returns `AuthUser` or `null`; cookie-first, then Bearer JWT | [api/\_lib/auth.ts#368-458](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L368-L458) |
| `requireAuth(req)` | Returns user or `{ status: 401 }` | [api/\_lib/auth.ts#465-474](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L465-L474) |
| `requireAdmin(req)` | Returns admin user or `{ status: 401/403 }` | [api/\_lib/auth.ts#476-489](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L476-L489) |
| `requireFounderOrAdmin(req)` | Returns founder/admin user or `{ status: 401/403 }` | [api/\_lib/auth.ts#491-504](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L491-L504) |

Admin-gated API paths (checked via `isAdminGatedPath`) include `/api/trainer/`, `/api/admin/`, and `/api/gate/` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#330-339](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L330-L339)

The server-side `api/_lib/supabaseOidc.ts` [api/\_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#1-239](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#L1-L239) provides full OIDC support for Supabase JWT verification:

- `getSupabaseProjectUrl()` — reads `SUPABASE_URL` or `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` [api/\_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#64-66](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#L64-L66)
- `fetchSupabaseDiscoveryDocument()` — fetches `/.well-known/openid-configuration` with caching [api/\_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#88-126](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#L88-L126)
- `fetchSupabaseJwks()` — fetches the JWKS key set with caching [api/\_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#128-159](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabaseOidc.ts#L128-L159)

The client-side Supabase client is lazily initialized in `getSupabaseBrowserClient()` [client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#15-37](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/supabaseAuth.ts#L15-L37) with `autoRefreshToken: true`, `detectSessionInUrl: true`, and `persistSession: true`.

# Design System & UI Components

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/brainstorming/visual-companion.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/brainstorming/visual-companion.md?plain=1)

This page documents the Neural-Aurora design system powering GestaltView's frontend. It covers the CSS custom property token layer, the typography system, the 55-component shadcn/ui primitive library, the `cn()` + `class-variance-authority` styling pipeline, Framer Motion animations, the atmospheric visual layer (AuroraBackground, FogOverlay, FloatingEmbers, BillyBabylon, BillyAvatar), and the Two-Layer Rendering Model that composites a full-screen canvas beneath interactive React UI.

## Architecture Overview

Two-Layer Rendering Model: Atmospheric Canvas + React UI

The atmospheric layer uses `position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0` to sit behind all interactive content. The React wrapper sits at `position: relative; z-index: 1`. This rule is constitutional — the Babylon.js/atmospheric layer is described as "NOT optional decoration" but "the product's felt identity" [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#40-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L40-L44)

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#39-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L39-L44) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#22](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#L22-L22) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#L8-L8) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#71](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#L71-L71)

## Typography System

Four typefaces serve distinct roles:

| Typeface | CSS Variable | Role | Utility Class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cabin Sketch | `--gv-font-hero` | Logos, hero headings | `.font-logo`, `.font-gv-hero` |
| Josefin Sans / Manrope | `--gv-font-display` | Display / section headings | `.font-display` |
| Manrope | `--gv-font-body` / `--gv-font-ui` | Body text, UI labels | `.font-body`, `.font-ui` |
| Geist Mono | `--gv-font-mono` | Code, data, monospace | `.font-mono-data`, `.font-gv-mono` |

Fonts are loaded as `@font-face` declarations with `font-display: swap` for performance. Cabin Sketch loads Regular (400) and Bold (700) as TTF. Manrope and Geist Mono are variable-weight fonts (100-900) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/styles/tokens.css#3-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/styles/tokens.css#L3-L33)

## The `cn()` Utility & Class Variance Authority

### `cn()` — Class Name Merger

The `cn()` function in `lib/utils.ts` composes `clsx` (conditional class joining) with `tailwind-merge` (intelligent deduplication of Tailwind classes):

```
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";


import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";


export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {


return twMerge(clsx(inputs));


}
```

[gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/lib/utils.ts#1-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/lib/utils.ts#L1-L6)

Every UI component imports `cn` from `@/lib/utils` to merge default styles with caller-supplied `className` props. This ensures later classes always win over defaults in Tailwind's specificity model.

### `class-variance-authority` (CVA)

CVA defines component variants as typed configuration objects. The pattern is used across nearly all `components/ui/*` primitives. Key dependencies: `class-variance-authority@^0.7.1`, `clsx@^2.1.1`, `tailwind-merge@^3.5.0` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#127-152](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L127-L152)

Variant Architecture Diagram

Example: `buttonVariants` defines 6 variants (`default`, `destructive`, `outline`, `secondary`, `ghost`, `link`) and 6 sizes (`default`, `sm`, `lg`, `icon`, `icon-sm`, `icon-lg`). The `Button` component uses the Radix `Slot` pattern via `asChild` to render as any element [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/button.tsx#7-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/button.tsx#L7-L60)

Example: `badgeVariants` defines 4 variants (`default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`) with the same `asChild`/`Slot` pattern [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/badge.tsx#7-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/badge.tsx#L7-L46)

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/lib/utils.ts#1-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/lib/utils.ts#L1-L6) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/button.tsx#1-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/button.tsx#L1-L60) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/badge.tsx#1-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/badge.tsx#L1-L46) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#127-152](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L127-L152)

## UI Component Library (55 Primitives)

The `client/src/components/ui/` directory contains 55 shadcn/ui-style components built on Radix UI primitives. Each component follows the pattern: Radix primitive → CVA variants → `cn()` merge → `data-slot` attribute for styling hooks.

### Component Inventory

| Category | Components |
| --- | --- |
| Layout | `card` (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter), `separator`, `aspect-ratio`, `resizable`, `scroll-area`, `sidebar` |
| Inputs | `button`, `input`, `textarea`, `checkbox`, `radio-group`, `select`, `slider`, `switch`, `toggle`, `toggle-group`, `calendar`, `input-otp`, `input-group`, `field` |
| Display | `badge`, `avatar`, `skeleton`, `spinner`, `progress`, `chart`, `table`, `pagination`, `kbd`, `item` |
| Overlay | `dialog`, `alert-dialog`, `sheet`, `drawer`, `popover`, `hover-card`, `tooltip`, `context-menu`, `dropdown-menu`, `command`, `menubar`, `navigation-menu` |
| Feedback | `alert`, `sonner` (toast), `empty` (empty states) |
| Composition | `accordion`, `breadcrumb`, `carousel`, `collapsible`, `tabs`, `form`, `label`, `button-group` |
| GestaltView Custom | `GVTypography` (GVLogo, GVHeading, GVBody, GVMono, GVEyebrow, GVParchmentPanel), `GlassCard` |

### Radix Primitives Used

The project depends on 21 Radix UI packages [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#81-106](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L81-L106):

`@radix-ui/react-accordion`, `alert-dialog`, `aspect-ratio`, `avatar`, `checkbox`, `collapsible`, `context-menu`, `dialog`, `dropdown-menu`, `hover-card`, `label`, `menubar`, `navigation-menu`, `popover`, `progress`, `radio-group`, `scroll-area`, `select`, `separator`, `slider`, `slot`, `switch`, `tabs`, `toggle`, `toggle-group`, `tooltip`.

### `data-slot` Convention

Every component outputs a `data-slot` attribute (e.g., `data-slot="button"`, `data-slot="card"`, `data-slot="dialog-content"`) enabling CSS targeting without class name coupling. For example, `Card` renders `data-slot="card"` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/card.tsx#8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/card.tsx#L8-L8) and `Dialog` uses `data-slot="dialog"`, `data-slot="dialog-content"`, etc. [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#51-66](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#L51-L66)

### Dialog Composition Context

The `Dialog` component extends the Radix primitive with a `DialogCompositionContext` that tracks IME composition state, preventing the dialog from closing on Escape during CJK text input — a Safari-specific fix [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#7-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#L7-L54)

### GlassCard — Neon Glass Primitive

`GlassCard` is a GestaltView-specific component that wraps content in a glass-morphism card with:

- 11 glow variants: `cyan`, `teal`, `emerald`, `electricPurple`, `neonPink`, `neonRed`, `midnightBlue`, `blue`, `gold`, `purple`, `none` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#18-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L18-L30)
- 3 intensity levels: `low` (70% opacity), `medium` (80%), `high` (90%) — using deep dark bases, not pale washes [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#33-37](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L33-L37)
- Dynamic liquid breathing: A Framer Motion animated gradient that cycles through cyan/purple radial gradients [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#78-89](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L78-L89)
- Interactive spotlight: A mouse-tracking radial gradient overlay [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#92-99](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L92-L99)

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/card.tsx#1-93](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/card.tsx#L1-L93) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#1-209](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx#L1-L209) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#1-111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L1-L111) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#81-106](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L81-L106)

## Framer Motion Animations

Framer Motion 12 (`framer-motion@^12.23.22`) drives all non-CSS animations [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L133-L133) It is used across the atmospheric layer and UI components.

### Key Animation Patterns

| Component | Animation Type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FogOverlay` | `motion.div` animate | Two counter-rotating fog layers at 40s and 55s cycles, with `mix-blend-color-dodge` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#12-45](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#L12-L45) |
| `BillyAvatar` | `motion.div` float | Gentle 3.2s vertical float `y: [0, -6, 0]` with `easeInOut` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#50-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L50-L54) |
| `GlassCard` | `motion.div` gradient | 8s cycling radial gradient background [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#79-89](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L79-L89) |
| `OpeningCeremony` | `motion.div` + `AnimatePresence` | Entry fade + scale, exit fade, radial glow pulsing [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#138-250](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L138-L250) |

The design rules mandate: "Motion is intentional — micro-interactions yes, gratuitous animation no" [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L54-L54)

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/package.json#L133-L133) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#L1-L51) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#50-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L50-L54) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#53-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L53-L55)

## Atmospheric Layer Components

The atmospheric layer provides GestaltView's visual identity. These components are `position: fixed` with `pointer-events: none` and render at z-index 0 or low z-indices beneath the React UI.

### Component Map

### `AuroraBackground`

A full-screen CSS-animated background using multiple `radial-gradient` layers with a slow `aurora-shift` keyframe (15s) and four blurred floating orbs with `neural-float` animation (8s) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#7-63](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#L7-L63) The orbs use the Neural-Aurora palette: cyan `rgba(0,212,255,0.06)`, purple `rgba(153,69,255,0.08)`, emerald `rgba(0,255,212,0.05)`, gold `rgba(255,215,0,0.04)`.

### `FogOverlay`

Two Framer Motion `motion.div` layers that sweep counter-directionally across the viewport. Layer 1 moves at 40s with cyan + purple gradients. Layer 2 moves at 55s with pink + emerald. A vignette darkens edges. Uses `mix-blend-color-dodge` and `opacity-60` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#L1-L51)

### `FloatingEmbers`

A JavaScript particle system that spawns up to 25 concurrent ember particles rising from the viewport bottom. Default palette: `NEON_EMBER_COLORS = ["#00E5FF", "#B026FF", "#FF007F", "#FFD700", "#00FF66"]` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#L26-L26) Each ember gets randomized size (2-6px), duration (8-18s), horizontal drift, and a neon glow `boxShadow`. The `gv-plasma-rise` CSS keyframe drives the rise animation. Embers auto-remove from state after their animation completes [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#28-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#L28-L98)

### `BillyBabylon`

A mood-reactive SVG orb representing Billy's presence. Accepts a `mood` prop (`idle` | `listening` | `processing` | `speaking`) which maps to accent colors via `MOOD_COLORS`: idle → `#00D4FF`, listening → `#F8FAFC`, processing → `#9F67FF`, speaking → `#00FFC8` [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#5-10](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#L5-L10) The SVG uses `<animate>` and `<animateTransform>` for breathing and rotation effects. Processing mode rotates faster (10s vs 16s) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#69](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#L69-L69)

### `BillyAvatar`

A detailed SVG character avatar (Tron-inspired helmet design) with:

- 4 size presets: `sm` (48px), `md` (80px), `lg` (120px), `xl` (180px) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L24-L24)
- Glow halo: Teal radial gradient behind the avatar [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#57-68](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L57-L68)
- Float animation: Framer Motion `y: [0, -6, 0]` at 3.2s [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#53-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L53-L54)
- BillyChip export: A composite component combining `BillyAvatar` + name + tagline for sidebar/header use [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#222-264](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L222-L264)

### `OpeningCeremony`

A first-visit gate animation at `z-index: 9999`. Uses a `CircuitCanvas` (HTML5 Canvas with 40 connected particle nodes in the Neural-Aurora palette), Framer Motion radial glows, and the `GV_TITLE_GRADIENT` (emerald → teal → midnight blue → electric purple → fuchsia). Completes by storing `gv-home-reveal-seen` in `sessionStorage` and playing a welcome audio file [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#1-250](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L1-L250)

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#1-63](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/AuroraBackground.tsx#L1-L63) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FogOverlay.tsx#L1-L51) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#1-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/FloatingEmbers.tsx#L1-L98) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#1-99](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyBabylon.tsx#L1-L99) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#1-264](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/BillyAvatar.tsx#L1-L264) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#1-250](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/OpeningCeremony.tsx#L1-L250)

## Design Rules & Constraints

The following rules are codified in the agent instructions and are treated as constitutional:

| Rule | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Neural-Aurora palette only. Dark backgrounds, high contrast. | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L53-L53) |
| No glassmorphism (despite `GlassCard` — which uses deep dark bases, not white washes) | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L53-L53) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#33-37](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/client/src/components/ui/GlassCard.tsx#L33-L37) |
| Motion is intentional — micro-interactions yes, gratuitous animation no | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L54-L54) |
| `prefers-reduced-motion` must be respected | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L55-L55) |
| Mobile: degrade gracefully but never remove core experience (e.g., reduce particle count, don't remove canvas) | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L56-L56) |
| Atmospheric canvas layer is NOT optional — it IS the product identity | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#40](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L40-L40) |
| Canvas: `position: absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; z-index:0` | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L41-L41) |
| React wrapper: `position: relative; z-index: 1` | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#42](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L42-L42) |
| Always clean up: `scene.dispose()` + `engine.dispose()` on unmount | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#43](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L43-L43) |
| No confetti, no generic SaaS UI patterns | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L92-L92) |
| Zero `any` casts without explanatory comment | [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L50-L50) |

Sources: [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#39-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L39-L56) [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md#90-94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1#L90-L94)

# Pages, Exhibits & Product Modules

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/references/app-archetypes.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/references/app-archetypes.md?plain=1)

This page documents the three major client-side surface layers of GestaltView: the 75+ page components in `pages/`, the exhibit system (a curated museum-style demo catalog), and the self-contained product modules in `modules/`. It also covers the features/ directory which houses complex feature subsystems: Agent Trainer, Dynamic Inner World, Masterclass, and Workbook.

## Architectural Overview

The client-side surfaces follow a clear separation:

| Layer | Directory | Purpose | State Management |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pages | `client/src/pages/` | Top-level route targets, each lazy-loaded via React `Suspense` | Hooks + context |
| Exhibits | `client/src/components/exhibits/` + `client/src/data/exhibits.ts` | Museum-style demo catalog with scoped Billy chat | `ExhibitContext` via `BillyEngine` |
| Modules | `client/src/modules/` | Self-contained product apps (own components, lib, pages, store) | Zustand per-module |
| Features | `client/src/features/` | Complex multi-component feature systems | Custom hooks + Zustand |

Page-to-Route Architecture

Sources: [client/src/pages/Home.tsx#1-145](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/Home.tsx#L1-L145) [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#1-77](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L1-L77) [client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#1-117](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#L1-L117)

## Page Components (`pages/`)

The `pages/` directory contains 75+ React components, each serving as a route target. Only `Home` is eagerly loaded; all others use `lazy()` with `Suspense` boundaries.

### Page Catalog

| Category | Pages | Key Components |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Home / Landing | `Home.tsx` | `FogOverlay`, `FloatingEmbers`, `GlassCard`, room navigation grid with 8 `ROOM_CARDS` |
| Room Pages | `SanctuaryPage`, `BlackboardRoomPage`, `CreationCornerPage`, `DynamicInnerWorldPage`, `ExternalScaffoldPage`, `WhiteboardRoomPage` | Room-specific atmospheres, `useBillySection()` binding |
| Exhibit / Museum | `ExhibitsIndex`, `MuseumPage`, `ADHDPowerUpPage`, `AddictionRecoveryPage`, `AlzheimersLegacyPage`, `MusicalDNAPage`, `HeirloomCompanionPage` | `EXHIBITS` data, `BillyExhibitChat`, `ScrollReader` |
| Product Modules | `SymbioCodingPage`, `BillyVoiceStudioPage`, `RapidPrototypePage` | Module wrappers |
| Agent / Trainer | `AgentTrainerDevCliPage`, `AgentAcademyPage`, `AgentCouncilPage`, `HostedAgentTrainerPage`, `AgentTrainerPricing` | Trainer feature panels |
| Analytics / Ops | `AnalyticsPage`, `MetricsDashboardPage`, `DashboardPage`, `WorkspaceAnalysisPage`, `WorkspacesPage` | Operational surfaces |
| Codex / Engine | `CodexPage`, `ContinuumCodexPage`, `EnginePage`, `GravityInspectorPage`, `TribunalPage`, `TranscriptoryPage` | System inspection |
| Commerce | `GATEPackageBuilderPage`, `GATEOrderStatusPage`, `Pricing` | GATE builder, Stripe |
| Profile / Settings | `ProfilePage`, `SettingsPage`, `DocumentsPage` | User management |
| Auth | `SignIn`, `Signup`, `AuthCallback`, `SpotifyCallbackPage` | OAuth flows |
| Info / Legal | `FAQ`, `ContactPage`, `ConsultingPage`, `EthicsFrameworkPage`, `PrivacyPage`, `Terms`, `CollaborationProofPage` | Static/legal |
| Misc | `NotFound`, `Welcome`, `Demo`, `SandboxPage`, `InsightWindow`, `PullStringPage`, `ResonanceLoopPage`, `BrainSparksPage`, `BucketDropsPage`, `LivingLegacyPage`, `GeminiAwakening`, `AdaptiveLayoutPage`, `FounderRuntimePage`, `OrientationSlideshowPage`, `MasterclassPage`, `MasterclassSessionPage`, `VoicePage` | Specialized surfaces |

1. Atmospheric layers: `FogOverlay` and `FloatingEmbers` at z-index 0 [client/src/pages/Home.tsx#18-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/Home.tsx#L18-L19)

4. Billy section binding via `useBillySection("home")` [client/src/pages/Home.tsx#35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/Home.tsx#L35-L35)

## Exhibit System

The exhibit system provides a museum-style catalog of GestaltView's product modules and philosophical foundations, each with a scoped Billy chat channel, demo surfaces, and metadata.

### Exhibit Data Model

Sources: [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#4-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L4-L41) [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#13-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L13-L28) [client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#1-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#L1-L46) [client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#4-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#L4-L8)

### Exhibit Registry (`data/exhibits.ts`)

The `EXHIBITS` array is constructed by merging `RAW_EXHIBITS` (11 base entries) with `CATEGORY_META` (color/glyph/role by category) and `SCOPE_BY_SLUG` (demo mode and codex scroll binding per slug) [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#273-298](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L273-L298)

The 11 registered exhibits:

| Slug | Title | Category | Demo Mode | codexScrollId | neverLookAway |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vibe-coder` | VibeCoder v2.0 | AI Interface | `static-demo` | `plk` | false |
| `resume-rockstar-demo` | Resume Rockstar Pro | Career Platform | `iframe` → `/resume-rockstar` | `symbiosis` | false |
| `adhd-powerup` | External Scaffold Of You | Scaffold Module | `iframe` → `/adhd-powerup` | `bucket-drop` | false |
| `symbiocoder` | SymbioCoder Plus v1.0 | Development Tool | `billy-chat` | `symbiosis` | false |
| `ai-collab-engine` | The 18.78 Quintillion Wall | Scientific Validation | `static-demo` | `tribunal` | false |
| `continuum-codex` | The Continuum Codex | Foundational Event | `static-demo` | `sanctuary` | false |
| `insight-bot` | Brain Sparks Station | Interactive Demo | `iframe` → `/brain-sparks-station` | `bucket-drop` | false |
| `creation-corner` | Village Builders' Covenant | Ethical Framework | `iframe` → `/village-builders` | `biography` | false |
| `musical-dna` | Musical DNA | Musical DNA Profile | `billy-chat` | `symbiosis` | false |
| `alzheimers-legacy` | Memory Continuity | Continuity Module | `billy-chat` | `never-look-away` | true |
| `addiction-recovery` | For Life's Hard Parts: Pull String | Recovery Module | `billy-chat` | `never-look-away` | true |

The `neverLookAway` flag (set for alzheimers-legacy and addiction-recovery) triggers crisis resource display in `BillyExhibitChat` [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#262-270](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L262-L270)

Exhibits are also exported as `EXHIBIT_BY_SLUG` for O(1) lookup and `MUSEUM_EXHIBITS` for museum page rendering [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#300-308](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L300-L308)

Sources: [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#43-271](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L43-L271) [client/src/data/exhibits.ts#273-308](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/data/exhibits.ts#L273-L308)

### `ExhibitsIndex` Page

The index page renders all exhibits in a responsive grid (1–3 columns), each as a clickable card linking to `/exhibits/{slug}`. It applies `AuroraBackground` and uses `useSEO(PAGE_SEO.exhibits)` [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#8-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L8-L9)

Each card displays the `glyph`, `tribunalRole`, `title`, `tagline`, and `billyPreviewPrompt` from the exhibit definition [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#44-71](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L44-L71)

Sources: [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#1-77](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L1-L77)

### Exhibit Components

#### `BabylonScrollArtifact`

An SVG-based visual artifact renderer. Maps tribunal roles to geometric shapes via `ROLE_SHAPES` (pentagon for The Architect, circle for The Mirror, rectangle for The Guardian, pentagon for The Weaver, triangle for The Witness). Includes SVG `<animate>` elements that pulse faster when `isPlaying` is true [client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#7-13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#L7-L13)

Sources: [client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#1-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BabylonScrollArtifact.tsx#L1-L46)

#### `BillyExhibitChat`

The scoped Billy chat panel that appears as a fixed overlay for exhibit pages. Key behaviors:

1. Context binding: On mount, calls `setActiveExhibit()` to bind the exhibit to the global `BillyEngine` context; cleans up via `clearActiveExhibit()` on unmount [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#109-119](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L109-L119)
2. Prompt augmentation: `buildPrompt()` injects PLK preservation instructions, live bridge context, and bridge payload into the user message [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#44-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L44-L64)
3. API call: Uses `callBillyApi()` with the exhibit ID, `"synthesis"` intent, and selected `embodimentProfileSlug` [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#172-178](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L172-L178)
4. Streaming: `streamText()` simulates character-by-character rendering at 14ms intervals [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#66-77](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L66-L77)
5. Never Look Away: When `neverLookAway` is true, displays crisis resources (988 hotline, emergency services, trusted person outreach) [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#30-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L30-L34)
6. Embodiment selector: Allows switching the DI persona via `EmbodimentSelector` [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#260-268](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L260-L268)
7. Persistence: Expanded/collapsed state is persisted to `localStorage` per exhibit [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#94-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L94-L98)

Sources: [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#1-332](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyExhibitChat.tsx#L1-L332)

#### `ScrollReader`

An audio-synchronized word-highlighting reader. Takes `audioUrl`, `timestamps` (array of `WordTimestamp` with `word`, `start`, `end`), and synchronizes word highlighting with audio playback. Active words glow with the exhibit's `colorHex`, past words dim, and the component auto-scrolls to keep the active word in view [client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#65-77](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#L65-L77)

Sources: [client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#1-141](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ScrollReader.tsx#L1-L141)

#### `ExhibitDemos`

A slug-based demo router. `CONTEXT_BY_EXHIBIT` maps exhibit slugs to `BillyDemoContextDescriptor` arrays (focus lenses for Billy). The component renders exhibit-specific demo UIs:

- `SymbioCoderDemo` — mock chat with architecture/ship-slice responses [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#156-218](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L156-L218)
- `VibeCoderDemo` — lane cards for concept/constraint/build/feedback [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#220-239](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L220-L239)
- `ADHDPowerUpDemo` — lightning-bolt thought capture form [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#241-282](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L241-L282)
- `RecoverySupportDemo` — grounding steps with Never Look Away resources (used for both `addiction-recovery` and `alzheimers-legacy`) [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#284-309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L284-L309)
- `AICollabMapDemo` — tribunal node visualization [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#311-330](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L311-L330)
- `CreationCornerDemo` — seed capture and loom output [client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#332-361](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/ExhibitDemos.tsx#L332-L361)
