#### `BillyMusicInterview`

Captures Musical DNA through an interview form. Users can add up to 6 tracks with title, artist, and body-memory context. Also supports PLK fragment quick capture with auto-parsing of `"Title - Artist"` lines via `parseSongsFromFragments()` [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyMusicInterview.tsx#61-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyMusicInterview.tsx#L61-L67) On submit, produces a `BillyMusicInterviewResult` with `songs`, `summary`, and `plkFragments` [client/src/components/exhibits/BillyMusicInterview.tsx#96-116](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/exhibits/BillyMusicInterview.tsx#L96-L116)

## Product Modules (`modules/`)

Three self-contained product applications live under `client/src/modules/`, each following an identical internal architecture:

```
modules/{Module_Name}/


├── index.tsx          # Re-exports pages/Main as default


├── components/        # Module-specific UI components


├── lib/


│   ├── types.ts       # TypeScript interfaces


│   └── prompts.ts     # LLM prompt templates


├── pages/


│   └── Main.tsx       # Main page component


└── store/


└── {name}Store.ts # Zustand store with persist middleware
```

### Module Architecture Diagram

Sources: [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/index.tsx#1-3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/index.tsx#L1-L3) [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/index.tsx#1-3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/index.tsx#L1-L3) [client/src/modules/Vibe\_Coder/index.tsx#1-3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Vibe_Coder/index.tsx#L1-L3)

### Resume Rockstar

Purpose: AI-powered resume builder with section editing, template selection, live preview, and export.

Store (`useResumeStore`): Zustand with `persist` middleware, storing to localStorage key `gv-resume-rockstar`. State includes a `Resume` object (with `resumeId`, `title`, `sections[]`, `lastModified`), `selectedTemplate`, and `isSaving` flag. Actions: `addSection`, `updateSection`, `removeSection`, `setTitle`, `setSelectedTemplate`, `saveResume` (POSTs to `/api/modules/resume-rockstar/save`), `resetResume` [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#8-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#L8-L88)

Types: `ResumeSection` supports 6 types: `objective`, `experience`, `skills`, `education`, `certifications`, `projects`. Export formats: `pdf`, `markdown`, `json` [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/lib/types.ts#4-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/lib/types.ts#L4-L8)

Prompts: `RESUME_PROMPTS` provides 4 LLM prompt templates — `improveObjective`, `enhanceExperience`, `suggestSkills`, `reviewResume`. The `RESUME_SYSTEM_PROMPT` establishes a career coach persona [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/lib/prompts.ts#4-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/lib/prompts.ts#L4-L19)

Layout: Three-column grid — `TemplateSelector` + `SectionEditor` on the left (2 columns), `SectionPreview` on the right (1 column) [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/pages/Main.tsx#25-43](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/pages/Main.tsx#L25-L43)

Sources: [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#1-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#L1-L88) [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/lib/types.ts#1-48](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/lib/types.ts#L1-L48) [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/lib/prompts.ts#1-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/lib/prompts.ts#L1-L19) [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/pages/Main.tsx#1-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/pages/Main.tsx#L1-L46)

### Symbio Coder

Purpose: AI code assistant with collaborative editing, chat sidebar, and suggestion panel.

Store (`useCoderStore`): Persists to `gv-symbio-coder`. State: `code` (string), `language` (default `typescript`), `sessionId` (nanoid). Supported languages: typescript, javascript, python, sql, bash, json [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#1-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#L1-L28)

Types: `CodeAnalysis` (complexity, patterns, issues), `SuggestionRequest` (3 types: `explain`, `optimize`, `refactor`), `ChatRequest`/`ChatResponse` [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/lib/types.ts#1-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/lib/types.ts#L1-L44)

Layout: Full-height flex layout — `CodeEditor` + `SuggestionPanel` stacked vertically on the left, collapsible `ChatSidebar` (280px width) on the right [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#39-52](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#L39-L52)

Sources: [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#1-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#L1-L28) [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/lib/types.ts#1-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/lib/types.ts#L1-L44) [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#1-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#L1-L55)

### Vibe Coder

Purpose: Musical DNA analysis — transforms song input into emotion profiles and creative signatures.

Store (`useVibeStore`): Persists to `gv-vibe-coder`. `analyzeVibe(song, artist)` POSTs to `/api/modules/vibe-coder/analyze` and stores the resulting `VibeProfile` [client/src/modules/Vibe\_Coder/store/vibeStore.ts#20-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Vibe_Coder/store/vibeStore.ts#L20-L31)

Types: `VibeProfile` contains `emotionScores` (energy, joy, melancholy, tension, serenity), `personalityDimensions[]`, `coreNarrative`, and `creativeSignature` [client/src/modules/Vibe\_Coder/lib/types.ts#4-20](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Vibe_Coder/lib/types.ts#L4-L20)

Layout: Two-column grid — `MusicInput` + `CreativeSuggestions` on the left, `VibeAnalysisCard` on the right. When a vibe profile exists, `NeuralAuroraVisualization` renders a visual background [client/src/modules/Vibe\_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#21-44](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Vibe_Coder/pages/Main.tsx#L21-L44)

## Features Directory (`features/`)

### Agent Trainer (`features/agent-trainer/`)

The Agent Trainer is a founder-only control plane for experiment-based agent training runs with governance gates, embodiment compilation, and packaging.

#### Component Structure

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `AgentTrainerPage.tsx` | Main page — 700+ line founder control surface |
| `EmbodimentCompilerPanel.tsx` | Compiles embodiment profiles from study sources |
| `ExperimentForm.tsx` | Creates/edits training experiments |
| `ExperimentRegistry.tsx` | Lists and manages experiments |
| `PackagingGatePanel.tsx` | Packages approved experiments into distributable kits |
| `PolicyFlagBadge.tsx` | Displays policy flag badges (blocking/warning/resolved) |
| `ReviewQueuePanel.tsx` | Admin review queue for training runs |

#### Access Control

Access is restricted to founder emails via `hasFounderTrainerAccess()`, which checks against `VITE_FOUNDER_ADMIN_EMAILS` env var or defaults to `["keithsoyka@gmail.com"]` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#280-294](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L280-L294)

#### Training Run Lifecycle

The trainer defines a 4-stage pipeline (`TrainerStage`): `collect` → `compile` → `synthesize` → `export` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#113-145](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L113-L145)

Run statuses progress through: `queued` → `running` → `evaluating` → `approved` → `stored` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#241-272](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L241-L272)

Progress is computed via weighted stage scores in `STAGE_WEIGHTS`: normalize (5), curriculum (10), scenario\_expand (15), author (25), evaluate (25), critique (12), safety (8), package (10) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#155-164](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L155-L164)

#### Hooks

`useTrainingRun`: Manages the full training run lifecycle — agents, scenario sets, study sources, personhood snapshots, queue health, and run CRUD. Polls active runs every 4 seconds via `setInterval` when run status is in `POLLABLE_STATUSES` (`queued`, `running`, `awaiting_review`). Provides actions: `submitRun`, `approveRun`, `rejectRun`, `deployRun`, `runNow`, `cancelRun`, `purgeRun`, `retryJob` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#116-582](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L116-L582)

`useTrainerGovernance`: Manages experiments and packaging candidates. Loads experiment lists and packaging candidates in parallel, provides mutation helpers: `createExperiment`, `updateExperiment`, `attachSource`, `createReview`, `createFlag`, `resolveFlag`, `nominatePackaging`, `updatePackagingCandidate`, `uploadPackagingAttachment` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#34-251](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#L34-L251)

Sources: [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#113-165](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L113-L165) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#575-669](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L575-L669) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#116-582](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L116-L582) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#34-251](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#L34-L251)

#### Packaging Gate

`PackagingGatePanel` enforces DI-4 ("no living DI export") via `boundaryStatement` — a required text field that must explicitly state what is NOT transferred. Three presets:

| Preset | Package Kind | Export Intent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `operator-kit` | `operator_kit` | `bundle_for_customer_delivery` |
| `companion-kit` | `companion_kit` | `review_first_runtime_bundle` |
| `governance-kit` | `governance_kit` | `policy_and_review_bundle` |

Each preset includes a boundary statement like: *"This kit provides reproducible operator-training assets... It does not transfer a persistent agent identity, private memory graph, founder continuity state, or any living digital intelligence."* [client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#32-71](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#L32-L71)

Only experiments with `class === "approved_training_kit"` and `unresolvedBlockingFlagCount === 0` are eligible for packaging [client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#155-162](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#L155-L162)

Sources: [client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#32-71](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#L32-L71) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#115-337](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/PackagingGatePanel.tsx#L115-L337)

#### Policy Flags

`PolicyFlagBadge` renders severity-based badges for `TrainerPolicyFlag`: blocking (rose), warning (amber), resolved (emerald). Each badge shows a `ShieldAlert` or `AlertTriangle` icon [client/src/features/agent-trainer/PolicyFlagBadge.tsx#8-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/PolicyFlagBadge.tsx#L8-L31)

### Dynamic Inner World (`features/dynamic-inner-world/`)

The Dynamic Inner World is the "Museum of You" — a spatial artifact gallery where finished artifacts from Creation Corner are displayed and navigated.

#### World Plan Builder

`buildWorldPlan()` is a deterministic, client-side planner that converts artifacts into a spatial layout. It takes `BuildWorldPlanInput` (artifacts, archived artifacts, selected artifact ID, resonance links, search query, filters) and returns a `WorldPlan` [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#56-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L56-L191)

Render modes are determined by artifact count via `getMode()`:

- `museum` — ≤8 artifacts, tight radius (190 + hash offset)
- `constellation` — 9–40 artifacts, medium radius (260 + hash offset)
- `archive` — >40 artifacts, wide radius (330 + hash offset), scaled to 0.86

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#44-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L44-L54)

Positioning: `positionForArtifact()` uses a hash-based radial layout. Each artifact gets `x`/`z` coordinates from `cos(angle)` and `sin(angle)` multiplied by a mode-dependent radius, with a `y` jitter from the hash [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#14-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L14-L26)

Atmosphere accent is chosen by filter state: `gold` for archive/memory/journal tags, `purple` for images, `emerald` for code, `cyan` default [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#28-42](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L28-L42)

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#1-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L1-L191) [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#1-101](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#L1-L101)

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#12-35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#L12-L35)

### Masterclass (`features/masterclass/`)

The Masterclass feature provides guided sessions with DI embodiment profiles.

#### `MasterclassProfileCard`

Renders a single `EmbodimentProfile` as an expandable card. Displays `slug`, `publicName`, `archetype`, and `sessionCount`. On expand, reveals `foundationalTruth` (as a blockquote) and `voiceTone`. Includes a "Begin session with {publicName}" launch button [client/src/features/masterclass/MasterclassProfileCard.tsx#15-96](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/masterclass/MasterclassProfileCard.tsx#L15-L96)

#### `useMasterclassProgress`

Fetches `masterclass_progress` rows from Supabase, returning a `ProgressMap` of `embodiment_slug → { session_count, last_session_at }`. The `recordSession(slug)` method calls Supabase RPC `upsert_masterclass_session` to increment the session counter [client/src/features/masterclass/useMasterclassProgress.ts#66-128](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/masterclass/useMasterclassProgress.ts#L66-L128)

Sources: [client/src/features/masterclass/MasterclassProfileCard.tsx#1-96](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/masterclass/MasterclassProfileCard.tsx#L1-L96) [client/src/features/masterclass/useMasterclassProgress.ts#1-128](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/masterclass/useMasterclassProgress.ts#L1-L128)

### Workbook (`features/workbook/`)

The Workbook feature is an operational spreadsheet-style governance surface for tracking roadmap items, claims, and evidence.

#### `WorkbookSyncPanel`

Manages workbook data across 5 sheets: `Roadmap`, `Products_vs_Proof`, `Claim_Ledger`, `Evidence_Index`, `Status_Dashboard` [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#20-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L20-L26)

Key capabilities:

- CSV/JSON import: `parseCsvRows()` implements a full RFC-compliant CSV parser with quoted field support [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#28-83](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L28-L83)
- CSV export: `itemToCsvRow()` serializes `OpsWorkbookItem` to CSV format [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#96-113](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L96-L113)
- Filtering: By sheet, status, priority, and phase [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#118-129](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L118-L129)
- API integration: Uses `listWorkbookItems`, `listWorkbookSyncRuns`, `updateWorkbookItem`, `upsertWorkbookItems` from `workbookApi` [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#13-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L13-L17)

#### `WorkbookTable`

Editable table component using shadcn/ui `Table` primitives. Each `OpsWorkbookItem` row is rendered with inline `Input` and `Textarea` controls for label, status, priority, phase, notes, and link. Local edit drafts are maintained in component state, and individual rows can be saved independently [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookTable.tsx#11-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookTable.tsx#L11-L182)

Sources: [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#20-83](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L20-L83) [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#115-229](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookSyncPanel.tsx#L115-L229) [client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookTable.tsx#11-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/workbook/WorkbookTable.tsx#L11-L182)

## Cross-Cutting Patterns

### Billy Section Binding

Every room page calls `useBillySection(sectionName)` to inform Billy which room the user occupies. This drives context-aware Billy responses:

- `Home.tsx` → `useBillySection("home")` [client/src/pages/Home.tsx#35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/Home.tsx#L35-L35)
- `SanctuaryPage.tsx` → `useBillySection("sanctuary")` [client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#32](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#L32-L32)

### SEO Hooks

Pages use `useSEO(PAGE_SEO.{page})` for meta tag management:

- `ExhibitsIndex` → `useSEO(PAGE_SEO.exhibits)` [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L9-L9)
- `SanctuaryPage` → `useSEO(PAGE_SEO.sanctuary)` [client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#L31-L31)

### Room-Specific Atmospheres

Each room owns its visual atmosphere rather than sharing a generic Babylon.js scene. The Sanctuary uses `WillowTreeOverlay` + `FloatingEmbers` + `FogOverlay` [client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#37-39](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/SanctuaryPage.tsx#L37-L39); Home uses `FogOverlay` + `FloatingEmbers` [client/src/pages/Home.tsx#53-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/Home.tsx#L53-L54); the Exhibits Index uses `AuroraBackground` [client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#14-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/ExhibitsIndex.tsx#L14-L19)

### Zustand Persistence Pattern

All three product modules use identical Zustand patterns:

```
create<StoreState>()(


persist(


(set, get) => ({ ... }),


{ name: 'gv-{module-name}' }


)


)
```

localStorage keys: `gv-resume-rockstar` [client/src/modules/Resume\_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#86](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Resume_Rockstar/store/resumeStore.ts#L86-L86) `gv-symbio-coder` [client/src/modules/Symbio\_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Symbio_Coder/store/coderStore.ts#L27-L27) `gv-vibe-coder` [client/src/modules/Vibe\_Coder/store/vibeStore.ts#39](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/modules/Vibe_Coder/store/vibeStore.ts#L39-L39)

**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)

This page documents the 24 custom React hooks in `client/src/hooks/` and the full `client/src/lib/` client-side library layer. Together these modules form the data-fetching, state management, audio/biofeedback, DI presence, and API integration surface of GestaltView's frontend.

### useSession — Tier & Feature Gating

`useSession` is the primary entitlements hook. It fetches session state from `/api/session/state` via `appFetchJson` on mount and exposes a `SessionState` with the user's `UserTier` (one of `anonymous | free | core | pro | enterprise`), query budget (`queryCount`, `queryLimit`, `remaining`), and a derived `TierFeatures` map.

[client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#4-16](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L4-L16) defines `UserTier` and `SessionState`. [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#18-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L18-L56) defines `TierFeatures` with the static `TIER_FEATURES` lookup table:

| Feature | anonymous | free | core | pro | enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billyUnlimited` | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `claudeAccess` | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `plkMemory` | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `domainLanes` | 0 | 1 | 2 | all | all |
| `diligenceExports` | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `symbioCoderAccess` | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `adhdFullAccess` | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `resumeRockstarAccess` | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `collaboratorEngineAccess` | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |

The hook fails open — if the session fetch fails, it sets `degraded: true` and defaults to `anonymous` so the user is never blocked by a session error. [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#84-94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L84-L94)

`decrementRemaining()` is called by Billy and other gated components after each query. [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#102-113](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L102-L113)

Sources: [client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#1-139](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts#L1-L139)

### useLLMRouter — Multi-Provider Proxy

`useLLMRouter` provides client-side LLM routing by resolving the first available provider from `VITE_*` environment variables. The provider cascade is: Google → Groq → HuggingFace → OpenRouter → OpenAI, checked by `resolveProvider()`. [client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#28-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#L28-L51)

All calls go through `/api/llm-proxy` as a server-side proxy. The `route()` function returns `{ text, provider, free, tokensUsed, timestamp }`. [client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#53-94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#L53-L94)

| Priority | Provider | Default Model |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `google` | `gemini-2.0-flash` |
| 2 | `groq` | `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` |
| 3 | `huggingface` | `Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3` |
| 4 | `openrouter` | `google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free` |
| 5 | `openai` | `gpt-4o-mini` |

Additionally, the lib layer re-exports the server-side `routeLlm`, `embedQuery`, and `routerStatus` from the API `_lib/llmRouter` via `client/src/lib/llmrouter.ts`. [client/src/lib/llmrouter.ts#1-5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/llmrouter.ts#L1-L5)

Sources: [client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#1-123](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useLLMRouter.ts#L1-L123) [client/src/lib/llmrouter.ts#1-5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/llmrouter.ts#L1-L5)

### useBillyVoice & useBillyVoicePreference — Voice Output

`useBillyVoice` manages Billy's text-to-speech output with two modes configured via `VITE_BILLY_VOICE`:

- `browser`: Uses native `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` with `rate: 0.94`, `pitch: 0.93`. Strips markdown before speaking via `normalizeSpeechText()`. [client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#41-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#L41-L51)
- `elevenlabs`: POSTs text to `/api/voice/billy`, receives an audio blob, creates an `Audio` element for playback. [client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#222-273](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#L222-L273)
- `disabled`: Default; returns an error message. [client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#158-162](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBillyVoice.ts#L158-L162)

`useBillyVoicePreference` is a per-surface toggle stored in localStorage under the key `gv-billy-voice-enabled:{surfaceId}`. Returns `[enabled, setEnabled]` tuple. [client/src/hooks/useBillyVoicePreference.ts#17-49](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBillyVoicePreference.ts#L17-L49)

### useDigitalIntelligence & useActiveDI — DI Presence

`useDigitalIntelligence(space)` resolves a `DIState` for any room/space and manages a conversation thread with the appropriate DI persona. The `SPACE_DI_MAP` maps spaces to embodiment slugs: [client/src/hooks/useDigitalIntelligence.ts#72-108](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useDigitalIntelligence.ts#L72-L108)

| Space | DI Slug | Public Name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sanctuary` | `the-keeper` | The Keeper |
| `creation-corner` | `art-teacher` | The Art Teacher |
| `dynamic-inner-world` | `curator` | The Curator |
| `external-scaffold` | `the-weaver` | The Weaver |
| `blackboard` | `billy` | Billy |
| `agent-trainer` | `the-architect` | The Architect |
| `gate` | `gate-keeper` | Gate Keeper |
| *(fallback)* | `billy` | Billy |

On mount/space change, it POSTs to `/api/billy/exhibit-bridge` to announce the active DI, then injects the DI's greeting as the first message. User messages are sent to `/api/blackboard/respond` with the last 6 messages as context. [client/src/hooks/useDigitalIntelligence.ts#129-211](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useDigitalIntelligence.ts#L129-L211)

`useActiveDI` manages the globally active DI persona via the `gv_active_di` localStorage key. It synchronizes across tabs via the `storage` event and across components via a `gestaltview:active-di-changed` CustomEvent. [client/src/hooks/useActiveDI.ts#5-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useActiveDI.ts#L5-L6) The default persona is always `billy`. [client/src/hooks/useActiveDI.ts#21-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useActiveDI.ts#L21-L31)

### Biofeedback & Audio Hooks

These four hooks form the Musical DNA biofeedback pipeline:

Data Flow: Biofeedback Pipeline

`useBiofeedback` classifies HRV samples into 4 states using rule-based thresholds: stress (HR>90, RMSSD<22), recovery (HR<65, RMSSD>55), flow (HR 65–82, RMSSD>45, rising trend), baseline (everything else). Each state maps to `AudioTargetParams` with suggested BPM, binaural preset, reverb depth, gain, and panning width. [client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#62-95](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#L62-L95) A built-in `simulateHRV()` provides demo data when no wearable is connected. [client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#142-162](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#L142-L162)

`useBinauralBeats` creates a Web Audio graph: two `OscillatorNode`s at `base ± beat/2` Hz routed through a `ChannelMergerNode` (left/right) → `GainNode` → destination. Five presets are defined: [client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#49-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#L49-L85)

| Preset | Beat Freq | Base Freq | Therapeutic Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delta` | 2 Hz | 100 Hz | Deep rest, trauma integration |
| `theta` | 6 Hz | 200 Hz | Stress reduction, creative insight |
| `alpha` | 10 Hz | 200 Hz | Calm productivity, baseline |
| `beta` | 20 Hz | 220 Hz | Concentration, engagement |
| `gamma` | 40 Hz | 240 Hz | Information integration |

The `STATE_TO_PRESET` map connects biofeedback states to presets: stress→theta, baseline→alpha, flow→alpha, recovery→delta. [client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#89-94](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#L89-L94)

`useEntrainmentPhase` tracks elapsed time since binaural onset and computes a visual `strength` parameter (0→1) through four phases: idle → initializing (0–3 min, strength 0→0.15) → entraining (3–7 min, strength 0.3→0.85) → entrained (7+ min, oscillating at 0.85±0.15). [client/src/hooks/useEntrainmentPhase.ts#59-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useEntrainmentPhase.ts#L59-L91)

`useEmbers` renders a canvas-based particle system of 60 floating embers. Particle color hue is driven by consciousness state (Focused=195/cyan, Relaxed=30/amber, Overwhelmed=random, Hyperfocus=185). Speed and radius modulate from audio frequency data. [client/src/hooks/useEmbers.ts#19-52](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useEmbers.ts#L19-L52)

Sources: [client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#1-252](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBiofeedback.ts#L1-L252) [client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#1-280](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBinauralBeats.ts#L1-L280) [client/src/hooks/useEntrainmentPhase.ts#1-115](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useEntrainmentPhase.ts#L1-L115) [client/src/hooks/useEmbers.ts#1-167](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useEmbers.ts#L1-L167)

### Other Hooks

`useSEO` sets `document.title`, description, canonical URL, Open Graph, and Twitter Card meta tags. Creates a visually-hidden `<h1>` element (id `gv-seo-h1`). Restores previous values on cleanup. A companion `PAGE_SEO` record provides pre-defined SEO data for 40+ routes. [client/src/hooks/useSEO.ts#41-91](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useSEO.ts#L41-L91)

`useBillyRuntimeReadiness` calls `verifyBillyRuntimeGuide()` which checks that the runtime's workflow spine, explanation sections, greeting lines, abilities, and tour steps all have the expected structure. The result is cached in localStorage under `gv_billy_runtime_guide_verified.v1`. [client/src/hooks/useBillyRuntimeReadiness.ts#4-29](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useBillyRuntimeReadiness.ts#L4-L29) [client/src/lib/billy-runtime-guide.ts#80-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billy-runtime-guide.ts#L80-L98)

`useConsciousnessAPI` provides a generic `callConsciousnessAPI(params)` that POSTs to `/api/consciousness/{surface}` for any exhibit chat surface (ADHD, recovery, memory-care, etc.). [client/src/hooks/useConsciousnessAPI.ts#30-87](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useConsciousnessAPI.ts#L30-L87)

`useRouteEmbodiment` watches the current `wouter` location and fetches the matching `EmbodimentProfile` from `/api/embodiments/by-route?path=...`. [client/src/hooks/useRouteEmbodiment.ts#19-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useRouteEmbodiment.ts#L19-L41)

`useComposition` guards IME composition events (CJK input) — blocks Enter/Esc key propagation during `compositionstart`/`compositionend` to prevent accidental form submission. Uses a two-layer `setTimeout` for Safari compatibility. [client/src/hooks/useComposition.ts#23-81](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useComposition.ts#L23-L81)

`useVoiceChat` wraps the Web Speech API with audio level visualization via `AnalyserNode`. It provides `start`, `stop`, `toggle` controls and reports `audioLevel` (0–1) from microphone frequency data for visual feedback. [client/src/hooks/useVoiceChat.ts#41-244](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useVoiceChat.ts#L41-L244)

## Client Libraries (`lib/`)

### appFetch — Typed Fetch with Retry & Error Classification

`appFetchJson<T>()` is the central HTTP client used by nearly every hook and lib module. It wraps `fetch` with:

- Typed discriminated union result: `AppFetchResult<T>` is either `{ ok: true, data: T, status }` or `{ ok: false, code, message, retryable, status }` [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#10-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L10-L26)
- Error classification via `classifyHttpFailure()`: categorizes failures into 7 codes — `timeout`, `network`, `supabase_paused`, `supabase_unavailable`, `upstream_5xx`, `auth_unavailable`, `unknown` [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L1-L8) [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#48-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L48-L55)
- Configurable timeout (default 8s) via `AbortController` [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#35-36](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L35-L36)
- Exponential backoff retries with jitter: `baseDelay * 2^attempt + random(0,120)ms`. Retries only on safe methods (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) unless `retryUnsafe: true`. Retryable status codes: `{408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504}` [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#37-38](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L37-L38) [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#87-90](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L87-L90)
- Credentials always included (`credentials: "include"` default) [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#119](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L119-L119)

Sources: [client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#1-184](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/appFetch.ts#L1-L184)

### BillyEngine — ManifestIndex, ContextWeaver, KnowledgeLoom

`BillyEngine.ts` is the client-side knowledge synthesis engine that runs entirely in the browser. It is a TypeScript port of three Python systems: ManifestIndex, ContextWeaver, and KnowledgeLoom. [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#1-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L1-L31)

Architecture Components:

ManifestIndex: A static in-memory knowledge graph of ~25 `ManifestNode` objects. Each node has a `type` (claim|moat|product|protocol|concept), `title`, `description`, `evidence[]`, `related_ids[]`, `section_anchor`, and `keywords[]`. [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#80-89](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L80-L89) [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#126-472](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L126-L472)

ContextWeaver (`buildWeavePlan()`): Parses a query into a `WeavePlan` with:

- Intent classification via regex: build, debug, compare, summarize, plan, learn, general [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#493-502](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L493-L502)
- 5W1H extraction: who, what, where, when, why, how [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#58-65](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L58-L65)
- Layered expansions: iteration, emergence, significance, ripples — templated per intent [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#521-570](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L521-L570)
- Multi-query retrieval set for RRF scoring

KnowledgeLoom: Performs keyword-based RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) retrieval across the Manifest. Each `retrieval_query` in the WeavePlan is scored against ManifestNodes; results are merged using RRF scoring to produce ranked `LoomResult[]`.

The engine imports `buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt` from `@shared/billy/runtime` and `BILLY_CORE_IDENTITY_PROMPT` from `@shared/embodiment` to construct system prompts. [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#34-35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L34-L35)

Sources: [client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#1-572](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/BillyEngine.ts#L1-L572)

### billyApi — Server Communication with Fallback

`billyApi.ts` is the primary Billy API client. It provides two main functions:

`bootstrapBillySession()`: Initializes a Billy session via `POST /api/billy` with `{ bootstrap: true }`. Falls back to a `local-continuity-cache` from the last known good metadata stored in localStorage under `gestaltview:billy:last-good-continuity:v1`. [client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#191-241](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#L191-L241)

`callBillyApi()`: Sends messages to `POST /api/billy`. On server failure, it falls back to `legacyBillyCall` from `BillyEngine.ts` — the client-side knowledge synthesis engine. Recovery metadata tracks which path was used (`clientRecovery: "legacy-provider" | "local-fallback" | "none"`). [client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#243-309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#L243-L309)

The `BillySessionMetadata` interface carries rich diagnostics: `conversationMode`, `embodimentProfileSlug`, `roomSlug`, `founderSessionActive`, `retrievalMode`, `memorySources`, `serverProvider`, `clientRecovery`, `embedBackend`, `gravity` (Two-Pass Gravity per-turn data), `symbioCoder`, and `vibeCoder` metadata. [client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#17-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#L17-L61)

A `SECTION_TO_ROOM_SLUG` map normalizes section identifiers to canonical room slugs (e.g., `"whiteboard-room" → "blackboard-room"`). [client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#98-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#L98-L109)

Sources: [client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#1-310](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/billyApi.ts#L1-L310)

### personaManager & PersonaATC

`personaManager.ts` provides room→persona resolution with localStorage caching. `getRoomPersona(roomBinding)` checks a local cache (`gv-room-persona-cache-v1`) before falling back to `getPersonaForRoom()` from the personas data layer. `getPersonaPrompt()` delegates to `buildBillyRuntimeSystemPrompt()` from `@shared/billy/runtime`. [client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#L1-L51)

`PersonaATC.ts` (Persona Air Traffic Controller) is a character-level circuit breaker for council/tribunal responses. It asks: "Did the CHARACTER actually show up in that response?" [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#8-10](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L8-L10)

Key mechanisms:

- `isCannedResponse(text)`: Detects generic LLM bleed-through via 20+ phrases (e.g., "as an ai language model", "i'm here to help") and a minimum length floor of 80 chars. [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#53-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L53-L88)
- Health tracking: Counts consecutive canned responses per persona slug. After 2 failures (`PERSONA_FAILURE_THRESHOLD`), triggers a reseed. Auto-resets after 2 minutes. [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#46-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L46-L47) [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#102-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L102-L109)
- `buildHardenedReseed(slug)`: Constructs a `██ PERSONA RESEED ██` block that re-injects the full `immutableCore` identity (foundational truth, neverDoes list, voice signature) to force the LLM back into character. [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#152-190](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L152-L190)
- `runPreFlight(slug, responseText)`: Post-response check that records success/failure and returns a reseed prompt when needed. [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#209-236](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L209-L236)

Sources: [client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#1-51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/personaManager.ts#L1-L51) [client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#1-237](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/PersonaATC.ts#L1-L237)

### profilePipeline/ — Capture → Scaffold → Artifact → Inner World

The `profilePipeline/` directory implements the core data lifecycle: capture → scaffold → artifact with provenance tracking.

Data Lifecycle: profilePipeline

Types (`profilePipeline/types.ts`):

- `ProfilePipelineRoom`: 8 rooms — sanctuary through digital-intelligence-academy [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#6-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L6-L14)
- `CapturePreservationStatus`: `private | released | dormant | deleted_by_user` [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L17-L17)
- `ConsentTier`: 7 tiers from `private_default` → `public_allowed` [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#20-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L20-L27)
- `ProvenanceEnvelope`: contentHash (SHA-256), canonicalization method, source IDs, privacy class, consent state [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#55-68](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L55-L68)
- `ProfilePipelineStore`: interface for save/get/update operations on captures, scaffold nodes, artifacts, and identity claims [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#123-142](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L123-L142)

Client (`profilePipeline/client.ts`):

- `createInMemoryProfilePipelineStore()`: In-memory Map-based store implementing `ProfilePipelineStore`. Publishes events via `gestaltEventBus`. Enforces rules: deletion requires `explicitUserAction`, Billy cannot be a scaffold node, identity claims require evidence before approval. [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#16-98](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#L16-L98)
- `recordCapture()`: Creates a capture with `private` preservation status [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#102-136](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#L102-L136)
- `releaseCaptureToScaffold()`: Promotes capture to scaffold with `pending` review state [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#138-179](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#L138-L179)
- `createArtifact()`: Creates artifact with SHA-256 provenance envelope [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#243-287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#L243-L287)

Provenance (`profilePipeline/provenance.ts`): `buildProvenanceEnvelope()` computes a SHA-256 hash of stable-JSON-serialized content using `crypto.subtle.digest` with FNV-1a fallback. [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/provenance.ts#1-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/provenance.ts#L1-L64)

Sources: [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#1-142](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/types.ts#L1-L142) [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#1-340](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/client.ts#L1-L340) [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/provenance.ts#1-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/provenance.ts#L1-L64)

### genEngineClient — Gen-Engine with Local Fallback

`genEngineClient.ts` wraps every gen-engine API call with automatic local fallback. If the server endpoint is unreachable, the client executes the equivalent function from `@shared/gen-engine/index` locally and appends a warning.

| Function | API Endpoint | Local Fallback |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getGenEngineHealth()` | `GET /api/gen-engine/health` | `buildGenEngineHealthLocal()` |
| `createCaptureSignal()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/fusion` | `createCaptureSignalLocal()` |
| `scoreResonance()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/resonance` | `scoreResonanceLocalFallback()` |
| `createArtifact()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/artifacts` | `createArtifactLocal()` |
| `scanAmbientCoherence()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/ambient-scan` | `scanAmbientCoherenceLocal()` |
| `learnWithGenEngine()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/learn` | `buildLearnResponseLocal()` |
| `predictNextMove()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/predict` | `buildPredictionFromRequestLocal()` |
| `lightUpCapture()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/lightning` | `buildLightningResponseLocal()` |
| `exportArtifact()` | *(local only)* | `exportArtifactLocal()` |

All remote calls use `appFetchJson` with 12s timeout and 0 retries. [client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#50-58](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#L50-L58)

### events/gestaltEventBus — Typed Event System

`GestaltEventBus` is a publish-subscribe event bus for `GestaltEvent` objects from `@shared/events/gestaltEvents`. It supports typed subscriptions by `GestaltEventType` or a wildcard `"*"` for all events. [client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#6-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#L6-L18)

On `publish()`, the bus:

1. Notifies type-specific handlers
2. Notifies wildcard handlers
3. Dispatches a `gestalt:event` `CustomEvent` on `window` for cross-framework interop [client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#20-32](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#L20-L32)

A singleton `gestaltEventBus` is exported for global use. The `profilePipeline/events.ts` re-exports this bus for pipeline integration. [client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/events/gestaltEventBus.ts#L35-L35) [client/src/lib/profilePipeline/events.ts#1](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/profilePipeline/events.ts#L1-L1)

### Spotify Integration

`spotify.ts` implements a full Spotify OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow for the Musical DNA module:

1. `beginSpotifyAuthFlow()`: Generates code verifier + challenge, writes transaction to `sessionStorage`, redirects to `accounts.spotify.com/authorize` with scopes `user-read-private`, `playlist-read-private`, `playlist-read-collaborative`. [client/src/lib/spotify.ts#220-236](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/spotify.ts#L220-L236)
2. `completeSpotifyAuthFlow(search)`: Validates state parameter, exchanges code for tokens via `accounts.spotify.com/api/token`, stores auth in localStorage under `gv_spotify_auth`. [client/src/lib/spotify.ts#348-374](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/spotify.ts#L348-L374)

# Backend Architecture

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/references/api-reference.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/references/api-reference.md?plain=1)

GestaltView's backend is a dual-runtime system: a TypeScript/Vercel serverless API layer (`api/`) handling HTTP routes and LLM orchestration, and a Python/FastAPI generative engine (`server/`) implementing the consciousness-processing brain. An Express static server (`server/index.ts`) bridges the two by serving the Vite-built SPA in production. All three runtimes share Supabase (PostgreSQL + pgvector) as the single persistence layer.

Dual-Runtime Architecture Diagram

Sources: [server/index.ts#1-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L1-L67) [api/billy.ts#1-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/billy.ts#L1-L14) [server/gestaltview\_generative\_engine.py#1-24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gestaltview_generative_engine.py#L1-L24) [server/core/brain.py#1-15](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/core/brain.py#L1-L15)

## Express Static Server

The Express server in `server/index.ts` serves as the production SPA host. It initializes Sentry via `initNodeSentry()` with runtime tag `"express-static-server"` [server/index.ts#13-15](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L13-L15) serves static files from the Vite build output (`dist/public` in dev, `public` in production) [server/index.ts#22-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L22-L27) and implements a catch-all `app.get("*")` handler that returns `index.html` for client-side routing [server/index.ts#47-49](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L47-L49) Sentry error handling is attached via `Sentry.setupExpressErrorHandler(app)` [server/index.ts#51](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L51-L51) with a fallback error handler for uncaught exceptions [server/index.ts#53-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L53-L56) The server listens on `process.env.PORT` or defaults to port 3000 [server/index.ts#60-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L60-L64)

Sources: [server/index.ts#1-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/index.ts#L1-L67)

## Middleware-as-Composable-Helpers Pattern

Because GestaltView uses Vite + Vercel serverless functions (not Next.js), there is no framework-level middleware pipeline. Instead, cross-cutting concerns are implemented as composable helper functions in `api/_lib/` that each route imports and calls explicitly. This pattern was adopted after Vercel attempted to compile a root-level `middleware.ts` as a Next.js Edge Function [api/\_lib/requestGuard.ts#1-7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/requestGuard.ts#L1-L7)

Middleware Composition Flow

Sources: [api/\_lib/cors.ts#73-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/cors.ts#L73-L85) [api/\_lib/requestGuard.ts#58-63](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/requestGuard.ts#L58-L63) [api/\_lib/auth.ts#368-458](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L368-L458) [api/\_lib/sentry.ts#87-141](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/sentry.ts#L87-L141) [api/\_lib/response.ts#19-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/response.ts#L19-L61)

The five helpers are summarized below:

| Helper | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `applyCorsHeaders()` | `api/_lib/cors.ts` | Sets `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` from `CORS_ORIGINS` env var; reflects request origin if allow-listed [api/\_lib/cors.ts#73-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/cors.ts#L73-L85) |
| `getAuthUser()` | `api/_lib/auth.ts` | Dual-path auth: HMAC-signed cookie (`gv_admin_session`) first, then Supabase JWT Bearer token; returns `AuthUser` with 5-tier system [api/\_lib/auth.ts#368-458](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L368-L458) |
| `isBotUserAgent()` / `checkRateLimit()` | `api/_lib/requestGuard.ts` | Bot detection via 15 UA regex patterns; 2-tier rate limiting (5 req/sec burst, 30 req/min window) [api/\_lib/requestGuard.ts#9-104](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/requestGuard.ts#L9-L104) |
| `checkAndIncrementLimit()` | `api/_lib/rateLimit.ts` | Tier-based query limits persisted in Supabase (anonymous: 2, free: 10, core/pro/enterprise: unlimited) [api/\_lib/rateLimit.ts#24-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/rateLimit.ts#L24-L30) |
| `withSentryVercelHandler()` | `api/_lib/sentry.ts` | Wraps a route in Sentry isolation scope with tracing span; auto-captures 5xx errors [api/\_lib/sentry.ts#87-141](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/sentry.ts#L87-L141) |
| `sendJson()` / `envelope()` | `api/_lib/response.ts` | Standardized JSON response with `ApiEnvelope` shape (`response`, `provider`, `timestamp`, `free`, `tokensUsed`, `processingTime`, `metadata`) [api/\_lib/response.ts#9-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/response.ts#L9-L61) |

## The `api/_lib/` Shared Library

The `api/_lib/` directory is the foundation layer that all serverless routes import. It contains 20+ modules covering auth, data access, LLM routing, embeddings, memory, and observability.

`api/_lib/` Module Map

Sources: [api/\_lib/auth.ts#1-5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L1-L5) [api/\_lib/supabase.ts#1-7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabase.ts#L1-L7) [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#1-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L1-L9) [api/\_lib/memory.ts#1-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/memory.ts#L1-L18) [api/\_lib/embeddings.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/embeddings.ts#L1-L8) [api/\_lib/billyMemoryPipeline.ts#1-3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/billyMemoryPipeline.ts#L1-L3)

Key modules:

- `supabase.ts` — Zero-SDK Supabase REST client with 20+ typed row interfaces (`MatchKnowledgeFragmentRow`, `MatchSkillFragmentRow`, `MemoryEntryRow`, `FounderContextRow`, `GravityReportRow`, etc.) and RPC functions for vector search [api/\_lib/supabase.ts#34-165](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/supabase.ts#L34-L165)
- `llmRouter.ts` — 7-provider LLM cascade (`ollama → groq → huggingface → openrouter → gemini → anthropic → openai`) with free-first ordering, retry on 429, and Braintrust tracing [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#59-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L59-L67)
- `embeddings.ts` — 3-backend embedding system (Gemini `text-embedding-004`, Ollama, HuggingFace) with L2-normalization and configurable dimensions [api/\_lib/embeddings.ts#8-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/embeddings.ts#L8-L67)
- `memory.ts` — 8 memory kinds (`identity`, `preference`, `goal`, `project`, `relationship`, `constraint`, `insight`, `note`) with 3 scopes and auto-capture via regex pattern matching [api/\_lib/memory.ts#20-119](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/memory.ts#L20-L119)

For details, see [Vercel Serverless API Layer](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#4.1) and [LLM Router & Multi-Provider Cascade](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#4.3).

The `api/` directory contains ~245 files organized as Vercel serverless functions. Each `.ts` file maps to an HTTP endpoint. Routes compose the `_lib/` helpers at the top of their handler function — applying CORS, checking auth, validating rate limits — then execute domain logic.

## Python Generative Engine (`server/`)

The Python backend is a FastAPI application in `server/gestaltview_generative_engine.py`, launched via `uvicorn server.gestaltview_generative_engine:app --reload` [server/gestaltview\_generative\_engine.py#4](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gestaltview_generative_engine.py#L4-L4) It exposes 17+ endpoints including `/api/fusion`, `/api/learn`, `/api/predict`, `/api/resonance`, `/api/blackboard/respond`, `/api/creation-corner/synthesize`, and embodiment CRUD [server/gestaltview\_generative\_engine.py#8-23](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gestaltview_generative_engine.py#L8-L23)

The engine's brain lives in `server/core/`, orchestrated by `GestaltViewCore` in `brain.py`. It implements a 9-stage consciousness-processing pipeline [server/core/brain.py#6-14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/core/brain.py#L6-L14):

1. Detect `ConsciousnessState`
2. Init/update `PersonalLanguageKey` via `PLKEngine`
3. Capture `BucketDrop` via `BucketDropsEngine`
4. Measure `ConsciousnessMetrics`
5. Loom processing via `LoomProcessor`
6. Tapestry weaving via `TapestryWeaver`
7. Generate response
8. Tribunal validation via `TribunalValidator`
9. Calculate session impact

`GestaltViewCore` encodes 8 Founder-as-Algorithm patterns — Keith's lived experience as named weights (e.g. `"adhd_jazz"`, `"chaos_current"`, `"consciousness_serving"`, `"cognitive_justice"`) [server/core/brain.py#47-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/core/brain.py#L47-L56) Each sub-engine (`PLKEngine`, `BucketDropsEngine`, `LoomProcessor`, `TapestryWeaver`, `TribunalValidator`) is Supabase-wired and instantiated per user session [server/core/brain.py#58-68](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/core/brain.py#L58-L68)

For complete documentation of the pipeline stages and sub-engines, see [Python Generative Engine & Core Brain](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#4.2).

Sources: [server/gestaltview\_generative\_engine.py#1-68](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gestaltview_generative_engine.py#L1-L68) [server/core/brain.py#1-72](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/core/brain.py#L1-L72)

## LLM Routing & Multi-Provider Cascade

All LLM calls from the TypeScript layer flow through `api/_lib/llmRouter.ts`, which implements a 7-provider cascade ordered free-first: `ollama → groq → huggingface → openrouter → gemini → anthropic → openai` [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#59-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L59-L67) Each provider is gated on environment variable presence via `hasAnyEnv()` [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#79-81](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L79-L81)

The companion embedding system in `api/_lib/embeddings.ts` supports 3 backends — Gemini (`text-embedding-004`), Ollama, and HuggingFace (`google/embeddinggemma-300m`) — all L2-normalized [api/\_lib/embeddings.ts#16-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/embeddings.ts#L16-L17) [api/\_lib/embeddings.ts#53-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/embeddings.ts#L53-L67) All Braintrust tracing is integrated for observability [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L9-L9)

For the full provider configuration, model details, retry logic, and memory system, see [LLM Router & Multi-Provider Cascade](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#4.3).

Sources: [api/\_lib/llmRouter.ts#1-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/llmRouter.ts#L1-L67) [api/\_lib/embeddings.ts#1-67](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/embeddings.ts#L1-L67)

## Authentication Architecture

Authentication uses a dual-path strategy implemented in `api/_lib/auth.ts`:

1. HMAC-signed session cookies (`gv_admin_session`) — the primary path for magic-link login. Payloads are `AdminSessionPayload` objects signed with `SESSION_SECRET` via HMAC-SHA256, encoded as base64url [api/\_lib/auth.ts#153-163](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L153-L163) Cookies are `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure` in production, with a default 14-day TTL [api/\_lib/auth.ts#224-237](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L224-L237)
2. Supabase JWT Bearer tokens — used by council/trainer endpoints. The token is verified against Supabase Auth, then the user's profile is fetched for tier and admin status, with a 60-second in-memory cache [api/\_lib/auth.ts#361-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L361-L457)

The `AuthUser` interface carries 5 tiers: `anonymous | free | core | pro | enterprise` [api/\_lib/auth.ts#13-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L13-L18) Helper functions `requireAuth()`, `requireAdmin()`, and `requireFounderOrAdmin()` provide graduated access control [api/\_lib/auth.ts#465-504](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L465-L504)

Sources: [api/\_lib/auth.ts#1-543](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L1-L543)

## How the Runtimes Connect

End-to-End Request Flow

The TypeScript layer handles all client-facing HTTP, auth, rate limiting, and LLM routing. The Python engine handles deep consciousness processing — PLK analysis, BucketDrop capture, Loom refinement, Tapestry weaving, and Tribunal validation. Some `api/gen-engine/` routes proxy directly to the FastAPI server, while `api/billy.ts` handles its own retrieval and LLM calls independently.
