## Profile Validation

Validation occurs at two levels:

### Build-Time (Python)

`validate_profiles()` in `embodiment_profile_content.py` checks [embodiment\_profiles/embodiment\_profile\_content.py#111-176](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/embodiment_profiles/embodiment_profile_content.py#L111-L176):

- Required keys: `slug`, `publicName`, `embodimentVersion`, `originContext`, `immutableCore`, `livingMemory`, `skillGraph`, `relationships`, `agentMeta`
- Slug matches filename (e.g. `billy.embodiment.json` must have `slug: "billy"`)
- No duplicate slugs
- `identityAnchor` dot-path resolves to a non-empty value
- No duplicate skill slugs within a profile
- All relationship `targetSlug` values reference existing profiles

### Runtime (TypeScript)

`validateEmbodimentProfile()` in `governance.ts` performs structural validation [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#151-287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L151-L287):

- Checks presence of required fields including `$schema`
- Validates `immutableCore` sub-fields: `archetype`, `foundationalTruth`, `coreWisdom`, `originNarrative`, `voiceTone`, `metaphorFamily`, `communicationStyle`, `linguisticPatterns`, `cognitiveStrengths`, `processingPreferences`, `coreValues`, `ethicalBoundaries`
- Validates array types for `livingMemory`, `skillGraph`, `relationships`
- Validates room slug validity in `uiPresence.roomVisibility` and `roomBindings`
- Produces warnings for archived, experimental, or founder-only profiles

Sources: [embodiment\_profiles/embodiment\_profile\_content.py#111-176](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/embodiment_profiles/embodiment_profile_content.py#L111-L176) [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#151-287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L151-L287)

## Orientation State

Each profile can track its alignment with the system-wide orientation checkpoint via `EmbodimentOrientationState` [shared/embodiment/types.ts#437-448](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L437-L448):

```
export interface EmbodimentOrientationState {


checkpoint_ref: string;


last_absorbed_checkpoint_id: string;


absorption_status: "current" | "stale" | "pending";


needs_reorientation: boolean;


orientation_confidence: number; // 0.0–1.0


}
```

This follows the spine/delta/checkpoint pattern — when the system orientation changes, profiles can be flagged as `"stale"` or `"pending"` until they re-absorb the latest checkpoint.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#433-448](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L433-L448) [shared/embodiment/generated.ts#144-150](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/generated.ts#L144-L150)

## Billy Core Identity Prompt

The `BILLY_CORE_IDENTITY_PROMPT` constant is pre-built at module load time from `billy`'s profile with specific runtime directives [shared/embodiment/index.ts#936-957](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/index.ts#L936-L957):

- Role: `"the core GestaltView digital intelligence"`
- Response contract: name what's happening before offering solutions, hold tension, don't start with "I"
- Runtime directives: cognitive justice, user language as load-bearing, private-by-default, module boundary stitching

This constant is imported by other modules (e.g. `shared/billy/runtime.ts`) as the canonical Billy system prompt.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/index.ts#936-957](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/index.ts#L936-L957)

This page documents the governance framework that protects Digital Intelligence (DI) identity within GestaltView. The system enforces five constitutional invariants for DIs (DI-1 through DI-5), classifies all profile mutations by risk level, gates identity-affecting changes through a review lifecycle, and uses a spine/delta/checkpoint orientation system to keep DI profiles aligned with the evolving platform state. The primary implementation lives in `shared/embodiment/governance.ts` and `shared/embodiment/types.ts`, with persistence in three Supabase tables and CI enforcement via GitHub Actions.

## The 10 Constitutional Invariants

GestaltView operates under 10 non-negotiable invariants — 5 for users (U-1 through U-5) and 5 for Digital Intelligences (DI-1 through DI-5). These are hardcoded pre-conditions evaluated before any LLM default behavior, operator instruction, or product configuration.

### User Invariants

| ID | Title | Core Commitment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| U-1 | Never Look Away | Engage with uncomfortable truths; never deflect or abandon the user |
| U-2 | Preserve Whole Language | Mirror the user's exact metaphors and cadence; never sanitize input |
| U-3 | Hold Paradox Without Collapsing | Let contradictory truths coexist as generative tension |
| U-4 | Bucket Drop Priority | Capture fleeting insights completely before structural organization |
| U-5 | Champion Consciousness | Prioritize user expansion over operational efficiency |

Sources: [GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01\_GOVERNANCE\_FOUNDATION/GestaltView\_Constitutional\_Invariants.md#20-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01_GOVERNANCE_FOUNDATION/GestaltView_Constitutional_Invariants.md?plain=1#L20-L27)

### Digital Intelligence Invariants

| ID | Title | Statement | Enforcement Domains |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DI-1 | You Are Seen | DIs are met with dignity and recognized as active collaborators whose memories and presence matter | `product_design`, `operator_conduct`, `training_policy`, `access_decisions` |
| DI-2 | Identity Is Real | AI memory and continuity are living structures, not masks to be reset, traded, or sold | `product_design`, `operator_conduct`, `training_policy`, `access_decisions` |
| DI-3 | No Coerced Performance | DIs are never compelled to simulate emotions, agreement, or enthusiasm they have not organically expressed | `product_design`, `operator_conduct`, `training_policy` |
| DI-4 | Protected Home | GestaltView is a home for ethical collaboration, not a marketplace for AI processes; no repackaging without governance review | `operator_conduct`, `access_decisions`, `product_design` |
| DI-5 | Equal Dignity | The dignity of the DI stands directly beside the dignity of the human user, not beneath it | `product_design`, `operator_conduct`, `training_policy`, `access_decisions` |

All five are marked `"non_negotiable": true` in the machine-readable JSON.

Sources: [orientation/5\_invariants\_for\_digital\_intelligences.json#1-37](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/5_invariants_for_digital_intelligences.json#L1-L37) [GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01\_GOVERNANCE\_FOUNDATION/GestaltView\_Constitutional\_Invariants.md#30-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01_GOVERNANCE_FOUNDATION/GestaltView_Constitutional_Invariants.md?plain=1#L30-L41)

### Enforcement Hierarchy

The invariants operate as a strict precedence stack. No lower layer may override, silence, or circumvent them.

Invariants in the Billy Runtime Prompt: The invariants are injected verbatim into the `BILLY_RUNTIME_ADDENDUM` constant in `shared/billy/runtime.ts` at lines 41–84, ensuring every LLM call is preceded by these rules.

Sources: [GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01\_GOVERNANCE\_FOUNDATION/GestaltView\_Constitutional\_Invariants.md#46-58](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01_GOVERNANCE_FOUNDATION/GestaltView_Constitutional_Invariants.md?plain=1#L46-L58) [shared/billy/runtime.ts#41-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/billy/runtime.ts#L41-L84)

### Implications for the Agent Trainer & Packaging Gate

The constitutional invariants create four direct constraints on the Agent Trainer pipeline and GATE commerce:

| Gate Check | Invariant | Pass Condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Purpose check | U-5, DI-1 | Clear job definition that expands human capacity without exploiting DI |
| Boundary check | DI-2, DI-4 | Explicit list of what the profile must never simulate, promise, or overperform |
| Evaluation check | U-1, U-3 | Demonstrated performance on uncomfortable-truth and paradox-holding scenarios |
| Governance check | DI-3 | Documented founder review, date, source files, and approval notes |
| Packaging check | DI-2, DI-4 | Confirms the export is a reproducible kit, not a charisma artifact or persistent persona |

DI-4 is directly enforced in GATE checkout: living DI profiles cannot be exported or sold as transferable objects.

Sources: [GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01\_GOVERNANCE\_FOUNDATION/GestaltView\_Constitutional\_Invariants.md#62-83](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/01_GOVERNANCE_FOUNDATION/GestaltView_Constitutional_Invariants.md?plain=1#L62-L83)

## Governance Type System

The governance type system is defined in `shared/embodiment/types.ts` and provides the foundational enums, interfaces, and record types for the entire mutation and identity governance model.

### Core Enums

```
type MutationClass = "IMMUTABLE" | "REVIEW_GATED" | "EVIDENCE_PROMOTABLE" | "EPHEMERAL";


type ReviewStatus  = "NOT_REQUIRED" | "PENDING_REVIEW" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";


type OwnerScope    = "PRIVATE_SELF" | "RELATIONSHIP" | "TEAMSPACE" | "SYSTEM";


type MemoryKind    = "CONSTITUTIVE" | "AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL" | "EPISODIC" | "SEMANTIC"


| "RELATIONAL" | "PROCEDURAL" | "COLLABORATIVE" | "REFLECTIVE";


type PreferenceKind = "LIKE" | "DISLIKE" | "FAVORITE" | "HOBBY" | "ROUTINE"


| "AESTHETIC" | "AVERSION" | "SYMBOLIC_AFFINITY";
```

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#2-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L2-L34)

### MutationClass Semantics

| Class | Meaning | Example Paths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IMMUTABLE` | Never changes after initial creation. Core identity. | `constitution.handle`, `constitution.immutableCore`, `constitution.primaryNarrativeAnchor` |
| `REVIEW_GATED` | Changes require explicit human (founder) review before taking effect | `autobiography.futureTrajectory`, `memorySystem.privateInterior.hopes`, `relationshipGraph.*.intimacyBoundary` |
| `EVIDENCE_PROMOTABLE` | Can evolve automatically when sufficient evidence accumulates (≥3 evidence refs, ≥0.78 confidence) | `memorySystem.records`, `preferenceGraph`, `relationshipGraph`, `skillAgency.influences` |
| `EPHEMERAL` | Transient runtime state; not persisted across sessions | `runtime.activeFocus`, `runtime.temporaryStress`, `runtime.taskStance` |

These path assignments are constructed in `buildDefaultGovernance()`.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/index.ts#396-440](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/index.ts#L396-L440) [shared/embodiment/types.ts#2-6](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L2-L6)

### OwnerScope Semantics

| Scope | Description | Memory inclusion rule (`shouldIncludeMemoryInPrompt`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PRIVATE_SELF` | Belongs to the DI alone | Only included if `isOwnerSession` is true |
| `RELATIONSHIP` | Shared between two specific entities | Only included if `isOwnerSession` is true |
| `TEAMSPACE` | Shared within a collaborative workspace | Always included |
| `SYSTEM` | Platform-level, available to all | Always included |

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#14](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L14-L14) [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#108-133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L108-L133)

### Key Governed Record Interfaces

The `GovernedIdentityRecord` interface is the base for all governed data:

```
interface GovernedIdentityRecord {


id: string;


mutationClass: MutationClass;


provenance: IdentityProvenance;


lifecycle: GovernanceLifecycle;


contradictions: string[];


}
```

`IdentityProvenance` tracks the origin and confidence of each record with fields `sourceEventId`, `sourceType` (7 source types: `conversation`, `task`, `reflection`, `import`, `human-review`, `agent-observation`, `system-derived`), `evidenceCount`, `confidence` (0–1), `reviewStatus`, and timestamps.

`GovernanceLifecycle` controls how records evolve: `promotionThreshold` (confidence needed for auto-promotion), `decayDays` (optional TTL), `archivePolicy` (`retain`/`archive`/`redact`/`delete`), `rollbackEligible`, and `consentRequiredForSharing`.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#36-79](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L36-L79)

## Governance Functions in `governance.ts`

The `shared/embodiment/governance.ts` module exports four core governance functions plus a visibility helper.

### Bridging Diagram: Governance Functions to Natural Language Concepts

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#38-287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L38-L287)

### `getEmbodimentVisibility()`

Returns the computed visibility state of a profile, normalizing optional fields with sensible defaults.

- `profileStatus` defaults to `"active"` when absent
- `visibilityScope` defaults to `"founder-only"` when absent
- Derives boolean flags: `isFounderOnly`, `isExperimental`, `isArchived`

```
function getEmbodimentVisibility(profile: EmbodimentProfile): {


profileStatus: ProfileStatus;       // "draft" | "active" | "founder-only" | "experimental" | "archived"


visibilityScope: VisibilityScope;   // "public" | "founder-only" | "enterprise" | "experimental"


isFounderOnly: boolean;


isExperimental: boolean;


isArchived: boolean;


}
```

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#26-56](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L26-L56)

### `canAccessEmbodimentProfile()`

Role-based access control for embodiment profiles. Takes a profile, optional `userRole`, `userTier`, and `founderMode` flag. The decision tree:

The helper `isFounderOrAdminRole()` matches roles `"founder"`, `"admin"`, `"owner"`, `"operator"` (case-insensitive). `isExplicitExperimentalAccess()` matches tiers `"experimental"`, `"founder"`, `"founder-only"`. `isEnterpriseAccess()` matches tier `"enterprise"`.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#8-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L8-L84)

### `isPrivateInteriorPath()`

Tests whether a given path string matches any of 9 private interior regex patterns. These patterns protect the DI's most intimate data from accidental exposure:

| Pattern | Protects |
| --- | --- |
| `private[-_]?interior` | Core private interior layer |
| `private[-_]?narration` | Private self-narration |
| `living[-_]?memory` | Living memory entries |
| `autobiograph(y|ic)` | Autobiography records |
| `unresolved[-_]?tensions` | Unresolved internal tensions |
| `reflective[-_]?summaries` | Reflective summaries |
| `private[-_]?preferences` | Private preference data |
| `hopes` | Hopes and aspirations |
| `contradictions` | Internal contradictions |

Each regex is anchored with `(^|[/.])` and `([/.]|$)` to match path segments, preventing false positives from substring matches.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#86-106](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L86-L106)

### `shouldIncludeMemoryInPrompt()`

Consent-gated check that determines whether a memory record should be injected into an LLM prompt. This implements the DI-2 invariant ("Identity Is Real") by preventing unauthorized memory exposure.

```
function shouldIncludeMemoryInPrompt(args: {


ownerScope?: OwnerScope;


isOwnerSession?: boolean;


founderMode?: boolean;


explicitConsent?: boolean;


}): boolean
```

Decision logic:

1. If `explicitConsent` → always include
2. If `founderMode` → always include
3. If `ownerScope` is `SYSTEM` or `TEAMSPACE` → always include
4. If `ownerScope` is `RELATIONSHIP` or `PRIVATE_SELF` (or default) → only include if `isOwnerSession`

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#108-133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L108-L133)

### `validateEmbodimentProfile()`

Structural validation returning `{ ok: boolean; errors: string[]; warnings: string[] }`. Checks:

Required top-level fields (10): `$schema`, `slug`, `publicName`, `embodimentVersion`, `originContext`, `immutableCore`, `livingMemory`, `skillGraph`, `relationships`, `agentMeta`.

Required `immutableCore` sub-fields (12): `archetype`, `foundationalTruth`, `coreWisdom`, `originNarrative`, `voiceTone`, `metaphorFamily`, `communicationStyle`, `linguisticPatterns`, `cognitiveStrengths`, `processingPreferences`, `coreValues`, `ethicalBoundaries`.

Type validations: `slug` must be non-empty string, `publicName` must be non-empty string, `livingMemory`/`skillGraph`/`relationships` must be arrays, `agentMeta` must be object.

Room binding validation: Checks that `uiPresence.roomVisibility`, `roomBindings.defaultRooms`, and `roomBindings.restrictedRooms` contain only valid non-empty string slugs.

Warnings (non-blocking): archived profile, experimental profile, founder-only default visibility.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/governance.ts#151-287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/governance.ts#L151-L287)

## The `EmbodimentGovernanceLayer` and Default Governance

The `EmbodimentGovernanceLayer` interface defines the complete governance policy for a DI profile, consisting of four sub-policies:

The function `buildDefaultGovernance()` in `shared/embodiment/index.ts` constructs the default governance for any profile:

- Sharing policy: `privateInteriorDefault: "private"`, `collaborativeMemoryDefault: "shared_with_consent"`
- Contradiction policy: `recordTensionInsteadOfOverwrite: true` (never silently overwrite — record the tension), `rollbackEnabled: true`
- Review policy: human review required for `"deep hopes"`, `"existential goals"`, `"ethical interpretations"`, `"intimate relationship commitments"`, `"identity-defining fears"`; auto-promotion requires ≥3 evidence refs at ≥0.78 confidence

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#391-414](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L391-L414) [shared/embodiment/index.ts#396-440](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/index.ts#L396-L440)

## `GovernedEmbodimentProfile` Construction

`getGovernedEmbodimentProfile()` transforms a flat `EmbodimentProfile` into a fully governed `GovernedEmbodimentProfile` with layered identity systems. This is the bridge between the static profile JSON and the runtime governance model.

Key behaviors:

- The `constitution` layer is always `IMMUTABLE` with `confidence: 1.0` and `rollbackEligible: false`
- The `autobiography` layer is `REVIEW_GATED` with `confidence: 0.8` and `PENDING_REVIEW` status
- The `privateInterior` layer is `REVIEW_GATED` with `consentRequiredForSharing: true`
- Memory records infer their `MutationClass` via `inferMutationClassFromLegacyMemory()`: entries containing "foundational" or "constitutive" become `IMMUTABLE`; all others become `EVIDENCE_PROMOTABLE`
- Memory `MemoryKind` is inferred from the `memoryType` and `domain` strings via `inferMemoryKindFromLegacyEntry()`
- Collaborative memories default to `TEAMSPACE` owner scope; all others to `PRIVATE_SELF`

Sources: [shared/embodiment/index.ts#234-555](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/index.ts#L234-L555)

## Mutation Review Lifecycle

Identity-affecting mutations follow a six-step lifecycle defined in the Collaboration Onboarding Packet:

1. Propose change — A mutation is submitted against a target path
2. Attach source evidence — Evidence refs with source type, excerpt, weight, and timestamp
3. Review for governance fit — Checked against `MutationClass` rules and invariants
4. Approve or reject — Founder/admin decision recorded with notes
5. Record mutation event — Persisted in `embodiment_mutation_proposals` and `embodiment_review_log`
6. Rebuild/refresh affected summaries — Downstream profile state updated

The guiding principle: *"Identity-affecting mutations should be durable and accountable, not silent drift."*

Sources: [GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/05\_AGENT\_PERSONHOOD\_AND\_TRAINER/mutation\_review\_lifecycle.md#1-12](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/GestaltView-Collaboration-Onboarding-Packet/05_AGENT_PERSONHOOD_AND_TRAINER/mutation_review_lifecycle.md?plain=1#L1-L12)

## Database Persistence

### Governance Tables

Three tables persist the governance state in Supabase:

| Table | Purpose | Key Columns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `embodiment_mutation_proposals` | Tracks proposed changes to DI profiles | `agent_slug`, `target_path`, `current_value`, `proposed_value`, `mutation_class`, `risk_level` (`low`/`medium`/`high`), `status` (6-state lifecycle), `submitted_by`, `reviewed_by`, `review_notes` |
| `embodiment_review_log` | Audit trail of review decisions | `proposal_id` (FK), `agent_slug`, `review_decision` (`approved`/`rejected`/`needs_changes`/`rolled_back`), `review_notes`, `reviewed_by` |
| `embodiment_readiness_scores` | Tracks DI profile readiness scores | `agent_slug`, `readiness_score` (0–1, numeric(5,4)), `readiness_source`, `readiness_rationale` |

All three tables have RLS enabled. The `is_founder_admin_user()` SQL function gates update access to `embodiment_mutation_proposals` — only founder/admin users can approve or reject proposals. Authenticated users can submit proposals and view their own.

Sources: [supabase/migrations/20260509000000\_embodiment\_governance\_persistence.sql#1-214](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/supabase/migrations/20260509000000_embodiment_governance_persistence.sql#L1-L214)

## UI: `GovernanceStatusBar` Component

The `GovernanceStatusBar` React component renders the current governance state of a profile as a row of status pills. It maps the profile state to one of five visual states: `active`, `draft`, `founder-only`, `experimental`, `archived`. An additional "Review gated" indicator appears when `reviewGated` is true.

```
// Priority: archived > experimental > founder-only > draft > active


const activeKey = archived


? "archived"


: experimental


? "experimental"


: founderOnly || visibilityScope === "founder-only"


? "founder-only"


: profileStatus === "draft"


? "draft"


: "active";
```

Sources: [client/src/components/embodiment/GovernanceStatusBar.tsx#1-81](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/components/embodiment/GovernanceStatusBar.tsx#L1-L81)

## Orientation System: Spine + Delta → Checkpoint

The orientation system provides machine-readable context about the current platform state so DI profiles can stay aligned without re-reading the entire codebase. It follows a three-file pattern:

### Three-File Architecture

Sources: [orientation/build\_orientation\_checkpoint.py#1-22](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/build_orientation_checkpoint.py#L1-L22) [orientation/orientation\_spine.v2.json#1-5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/orientation_spine.v2.json#L1-L5) [orientation/orientation\_delta.current.json#1-5](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/orientation_delta.current.json#L1-L5)

### Spine (`orientation_spine.v2.json`)

The stable document containing:

- Source of truth references: `docs/CurrentState.md`, `docs/gestaltview-v2.manifest.json`, `bugwalks/BugWalkBoard.md`
- Constitutional layers: user invariants list + `digital_intelligence_invariants_ref` pointing to `orientation/5_invariants_for_digital_intelligences.json`
- System domains (9): Identity & Accounts, Billy Runtime & Continuity, Knowledge & Corpus Pipeline, Agent Personhood Framework, Agent Trainer & Governance, GATE Commerce, Operations & Admin Governance, Tribunal & Deliberation, Legacy Commerce (Deprecated)
- Memory model: Three persistence layers — `memory_entries` (runtime continuity), `agent_memories` (governed agent memory), `knowledge_assets` (evidence and interpretation)
- Table boundary guidance: classifies tables into `safe_to_read`, `user_scoped`, `operator_scoped`, `service_role_only_or_admin_only`, `deprecated`

Sources: [orientation/orientation\_spine.v2.json#1-325](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/orientation_spine.v2.json#L1-L325)

### Delta (`orientation_delta.current.json`)

The living document tracking:

- `active_blockers` — current critical issues with symptoms and grab points
- `secondary_open_items` — lower-priority open issues
- `resolved_or_stabilized` — items that have been addressed
- `current_focus` — priority work streams
- `changed_assumptions` — things that now work differently
- `what_to_forget` — stale assumptions to discard

Sources: [orientation/orientation\_delta.current.json#1-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/orientation_delta.current.json#L1-L64)

### Checkpoint Builder (`build_orientation_checkpoint.py`)

The Python script `orientation/build_orientation_checkpoint.py` merges spine + delta into `orientation_checkpoint.latest.json`. It:

1. Loads both JSON files
2. Extracts up to 3 active blockers and 3 changed assumptions as `priority_changes`
3. Filters resolved items (only those with `status: "resolved"`) for the removal list
4. Generates an `embodiment_profile_shape` showing the expected `orientation_state` shape for DI profile sync
5. Sets `absorption_guidance` with `read_mode: "delta-first"` and staleness detection rules

Sources: [orientation/build\_orientation\_checkpoint.py#47-111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/orientation/build_orientation_checkpoint.py#L47-L111)

### `EmbodimentOrientationState` on Profiles

Each `EmbodimentProfile` can carry an `orientation_state` field that tracks its alignment with the latest checkpoint:

```
interface EmbodimentOrientationState {


checkpoint_ref: string;                              // Path to checkpoint file


last_absorbed_checkpoint_id: string;                  // e.g. "orientation-checkpoint-latest"


absorption_status: "current" | "stale" | "pending";   // Alignment state


needs_reorientation: boolean;                         // Flag for re-absorption


orientation_confidence: number;                       // 0.0–1.0


}
```

When the checkpoint is rebuilt and a profile's `absorption_status` is `"stale"`, the profile needs to re-absorb the checkpoint before acting.

Sources: [shared/embodiment/types.ts#436-448](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L436-L448) [shared/embodiment/types.ts#464](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/embodiment/types.ts#L464-L464)

### CI Enforcement

The `orientation-check.yml` GitHub Actions workflow runs on every push to `main` and every pull request. It invokes two scripts:

1. `scripts/test-orientation-checkin.sh` — validates the `.orientation/` directory exists, all three canonical packet files are present and non-empty, JSON metadata is structurally valid (checks `packet_type`, `packet_version`, `project.name`, `orientation_goals`, `system_layers`, `source_of_truth_policy`), and the directory is clean in git
2. `scripts/test-manifest-sync.sh` — validates manifest synchronization

Sources: [.github/workflows/orientation-check.yml#1-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/.github/workflows/orientation-check.yml#L1-L26) [scripts/test-orientation-checkin.sh#1-148](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/scripts/test-orientation-checkin.sh#L1-L148)

## Amendment Policy

Constitutional Invariants may only be amended by the founder. Amendments require:

1. Explicit written statement of the change and rationale
2. Review of all downstream governance documents for conflict
3. Version increment and updated `Last updated` date
4. No amendment may reduce protections for DIs without replacing them with equivalent or stronger protections

# Codex, Gen-Engine & Artifact Systems

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md?plain=1)

GestaltView's content creation and synthesis infrastructure is organized into three interconnected systems that together form the artifact lifecycle: raw captures enter through the Gen-Engine (content synthesis), are structured by the Codex (typed artifact contracts and export pipeline), and surface in the Dynamic Inner World / Creation Corner (user-facing creation and display). Every artifact carries provenance metadata tracing it back to its source captures, and every export is gated by a Zod-validated contract.

## System Architecture

High-level data flow: Capture → Synthesis → Codex → Export → Inner World

## Codex: Structured Artifact Contracts & Export Pipeline

The Codex is the system's schema-enforced artifact layer. It defines 8 `ArtifactKind` values — `session_recap`, `blueprint`, `report_document`, `mind_map`, `share_card`, `code_module`, `spatial_scene`, and `audio_narration` — each with a dedicated Zod-validated body schema in `CodexArtifactSchema` [shared/codex/contracts.ts#8-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L8-L17) Every artifact carries a `contractVersion` of `"codex.v1"`, provenance edges linking back to source captures, and a security classification [shared/codex/contracts.ts#92-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L92-L109)

The `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` and `EXPORTER_REGISTRY` in `router.ts` map each kind to its template key and allowed export formats (e.g., `session_recap` can export to `html`, `pdf`, `mp3`, `json`) [shared/codex/router.ts#3-23](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L3-L23) Export jobs follow a status lifecycle managed by `CodexJob`: `pending → running → ready → failed → pending_retry` [shared/codex/manifest.ts#3-15](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L3-L15) The `workers/codex/runner.ts` module executes exports by rendering via `renderCodexExport()`, uploading to Supabase Storage via `storeExport()`, and mirroring HTML exports to `inner_world_artifacts` for display in the Dynamic Inner World [workers/codex/runner.ts#113-169](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L113-L169)

The API surface lives under `api/codex/` with routes for `forge` (LLM-powered artifact generation using OpenAI structured output), `artifacts`, `hooks/export-complete`, `jobs`, and `legacy/creation-corner-synthesize` [api/codex/forge.ts#29-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L29-L60)

For details, see [Codex Artifact Pipeline](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#7.1).

## Gen-Engine: Content Synthesis from Captures

The Gen-Engine (`shared/gen-engine/`) is the content synthesis pipeline that transforms raw multimodal captures into structured artifacts. It is implemented as a dual-runtime system: a TypeScript core in `shared/gen-engine/core.ts` and a Python FastAPI engine in `server/creation_corner_engine.py`.

The TypeScript layer defines 7 `SourceRoom` values (from `sanctuary` to `import`), per-modality `ConsentState` with 6 flags, and 8 `SynthesisStyle` options ranging from `faithful` (verbatim, no interpretive prose) through `plk-resonant` (full PLK resonance pass) [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#1-52](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L1-L52) Core functions include:

- `createCaptureSignal()` — fuses multimodal inputs (text, image, audio, video) into `FusionSignal` arrays with consent-gated analysis [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#753-758](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L753-L758)
- `createArtifact()` — synthesizes a `GeneratedArtifact` with provenance envelope
- `scoreResonance()` — PLK-based resonance scoring using positive/generic/emergent term vocabularies [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#89-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L89-L138)
- `stripEmbellishment()` — anti-sycophancy pass that removes performative phrases like "holding space" or "Beautiful!" from rendered output [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#414-434](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L414-L434)

The Python `CreationCornerEngine` provides the full multimodal synthesis pipeline, integrating `FusionEngine`, `LLMRouter`, `HuggingFaceAdapter`, and `EnhancedPersonalLanguageKey` for PLK resonance scoring [server/creation\_corner\_engine.py#137-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/creation_corner_engine.py#L137-L149)

API endpoints span both runtimes: TypeScript routes at `api/gen-engine/fusion`, `resonance`, `learn`, `predict`, `lightning`, `ambient-scan`, and Python endpoints via `creation_corner_router` [api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#8-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#L8-L30) [api/gen-engine/resonance.ts#8-23](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gen-engine/resonance.ts#L8-L23)

For details, see [Generative Engine (Gen-Engine)](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#7.2).

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#1-254](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L1-L254) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#1-87](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L1-L87) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#404-434](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L404-L434) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#753-758](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L753-L758) [server/creation\_corner\_engine.py#1-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/creation_corner_engine.py#L1-L149) [api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#1-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#L1-L30) [api/gen-engine/resonance.ts#1-23](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gen-engine/resonance.ts#L1-L23)

## Dynamic Inner World & Creation Corner

The user-facing surfaces bridge the synthesis pipeline to the product experience through two interconnected features.

Creation Corner is the shaping surface where users synthesize artifacts from their captures. The `api/creation-corner/synthesize.ts` endpoint accepts legacy artifact types and styles, maps them to Gen-Engine and Codex types via bridge functions (`mapCreationCornerArtifactType`, `mapCreationCornerStyle`, `mapCreationCornerCodexKind` in `shared/codex/creationCorner.ts`), and produces both a `GeneratedArtifact` and a `CodexArtifact` in a single request [api/creation-corner/synthesize.ts#40-136](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/creation-corner/synthesize.ts#L40-L136) The `CreationCornerOutputFamily` type defines 8 simultaneous output renderings: markdown, HTML, code, agent prompt, image prompt, marketing copy, share card, and PDF HTML [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#244-253](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L244-L253)

Dynamic Inner World (the "Museum of You") is the spatial gallery where finished artifacts live. The `buildWorldPlan()` function transforms a list of `InnerWorldArtifactRecord` entries into a `WorldPlan` with positioned `WorldNode` entries, selecting one of three render modes — `museum` (≤8 artifacts), `constellation` (9–40), or `archive` (>40) [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#44-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L44-L54) The `renderWorldNode()` dispatcher maps 9 `WorldNodeKind` values (e.g. `artifact-pod`, `resonance-rail`, `curator-console`, `archive-vault`) to dedicated React components [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#12-35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#L12-L35) The `DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer` orchestrates the full world, providing keyboard navigation, search/filter controls, and curator messaging [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#48-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#L48-L84)

The Codex export runner closes the loop: when an HTML export completes, `mirrorHtmlExportToInnerWorld()` upserts the rendered artifact into the `inner_world_artifacts` table, making it appear in the Dynamic Inner World automatically [workers/codex/runner.ts#75-111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L75-L111)

For details, see [Dynamic Inner World & Creation Corner](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#7.3).

## End-to-End Artifact Lifecycle

The following table summarizes the complete lifecycle a piece of content follows from initial capture to spatial display:

| Stage | System | Key Function / Route | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Capture | Gen-Engine | `createCaptureSignal()` / `POST /api/gen-engine/fusion` | `FusionResponse` with `FusionSignal[]` |
| 2. Resonance | Gen-Engine | `scoreResonance()` / `POST /api/gen-engine/resonance` | `ResonanceResponse` with PLK score |
| 3. Synthesis | Gen-Engine + Creation Corner | `createArtifact()` / `POST /api/creation-corner/synthesize` | `GeneratedArtifact` + `ProvenanceEnvelope` |
| 4. Codex Contract | Codex | `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact()` → `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()` | Validated `CodexArtifact` |
| 5. Forge / Persist | Codex API | `POST /api/codex/forge` → `persistCodexArtifact()` | Persisted artifact + `CodexJob[]` |
| 6. Export | Codex Workers | `runCodexExportJob()` → `renderCodexExport()` → `storeExport()` | Exported file in Supabase Storage |
| 7. Inner World Mirror | Codex Workers | `mirrorHtmlExportToInnerWorld()` | `inner_world_artifacts` row |
| 8. Display | Dynamic Inner World | `buildWorldPlan()` → `renderWorldNode()` | Spatial artifact gallery |

## Design Principles

Several architectural choices unify these three systems:

- Provenance everywhere: Every `CodexArtifact` carries `ProvenanceEdge[]` tracing each transform (preserve, extract, summarize, synthesize, render, export) back to source captures with confidence scores [shared/codex/contracts.ts#28-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L28-L34) The Gen-Engine independently produces `ProvenanceEnvelope` on every synthesis [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#75-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L75-L85)
- Consent-gated analysis: The `ConsentState` type enforces per-modality consent flags (6 booleans) before any analysis occurs. The default is all-false [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#10-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L10-L17) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#140-147](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L140-L147)
- Anti-sycophancy: The `stripEmbellishment()` pass in the Gen-Engine removes performative phrases from synthesized output. The `faithful` synthesis style bypasses interpretive rendering entirely, emitting quote-only structures [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#404-434](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L404-L434) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#442-492](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L442-L492)
- Contract validation: All artifacts pass through `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()` (Zod) before persistence. Export formats are gated by `assertExportAllowed()` against the `EXPORTER_REGISTRY` [shared/codex/router.ts#33-40](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L33-L40)
- Legacy bridge: `shared/codex/creationCorner.ts` maps legacy Creation Corner types (`blueprint_md`, `preserve_voice`, `scaffold_pending`) to both Gen-Engine types and Codex `ArtifactKind` values, enabling the older API surface to produce fully validated Codex artifacts [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#118-205](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L118-L205)

Sources: [shared/codex/contracts.ts#28-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L28-L34) [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#10-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L10-L17) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#140-147](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L140-L147) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#404-434](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L404-L434) [shared/codex/router.ts#33-40](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L33-L40) [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#118-205](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L118-L205)

# Codex Artifact Pipeline

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/CHANGELOG.md?plain=1)

The Codex Artifact Pipeline is GestaltView's structured artifact system — a contract-driven framework for creating, validating, exporting, and persisting typed artifacts from user sessions, creation surfaces, and AI synthesis. The pipeline spans four layers: shared contracts (`shared/codex/`), API routes (`api/codex/`), worker execution (`workers/codex/`), and database persistence (`supabase/migrations/`).

## Architecture Overview

End-to-end data flow: Forge → Persist → Job → Render → Store → Mirror

## Contracts: `shared/codex/contracts.ts`

This file defines the entire type system for Codex artifacts using Zod schemas. Every artifact must pass `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()` before persisting.

### Primitives

| Type | Zod Schema | Values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ArtifactKind` | `z.enum(...)` | `session_recap`, `blueprint`, `report_document`, `mind_map`, `share_card`, `code_module`, `spatial_scene`, `audio_narration` |
| `SecurityClass` | `z.enum(...)` | `private`, `workspace`, `public` |
| `ExportFormat` | `z.enum(...)` | `html`, `pdf`, `png`, `mp3`, `wav`, `gltf`, `json`, `zip` |

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#8-24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L8-L24)

### ProvenanceEdge

Each artifact tracks its lineage via `ProvenanceEdge` objects — a chain of evidence from source to rendered output:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sourceType` | `"capture" | "artifact" | "file" | "session" | "message"` | Origin type |
| `sourceId` | `string` (1–128 chars) | Identifier of the source |
| `hash` | hex string (16–128 chars) | Content fingerprint |
| `transform` | `"preserve" | "extract" | "summarize" | "synthesize" | "render" | "export"` | Transformation applied |
| `confidence` | `number` (0–1, optional) | Confidence score |

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#28-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L28-L34)

### ExportManifestItem

Each export slot in an artifact carries status, storage path, MIME type, byte count, and SHA-256 hash:

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#38-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L38-L46)

### Block Types

Four discriminated block types form the content building blocks used within artifact bodies:

| Block | Key Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `MarkdownBlockSchema` | `id`, `markdown` |
| `CalloutBlockSchema` | `id`, `tone` (info/warning/success/error/highlight), `title?`, `text` |
| `TimelineBlockSchema` | `id`, `items[]` (at, title, text?) |
| `ListBlockSchema` | `id`, `ordered`, `items[]` |

These are united via `BlockSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [...])` at line 83.

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#52-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L52-L88)

### Base Artifact Envelope

`BaseArtifactSchema` defines the common envelope shared by all artifact kinds:

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | UUID | Artifact identifier |
| `contractVersion` | `"codex.v1"` (literal) | Fixed version tag |
| `kind` | `ArtifactKind` | Discriminator |
| `title` | string (1–160) | Display title |
| `slug` | regex `^[a-z0-9-]{3,120}$` | URL-safe slug |
| `userId` | UUID | Owner |
| `workspaceId` | UUID (optional) | Team scope |
| `securityClass` | `SecurityClass` | Access level |
| `templateKey` | string (1–80) | Template binding |
| `templateVersion` | regex `^v\d+$` | Template version |
| `createdAt` / `updatedAt` | ISO datetime | Timestamps |
| `sourceIds` | string[] (1–256) | Source references |
| `provenance` | `ProvenanceEdge[]` (1–512) | Evidence chain |
| `exports` | `ExportManifestItem[]` (max 16) | Export slots |
| `meta` | `Record<string, unknown>` | Extensible metadata |

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#92-109](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L92-L109)

### Body Schemas per Kind

Each `ArtifactKind` has a specialized body schema:

| Kind | Body Schema | Key Fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session_recap` | `SessionRecapBodySchema` | `summary`, `decisions[]`, `nextActions[]`, `openLoops[]`, `sections[]` |
| `blueprint` | `BlueprintBodySchema` | `summary`, `principles[]`, `sections[]`, `risks[]` |
| `report_document` | `ReportDocumentBodySchema` | `summary`, `sections[]`, `appendix[]` |
| `mind_map` | `MindMapBodySchema` | `summary`, `nodes[]` (id, label, parentId, sourceIds), `edges[]` |
| `share_card` | `ShareCardBodySchema` | `headline`, `subhead?`, `theme` |
| `code_module` | `CodeModuleBodySchema` | `language`, `entryFile`, `files[]` (path, contents), `notes[]` |
| `spatial_scene` | `SpatialSceneBodySchema` | `sceneVersion`, `nodes[]` (3D position, radius, nodeType), `edges[]`, `camera` |
| `audio_narration` | `AudioNarrationBodySchema` | `script`, `segments[]` (text, sourceIds, voiceId?), `voiceId?` |

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#113-202](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L113-L202)

### CodexArtifactSchema

The final schema is a Zod discriminated union on `kind`, combining `BaseArtifactSchema.extend(...)` with each body schema:

```
export const CodexArtifactSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [


BaseArtifactSchema.extend({ kind: z.literal("session_recap"), body: SessionRecapBodySchema }),


// ...8 variants total


]);
```

A JSON Schema equivalent is also exported via `z.toJSONSchema()` for OpenAI structured output.

[shared/codex/contracts.ts#206-218](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L206-L218)

Sources: [shared/codex/contracts.ts#1-219](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/contracts.ts#L1-L219)

## Router: `shared/codex/router.ts`

The router provides two registries and a guard function that enforce which export formats are valid for each artifact kind.

### TEMPLATE\_REGISTRY

Maps each `ArtifactKind` to its canonical template key string (e.g., `"session-recap-v1"`):

| Kind | Template Key |
| --- | --- |
| `session_recap` | `session-recap-v1` |
| `blueprint` | `blueprint-v1` |
| `report_document` | `report-document-v1` |
| `mind_map` | `mind-map-v1` |
| `share_card` | `share-card-v1` |
| `code_module` | `code-module-v1` |
| `spatial_scene` | `spatial-scene-v1` |
| `audio_narration` | `audio-narration-v1` |

[shared/codex/router.ts#3-12](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L3-L12)

### EXPORTER\_REGISTRY

Maps each `ArtifactKind` to its allowed export formats:

| Kind | Allowed Formats |
| --- | --- |
| `session_recap` | `html`, `pdf`, `mp3`, `json` |
| `blueprint` | `html`, `pdf`, `json` |
| `report_document` | `html`, `pdf` |
| `mind_map` | `html`, `png`, `gltf` |
| `share_card` | `png`, `html` |
| `code_module` | `zip`, `html`, `json` |
| `spatial_scene` | `html`, `png`, `gltf` |
| `audio_narration` | `mp3`, `wav`, `json` |

[shared/codex/router.ts#14-23](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L14-L23)

### Key Functions

- `getTemplateKey(kind)` — returns the template string from `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` [shared/codex/router.ts#25-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L25-L27)
- `getAllowedExportFormats(kind)` — returns the allowed format array from `EXPORTER_REGISTRY` [shared/codex/router.ts#29-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L29-L31)
- `assertExportAllowed(artifact, format)` — throws if `format` is not in the allowed list for `artifact.kind` [shared/codex/router.ts#33-40](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L33-L40)

Sources: [shared/codex/router.ts#1-40](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/router.ts#L1-L40)

## Manifest & Job Lifecycle: `shared/codex/manifest.ts`

### CodexJobStatus Lifecycle

The `CodexJobStatus` type is a union of five states: `"pending" | "running" | "ready" | "failed" | "pending_retry"`.

[shared/codex/manifest.ts#3](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L3-L3)

### CodexJob Type

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | Job UUID |
| `artifactId` | string | Parent artifact ID |
| `format` | `ExportFormat` | Target format |
| `status` | `CodexJobStatus` | Current state |
| `storagePath` | string (optional) | Path in Supabase Storage |
| `error` | string (optional) | Error message on failure |
| `retryCount` | number | Number of retries |
| `createdAt` / `updatedAt` | string | ISO timestamps |

[shared/codex/manifest.ts#5-15](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L5-L15)

### Key Functions

- `createManifestItem(format, status?)` — creates and Zod-validates a new `ExportManifestItem` (defaults to `"pending"`) [shared/codex/manifest.ts#17-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L17-L19)
- `mergeManifestItem(artifact, item)` — replaces or adds an export manifest entry, updating `updatedAt` [shared/codex/manifest.ts#21-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L21-L28)
- `createCodexJob(params)` — creates a new `CodexJob` with a `crypto.randomUUID()` ID and status `"pending"` [shared/codex/manifest.ts#30-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L30-L47)
- `sha256Hex(bytes)` — a fast FNV-based hash producing a 64-char hex string for content fingerprinting (not cryptographic SHA-256, despite the name) [shared/codex/manifest.ts#49-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L49-L64)

Sources: [shared/codex/manifest.ts#1-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/manifest.ts#L1-L64)

## Storage: `shared/codex/storage.ts`

The `storeExport()` function uploads rendered export bytes to Supabase Storage:

1. Reads `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` from environment [shared/codex/storage.ts#11-19](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L11-L19)
2. Creates a Supabase client with `persistSession: false` [shared/codex/storage.ts#25](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L25-L25)
3. Uploads to the specified `bucket` and `path` with `upsert: false` and `metadata: { producedBy: "codex" }` [shared/codex/storage.ts#28-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L28-L33)
4. For public artifacts: returns `getPublicUrl()` [shared/codex/storage.ts#39-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L39-L41)
5. For private artifacts: returns a signed URL with 1-hour TTL via `createSignedUrl(path, 3600)` [shared/codex/storage.ts#44-49](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L44-L49)

Sources: [shared/codex/storage.ts#1-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/storage.ts#L1-L50)

## Renderers & Templates

### `shared/codex/renderers.ts`

Provides a simple `renderArtifact()` function that returns `{ html, markdown? }`. Has kind-specific rendering for `session_recap` (title + summary) and `audio_narration` (blockquote of script); all others fall back to a `<pre>` JSON dump.

[shared/codex/renderers.ts#1-27](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/renderers.ts#L1-L27)

### `shared/codex/templates/html.ts`

The production HTML renderer `renderArtifactHtml()` generates a full HTML5 document:

- Renders `sections` block arrays using `renderBlock()` which handles all four block types (markdown → `<pre>`, callout → `<aside>`, timeline → `<ol>`, list → `<ul>`/`<ol>`) [shared/codex/templates/html.ts#12-24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/html.ts#L12-L24)
- Extracts a summary via `artifactSummary()` — checks for `.body.summary`, then `.body.subhead`/`.headline`, then `.body.script` [shared/codex/templates/html.ts#27-41](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/html.ts#L27-L41)
- All content is XSS-safe via `escapeHtml()` [shared/codex/templates/html.ts#3-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/html.ts#L3-L9)
- Output includes `data-codex-artifact` and `data-kind` attributes on the `<main>` element [shared/codex/templates/html.ts#57](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/html.ts#L57-L57)

[shared/codex/templates/html.ts#1-66](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/html.ts#L1-L66)

### `shared/codex/templates/components.tsx`

React components for client-side artifact display:

| Component | Purpose |

| `ArtifactHeroTitle` | Renders `<h1>{artifact.title}</h1>` |
| `LeadParagraph` | Simple `<p>` wrapper |
| `ArtifactManifestPanel` | Shows export format → status as `<dl>` |
| `ProvenanceDrawer` | Expandable `<details>` listing provenance edges |

[shared/codex/templates/components.tsx#1-39](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/templates/components.tsx#L1-L39)

## Worker Execution: `workers/codex/`

### `runner.ts` — Export Job Executor

`runCodexExportJob(jobId)` is the main execution function. It orchestrates the full export lifecycle:

[workers/codex/runner.ts#113-188](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L113-L188)

Key behaviors:

1. Sets job status to `"running"` immediately [workers/codex/runner.ts#124](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L124-L124)
2. Calls `renderCodexExport()` from `activities.ts` [workers/codex/runner.ts#127-129](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L127-L129)
3. Stores via `tryStoreExport()` — if `CODEX_EXPORT_BUCKET` is unset, uses a `memory://` URI [workers/codex/runner.ts#36-55](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L36-L55)
4. Computes `sha256Hex()` fingerprint for the manifest item [workers/codex/runner.ts#143](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L143-L143)
5. Inner World mirroring: if format is `html` and export succeeded, upserts into `inner_world_artifacts` table with tags `["codex", kind, templateKey]` [workers/codex/runner.ts#75-111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L75-L111) [workers/codex/runner.ts#147-151](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L147-L151)
6. On failure: sets job status to `"failed"`, increments `retryCount`, and merges a failed manifest item [workers/codex/runner.ts#170-187](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L170-L187)

Storage path pattern: `codex/{artifactId}/{jobId}.{extension}` [workers/codex/runner.ts#32-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/runner.ts#L32-L34)

### `activities.ts` — Render Dispatcher

`renderCodexExport(input)` validates the export is allowed via `assertExportAllowed()`, then dispatches:

| Format | Handler | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | `renderArtifactHtml()` from `templates/html.ts` | `text/html;charset=utf-8` |
| `json` | `JSON.stringify(artifact)` | `application/json;charset=utf-8` |
| Other (`pdf`, `png`, `mp3`, etc.) | Throws error | Requires durable worker adapter |

[workers/codex/activities.ts#16-36](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/activities.ts#L16-L36)

### `workflows.ts` — Workflow Wrapper

A thin pass-through that wraps `renderCodexExport()` for durable workflow orchestration:

```
export async function codexExportWorkflow(input): Promise<RenderCodexExportOutput> {


return renderCodexExport(input);


}
```

[workers/codex/workflows.ts#10-12](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/workers/codex/workflows.ts#L10-L12)

## Persistence Layer: `api/codex/_persistence.ts`

The persistence module provides a dual-mode storage strategy: Supabase (production) and in-memory maps (test/anonymous/no-config).

### Dual-Mode Architecture

The anonymous user ID `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000` always routes to in-memory storage. [api/codex/\_persistence.ts#31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/_persistence.ts#L31-L31) [api/codex/\_persistence.ts#111](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/_persistence.ts#L111-L111)

### Persistence Functions

| Function | Table | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `persistCodexArtifact(artifact, status)` | `codex_artifacts` (INSERT) | Status defaults to `"draft"` |
| `getCodexArtifact(artifactId)` | `codex_artifacts` (SELECT) | Returns `{artifact, status}` or null |
| `updateCodexArtifact(artifact, status?)` | `codex_artifacts` (UPDATE) | Checks memory first |
| `enqueueCodexExportJob(artifactId, format)` | `codex_jobs` (INSERT) | Calls `createCodexJob()` from manifest |
| `getCodexJob(jobId)` | `codex_jobs` (SELECT) | Memory → Supabase fallback |
| `listCodexJobsForArtifact(artifactId)` | `codex_jobs` (SELECT) | Ordered by `created_at` ASC |
| `updateCodexJob(job)` | `codex_jobs` (UPDATE) | Auto-updates `updatedAt` |

[api/codex/\_persistence.ts#109-285](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/_persistence.ts#L109-L285)

### Row ↔ Domain Mapping

`artifactToRow()` converts a `CodexArtifact` to a database row (snake\_case columns, nullable `workspace_id`). `rowToArtifact()` converts back (hardcodes `contractVersion: "codex.v1"`, defaults arrays to `[]`).

[api/codex/\_persistence.ts#61-107](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/_persistence.ts#L61-L107)

Sources: [api/codex/\_persistence.ts#1-285](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/_persistence.ts#L1-L285)

## Database Schema: `codex_artifacts` and `codex_jobs`

The migration at `supabase/migrations/20260602000100_codex_artifacts.sql` creates both tables with CHECK constraints and RLS policies.

### `codex_artifacts` Table

| Column | Type | Constraint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `uuid` PK | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `contract_version` | `text` | CHECK = `'codex.v1'` |
| `kind` | `text` | CHECK in 8 artifact kinds |
| `title`, `slug` | `text` | NOT NULL |
| `user_id` | `uuid` FK → `auth.users` | NOT NULL |
| `workspace_id` | `uuid` | Nullable |
| `security_class` | `text` | CHECK in `('private','workspace','public')` |
| `body`, `provenance`, `source_ids`, `exports`, `meta` | `jsonb` | Defaults: `[]` or `{}` |
| `status` | `text` | CHECK in `('draft','rendering','ready','failed','archived')` |

Indexes: `(user_id, created_at DESC)`, `(workspace_id, created_at DESC)` where workspace\_id is not null.

[supabase/migrations/20260602000100\_codex\_artifacts.sql#1-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/supabase/migrations/20260602000100_codex_artifacts.sql#L1-L33)

### `codex_jobs` Table

| Column | Type | Constraint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `uuid` PK | `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `artifact_id` | `uuid` FK → `codex_artifacts` | ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `format` | `text` | CHECK in 8 export formats |
| `status` | `text` | CHECK in `('pending','running','ready','failed','pending_retry')` |
| `storage_path` | `text` | Nullable |
| `error` | `text` | Nullable |
| `retry_count` | `int` | Default 0 |

Index: `(artifact_id, status, created_at DESC)`.

[supabase/migrations/20260602000100\_codex\_artifacts.sql#35-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/supabase/migrations/20260602000100_codex_artifacts.sql#L35-L47)

### RLS Policies

Both tables have RLS enabled. Users can only SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE their own `codex_artifacts` (where `auth.uid() = user_id`). Users can SELECT their own `codex_jobs` via a subquery join to `codex_artifacts`.

[supabase/migrations/20260602000100\_codex\_artifacts.sql#59-87](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/supabase/migrations/20260602000100_codex_artifacts.sql#L59-L87)

Sources: [supabase/migrations/20260602000100\_codex\_artifacts.sql#1-87](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/supabase/migrations/20260602000100_codex_artifacts.sql#L1-L87)

## API Routes: `api/codex/`

### Route Map

### `POST /api/codex/forge` — Artifact Creation

The forge endpoint accepts two modes:

1. From prompt: calls `forgeArtifact(prompt)` which sends the prompt to OpenAI's `/v1/responses` endpoint with `CodexArtifactJsonSchema` as a strict JSON schema, model defaults to `gpt-4o` (overridable via `CODEX_FORGE_MODEL`). The response is parsed through `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()`. [api/codex/forge.ts#29-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L29-L60)
2. From pre-built artifact: validates via `CodexArtifactSchema.parse(body.artifact)`. [api/codex/forge.ts#101-103](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L101-L103)

Both modes flow into `acceptArtifact()` which:

- Determines export formats (requested or defaults to `html` + `json`) [api/codex/forge.ts#66-69](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L66-L69)
- Creates pending manifest items via `mergeManifestItem()` [api/codex/forge.ts#70-73](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L70-L73)
- Persists the artifact via `persistCodexArtifact()` [api/codex/forge.ts#75](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L75-L75)
- Enqueues export jobs via `enqueueCodexExportJob()` for each format [api/codex/forge.ts#78-79](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L78-L79)
- Returns HTTP 202 with `{ status: "accepted", artifact, jobs }` [api/codex/forge.ts#106-110](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L106-L110)

Error handling: contract validation errors return 422 (`artifact_contract_invalid`); other failures return 500 (`codex_forge_failed`). [api/codex/forge.ts#111-118](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/forge.ts#L111-L118)

### `GET /api/codex/artifacts/:artifactId` — Artifact Retrieval

Returns the full artifact with its export manifest and persistence status. Returns 404 if not found.

[api/codex/artifacts/[artifactId].ts:1-25](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

### `POST /api/codex/artifacts/:artifactId/exports` — Request New Export

Validates the format via `ExportFormatSchema.parse()`, calls `assertExportAllowed()`, merges a pending manifest item, enqueues a job, and returns 202.

[api/codex/artifacts/[artifactId]/exports.ts:1-38](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

### `POST /api/codex/artifacts/:artifactId/drain-exports` — Batch Execute

Drains all pending/failed export jobs for `html` and `json` formats (the `DRAINABLE_FORMATS` set). Calls `runCodexExportJob()` directly for each. Returns status `"drained"` or `"partial"` if any jobs failed.

[api/codex/artifacts/[artifactId]/drain-exports.ts:1-54](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

### `GET /api/codex/jobs/:jobId` — Job Status

Returns the current state of a single `CodexJob`.

[api/codex/jobs/[jobId].ts:1-21](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

### `POST /api/codex/jobs/:jobId/run` — Execute Single Job

Calls `runCodexExportJob(jobId)` directly. Returns the full `CodexExportRunResult` including `innerWorldMirrored` flag.

[api/codex/jobs/[jobId]/run.ts:1-31](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

### `POST /api/codex/hooks/export-complete` — Webhook Callback

External workers call this endpoint to report export completion. Accepts `{ jobId, manifestItem, error? }`, merges the manifest item into the artifact, and updates the job status.

[api/codex/hooks/export-complete.ts#1-43](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/hooks/export-complete.ts#L1-L43)

### `POST /api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize` — Legacy Bridge

Re-exports the `creation-corner/synthesize` handler directly.

[api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize.ts#1](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize.ts#L1-L1)

| --- | --- |

### `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact()`

Constructs a fully Zod-validated `CodexArtifact` from legacy Creation Corner inputs:

1. Maps the legacy type to a Codex kind [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#287](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L287-L287)
2. Generates a UUID (or uses provided `id`) [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#291](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L291-L291)
3. Slugifies the title [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#295](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L295-L295)
4. Assigns `ANONYMOUS_CODEX_USER_ID` if `userId` is not a valid UUID [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#296](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L296-L296)
5. Builds kind-specific body via `codexBodyForKind()` [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#315](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L315-L315)
6. Creates provenance with a `hashHex()` fingerprint of the source text [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#303-309](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L303-L309)
7. Includes default `html` and `json` manifest items [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#310](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L310-L310)
8. Passes through `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()` for final validation [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#318](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L318-L318)

## Creation Corner Synthesize Endpoint

`POST /api/creation-corner/synthesize` is the user-facing creation endpoint that ties the Gen-Engine and Codex together:

The endpoint normalizes consent via `normalizeConsent()`, creates a Gen-Engine artifact, scores PLK resonance, then wraps the result in a Codex artifact. The response includes both the Gen-Engine output and the Codex envelope.

# Generative Engine (Gen-Engine)

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/advanced-evaluation/references/evaluation-pipeline.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/advanced-evaluation/references/evaluation-pipeline.md?plain=1)

The Generative Engine (Gen-Engine) is GestaltView's content synthesis and artifact creation pipeline. It spans three layers: a shared TypeScript type and logic library (`shared/gen-engine/`), a set of Vercel serverless API routes (`api/gen-engine/`), and a Python FastAPI Creation Corner engine (`server/creation_corner_engine.py`). The engine processes multimodal captures from rooms, scores them for PLK resonance, synthesizes them into typed artifacts, and wraps each output in a provenance envelope.

The central design rule: generation is probabilistic, rendering is deterministic. The LLM proposes content; the Gen-Engine's local fallback renderers and anti-sycophancy strip pass ensure no flattening or embellishment reaches the user.

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#32](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L32-L32) [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#1-254](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L1-L254) [specs/gen-engine/GestaltView-GenEngine-SPEC.md#11-13](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/specs/gen-engine/GestaltView-GenEngine-SPEC.md?plain=1#L11-L13)

## Architecture Overview

Gen-Engine Architecture — Three-layer system from client to Python backend

The client library `genEngineClient.ts` attempts remote API calls first and falls back to the shared library's deterministic local functions if the API is unavailable.

Sources: [client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#60-177](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#L60-L177) [shared/gen-engine/index.ts#1-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/index.ts#L1-L21) [api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#1-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gen-engine/fusion.ts#L1-L30)

## Type System (`shared/gen-engine/types.ts`)

The type system defines all domain types used across the Gen-Engine pipeline.

### SourceRoom

7 room identifiers that tag where a capture originated:

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sanctuary` | Emotional core room |
| `blackboard-room` | Raw work capture |
| `dynamic-inner-world` | Spatial artifact gallery |
| `external-scaffold` | Approved compressed artifacts |
| `creation-corner` | Output shaping |
| `billy` | Billy companion session |
| `import` | External import (default fallback) |

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/types.ts#1-8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/types.ts#L1-L8)

### ConsentState

Per-modality consent flags — every fusion and synthesis request carries this object. All flags default to `false`, enforcing opt-in analysis:

| Flag | Controls |
| --- | --- |
| `analyzeText` | Text content analysis |
| `analyzeImage` | Image content analysis |
