## Core Logic (`shared/gen-engine/core.ts`)

`core.ts` is the deterministic synthesis engine — ~1400 lines of pure functions with no external dependencies. It provides local-fallback implementations that work without any LLM provider configured.

### Normalization Layer

Four alias maps normalize kebab-case, snake\_case, and plain string inputs into canonical values. Each uses `normalizeByMap()` with a fallback:

| Function | Alias Map | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normalizeSourceRoom()` | `ROOM_ALIASES` (8 entries) | `"import"` |
| `normalizeArtifactType()` | `ARTIFACT_TYPE_ALIASES` (11 entries) | `"markdown"` |
| `normalizeArtifactDestination()` | `DESTINATION_ALIASES` (10 entries) | `"download-only"` |
| `normalizeSynthesisStyle()` | `STYLE_ALIASES` (10 entries) | `"faithful"` |

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#34-87](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L34-L87) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#222-235](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L222-L235)

### Anti-Sycophancy Embellishment Strip

The `EMBELLISHMENT_PATTERNS` array defines 10 regex patterns that detect performative/flattering phrases. The `stripEmbellishment()` function removes these from interpretive fields (summaries, user instructions) before they enter templates. Source material is never stripped.

Patterns target phrases like:

- `"It's nice to have/see/meet you..."`
- `"holding space"`
- `"that must be/feel..."`
- `"Beautiful!" / "Tender!" / "Amazing!"`
- `"What I hear is..."`

This enforces the anti-sycophancy rule from CONTEXT.md: *"If a response flatters, overconfirms, prematurely elevates, or adopts the user's frame without sufficient grounding, that is a system failure."*

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#404-434](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L404-L434)

### Faithful Render Path

When `synthesisStyle === "faithful"` or `preserveExactLanguage === true`, `renderMarkdownArtifact()` delegates to `renderFaithfulArtifact()`. This emits a quote-only markdown structure where every source line is blockquoted with `>` syntax. No interpretive prose is generated — this is the "hard floor against flattening."

```
# {title}


## Mode


Preserve Voice — verbatim source, no interpretive prose.


## Source Material (verbatim)


> {each line of source text}
```

For non-faithful styles, the standard markdown template applies `stripEmbellishment()` to the summary and user instructions before insertion.

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#436-574](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L436-L574)

### Output Renderers

`core.ts` provides multiple format-specific renderers:

| Renderer | Output | Used For |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderFaithfulArtifact()` | Blockquoted markdown | `faithful` style, `preserveExactLanguage` |
| `renderMarkdownArtifact()` | Structured markdown with metadata sections | All markdown-based types |
| `renderHtmlArtifact()` | Full HTML document with Neural-Aurora dark styling | `pdf-ready-html`, export fallback |
| `renderPdfHtmlArtifact()` | Print-ready HTML with Georgia serif, white background | PDF export |

The `createArtifact()` function selects the renderer based on `targetType` via a switch statement at line 1057. Special types like `agent-prompt`, `image-prompt`, `marketing-copy`, `share-card`, and `code` have inline template renderers. The `blueprint-json` type outputs structured JSON with embedded resonance data.

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#442-599](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L442-L599) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#1057-1141](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L1057-L1141)

### `createCaptureSignal()` — Fusion Pipeline

The primary multimodal fusion entry point. For each modality present in the `FusionRequest`, it:

1. Normalizes the source room and consent state
2. Checks consent per modality — if consent is denied, the raw data is preserved but not analyzed
3. Builds a `FusionSignal` per modality with adapter name (`text-basic`, `image-basic`, `audio-basic`, `video-basic`, `file-basic`), confidence score, and metadata
4. Generates a 12-dimensional vector via `buildTextVector()` for text (if consent allows) using token-hashing into buckets
5. Returns `FusionResponse` with `captureId`, `fusedText`, optional `embedding`, array of `signals`, and `warnings`

Confidence values by modality and consent:

| Modality | Consented | Not Consented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | 0.96 | 0.36 |
| image | 0.82 | 0.28 |
| audio | 0.76 | 0.24 |
| video | 0.70 | 0.20 |
| file | 0.70 | 0.34 |

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#753-887](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L753-L887)

### `scoreResonance()` — PLK Resonance Scoring

Scores text for alignment with GestaltView's values using three term lists:

- `POSITIVE_TERMS` (16 terms: `preserve`, `hold`, `witness`, `honest`, etc.) — each match adds `+1.8` energy boost
- `EMERGENT_TERMS` (12 terms: `blueprint`, `artifact`, `signal`, `resonance`, etc.) — each match adds `+1.2` energy boost
- `GENERIC_TERMS` (13 terms: `generic`, `flatten`, `dashboard`, `autopilot`, etc.) — each match adds `+1.6` trigger penalty
- PLK context terms — extracted from the user's PLK context, each match adds `+1.3` boost

The formula:

```
densityBonus = clamp(wordCount / 24, 0, 2)


baseScore = 44 + densityBonus * 6 + energyBoost * 4 - triggerPenalty * 5


score = round(clamp(baseScore, 0, 100))
```

Warnings are emitted if `score < 45` ("language reads a little generic") or `triggerPenalty > 4` ("draft carries flattening language").

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#89-138](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L89-L138) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#889-950](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L889-L950)

### `createArtifact()` — Full Synthesis Pipeline

The main artifact creation function orchestrates the full local synthesis pipeline:

1. Normalize all inputs (room, type, style, destination)
2. Pick best title via `pickBestTitle()` — rejects JSON-stringified candidates via `isLikelyJsonObject()`
3. Run `scoreResonance()` on combined text
4. Build source digests for provenance
5. Route to format-specific renderer
6. Attach `ProvenanceEnvelope` with FNV-1a `stableHash()` of source digests and artifact content
7. Set `transformType` based on artifact type: `prompt-generation` | `formatting` | `translation` | `synthesis`
8. Return `ArtifactSynthesisResponse` with `reviewRequired: destination !== "download-only"`

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#994-1192](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L994-L1192)

### `buildCreationCornerOutputs()` — Output Family Builder

Accepts `CreationCornerDraftInput` and produces a `CreationCornerOutputFamily` — 8 format variants of the same artifact simultaneously:

| Field | Builder Function | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | `buildCreationCornerMarkdown()` | Structured markdown blueprint |
| `html` | `renderHtmlArtifact()` | Neural-Aurora styled HTML |
| `code` | `buildCreationCornerCode()` | TypeScript `export const` module |
| `agentPrompt` | `buildCreationCornerPrompt()` | AI agent build instructions |
| `imagePrompt` | `buildCreationCornerImagePrompt()` | Image generation prompt |
| `marketingCopy` | `buildCreationCornerMarketingCopy()` | Marketing text |
| `shareCard` | `buildCreationCornerShareCard()` | Share-ready text card |
| `pdfHtml` | `renderPdfHtmlArtifact()` | Print-ready HTML |

Internally calls `createArtifact()` with `synthesisStyle: "faithful"`, `preserveExactLanguage: true`, and `plkMode: "light-touch"`.

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#1295-1330](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L1295-L1330) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#601-706](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L601-L706)

`POST /api/gen-engine/artifacts` — the most complex route. It:

## Client Library (`client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts`)

The client library wraps every Gen-Engine function in a remote-first, local-fallback pattern:

```
// Pattern used for every function:


const remote = await fetchRoute<T>(apiPath, { method: "POST", body: ... });


if (remote) return remote;


return localFallback(input); // from shared/gen-engine/core.ts
```

Each function calls the Vercel API via `appFetchJson()` with a 12-second timeout and 0 retries. If the API is unavailable, it falls back to the shared library's deterministic local implementation and appends a warning.

| Client Function | API Route | Local Fallback |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `createCaptureSignal()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/fusion` | `createCaptureSignalLocal()` |
| `scoreResonance()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/resonance` | `scoreResonanceLocalFallback()` |
| `createArtifact()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/artifacts` | `createArtifactLocal()` |
| `scanAmbientCoherence()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/ambient-scan` | `scanAmbientCoherenceLocal()` |
| `learnWithGenEngine()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/learn` | `buildLearnResponseLocal()` |
| `predictNextMove()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/predict` | `buildPredictionFromRequestLocal()` |
| `lightUpCapture()` | `POST /api/gen-engine/lightning` | `buildLightningResponseLocal()` |
| `exportArtifact()` | *(local only)* | `exportArtifactLocal()` |
| `buildCreationCornerOutputs()` | *(local only)* | `buildCreationCornerOutputsLocal()` |

Sources: [client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#50-203](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineClient.ts#L50-L203)

## Provenance & Hashing

Every artifact produced by the Gen-Engine carries a `ProvenanceEnvelope`. The TypeScript implementation uses FNV-1a hashing via `stableHash()` (initialization constant `2166136261`, multiplier `16777619`) to produce deterministic 8-character hex hashes of source digests and artifact content.

The Python implementation uses SHA-256 truncated to 16 hex characters for both input and output hashing, and records the full transformation chain including modality fusion steps, PLK scoring, and generation mode.

| Field | TypeScript | Python |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hash algorithm | FNV-1a (32-bit) | SHA-256 (truncated) |
| Source tracking | `sourceCaptureIds`, `sourceHashes` | `source_capture_ids`, `input_hash` |
| Transform types | `summary`, `synthesis`, `translation`, `formatting`, `prompt-generation` | Recorded as operations list |
| Engine version | `GEN_ENGINE_VERSION` = `"1.0.0"` | Via `ProvenanceEnvelope` class |

Sources: [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#203-211](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L203-L211) [shared/gen-engine/core.ts#382-402](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gen-engine/core.ts#L382-L402) [server/creation\_corner\_engine.py#272-288](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/creation_corner_engine.py#L272-L288)

## Health Checking

`buildGenEngineHealth()` checks for any configured LLM provider by scanning environment variables for 21 possible keys (Ollama, Groq, HuggingFace, OpenRouter, Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI — each with multiple naming conventions). Returns `"operational"` if any key exists, `"degraded"` with a warning otherwise. The health response also reports adapter availability — `text_basic`, `image_basic`, `audio_basic`, `video_basic`, `plk`, `provenance` are always `true`; `llm` depends on provider configuration.

# Dynamic Inner World & Creation Corner

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)

This page documents the two primary user-facing creation and display surfaces in GestaltView: the Dynamic Inner World (the "Museum of You" — a spatial artifact gallery) and Creation Corner (the synthesis workshop). Together they form the final stages of the artifact lifecycle: raw capture → synthesis → Codex artifact → export → inner-world display.

## Dynamic Inner World

The Dynamic Inner World is the room where finished artifacts are displayed in a spatial, museum-like gallery. It is conceptually the "Museum of You" — a 3D-perspective CSS stage where artifacts are positioned radially and the user navigates between them with keyboard or click interactions.

### Type System

All types for the world renderer are defined in a single file. The key types are:

| Type | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `WorldRenderMode` | `"museum"` / `"constellation"` / `"timeline"` / `"archive"` — layout mode based on artifact count |
| `WorldNodeKind` | 9 node types that can appear in the world (see table below) |
| `WorldPosition` | `{x, y, z, rotateX?, rotateY?, rotateZ?, scale?}` — 3D CSS position |
| `WorldNode` | A renderable item: `{id, kind, artifactId?, title?, summary?, tags?, position, emphasis, children?, props?}` |
| `WorldPlan` | Complete layout plan: `{id, mode, generatedAt, selectedArtifactId, nodes[], atmosphere, curator}` |
| `WorldRenderContext` | Context object combining plan, artifact map, filter state, and all callback handlers |
| `WorldStats` | `{totalArtifacts, plkFragmentCount, recentUpdates, curatorLabel}` |
| `ArtifactTypeFilter` | `"all"` / `"image"` / `"text"` / `"code"` / `"audio"` |
| `ArtifactSortMode` | `"recent"` / `"oldest"` / `"title"` |

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#1-100](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#L1-L100)

The 9 `WorldNodeKind` values and their component mappings:

| `WorldNodeKind` | Component | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"world-atrium"` | `WorldAtrium` | Atmospheric background with radial gradients and mode label |
| `"artifact-pod"` | `ExhibitPod` | Individual artifact card positioned in 3D space |
| `"artifact-constellation"` | `ArtifactConstellation` | Central dot visual for constellation mode |
| `"resonance-rail"` | `ResonanceRail` | Resonance link pill showing score between artifacts |
| `"curator-console"` | `CuratorConsole` | Collapsible panel with curator persona message |
| `"archive-vault"` | `ArchiveVault` | Sidebar showing archived artifact count and recent titles |
| `"search-control-deck"` | `SearchControlDeck` | Search, sort, type filter, and tag filter controls |
| `"empty-hall-state"` | `EmptyHallState` | Placeholder shown when no artifacts exist |
| `"world-stats-ribbon"` | `WorldStatsRibbon` | Top-row stats grid (artifacts, PLK fragments, recent updates, curator) |

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#6-15](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/types.ts#L6-L15) [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#12-35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#L12-L35)

### `buildWorldPlan` — Layout Algorithm

`buildWorldPlan` is a pure, deterministic function that takes a `BuildWorldPlanInput` and produces a `WorldPlan`. It does not call any API — all layout is computed client-side.

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#56-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L56-L191)

Mode selection is based on artifact count via `getMode()`:

| Artifact Count | Mode | Radius | Corridor Depth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0–8 | `"museum"` | 190 + hash offset | 620 |
| 9–40 | `"constellation"` | 260 + hash offset | 720 |
| 41+ | `"archive"` | 330 + hash offset | 920 |

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#44-54](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L44-L54)

Positioning uses `positionForArtifact()` — a hash-based radial layout. Each artifact is placed on a circle at angle `(index / total) * 2π`, with a radius determined by the mode plus a hash-derived offset. The selected artifact is always placed at center `{x:0, y:2, z:28, scale:1.18}`.

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#14-26](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L14-L26)

Accent color is picked by `pickAccent()` based on active tags and type filter:

- Tags matching `/archive|memory|journal/i` → `"gold"`
- `typeFilter === "image"` → `"purple"`
- `typeFilter === "code"` → `"emerald"`
- Default → `"cyan"`

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#28-42](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L28-L42)

Empty state: When no artifacts are present, the plan returns an `empty-hall-state` node with a message directing the user to Creation Corner, plus a `search-control-deck` and `curator-console`.

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#61-104](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L61-L104)

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#1-191](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/buildWorldPlan.ts#L1-L191)

### `renderWorldNode` — Node Dispatch

`renderWorldNode` is a switch-based dispatch function that maps each `WorldNodeKind` to its React component. It receives a `WorldNode` and `WorldRenderContext` and returns the appropriate JSX element.

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#12-35](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#L12-L35)

Each component receives the full `WorldRenderContext` so it can access callbacks and state without prop drilling.

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#1-36](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/renderWorldNode.tsx#L1-L36)

### `DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer` — Main Component

The top-level component that assembles the museum UI. It takes artifacts, archived artifacts, resonance links, filter state, stats, and callback handlers as props.

[client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#48-253](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#L48-L253)

Key behaviors:

1. Calls `buildWorldPlan()` via `useMemo` to compute the layout plan from current state [line 71-84]
2. Builds a `WorldRenderContext` object combining plan data and all callbacks [line 87-130]
3. Wraps everything in `WorldRendererProvider` for context access [line 159]
4. Renders a desktop stage (perspective-enabled 3D CSS container with `framer-motion` slow rotation animation) and a mobile corridor (flat list of artifact cards, capped at 20) [lines 199-247]
5. Supports keyboard navigation: Arrow keys cycle through artifacts, Enter opens the selected one [lines 132-153]

Desktop 3D Stage: Uses CSS `perspective: 1200px` and `preserve-3d` transform style. A `motion.div` wraps all stage nodes with a slow `rotateX/rotateY` animation (32-second loop), respecting `useReducedMotion`. [lines 203-214]

Mobile Fallback: A flat scrollable list with single-click to select and double-click to open. [lines 222-247]

Sources: [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#1-255](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#L1-L255)

### `useDynamicInnerWorld` Hook

The `useDynamicInnerWorld` hook fetches personality-profile–based artifact data from the server API endpoint `GET /api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world`. It calls `appFetchJson` and returns `{data, isLoading, error, refetch}`.

[client/src/hooks/useDynamicInnerWorld.ts#19-48](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useDynamicInnerWorld.ts#L19-L48)

The server endpoint (`api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world.ts`) uses `synthesizePersonalityProfile()` to build starter artifacts from personality dimensions. Each dimension becomes a `DynamicInnerWorldArtifact` with `id`, `type`, `title`, `summary`, `content`, `metadata` (confidence, mutationClass, traits), `salience`, and `sourceId`.

[api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world.ts#12-80](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world.ts#L12-L80)

Sources: [client/src/hooks/useDynamicInnerWorld.ts#1-48](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/hooks/useDynamicInnerWorld.ts#L1-L48) [api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world.ts#1-80](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/consciousness/dynamic-inner-world.ts#L1-L80)

### Resonance Links

Resonance links connect related artifacts within the Inner World. `buildDynamicInnerWorldResonanceLinks()` in `genEngineRoomWiring.ts` computes them by:

1. Extracting full text from each artifact (title + summary + tags + evidenceNodeIds + stripped HTML) [line 54-65]
2. Calling `scoreResonance()` for each candidate against the selected artifact [lines 136-154]
3. Filtering links with `score > 0`, sorting by score descending, and taking top 3 [lines 156-159]

The resulting `DynamicInnerWorldResonanceLink[]` objects have `{artifactId, title, score, reason}` and are rendered as `ResonanceRail` nodes in the world plan.

Sources: [client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#12-17](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#L12-L17) [client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#128-160](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/genEngineRoomWiring.ts#L128-L160)

### Synthesis Flow (`handleSynthesize`)

The `handleSynthesize` function at [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#311-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L311-L457) implements a two-step synthesis:

Synthesis Pipeline Sequence

Step 1: Local gen-engine synthesis — Calls `synthesizeArtifact()` from `genEngineClient` which runs the gen-engine locally (always succeeds). Then calls `scoreResonance()` for PLK resonance scoring. Then calls `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact()` to produce a Zod-validated `CodexArtifact`. [lines 339-381]

Step 2: Codex forge API — Attempts `POST /api/codex/forge` with the artifact and export formats `["html", "json"]`. If the API is unavailable, falls back to `buildLocalCodexManifest()` which produces a complete local manifest with `status: "ready"`. [lines 395-422]

Routing to Inner World: If `destination === "dynamic_inner_world"`, calls `appendResultToInnerWorld()` → `buildCreationCornerInnerWorldArtifact()` → `appendInnerWorldArtifact()`. This writes to localStorage and fires a `POST /api/inner-world/artifacts` to persist server-side. [lines 172-179, 442-448]

Sources: [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#311-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L311-L457)

### Server-Side Synthesis API

`POST /api/creation-corner/synthesize` — The server-side synthesis endpoint. [api/creation-corner/synthesize.ts#40-136](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/creation-corner/synthesize.ts#L40-L136)

1. Extracts `text`, `artifact_type`, `synthesis_style`, `destination`, `custom_title`, and `consent` from the request body [lines 46-66]
2. Maps legacy types to Codex types via `mapCreationCornerArtifactType()`, `mapCreationCornerStyle()`, `mapCreationCornerDestination()` [lines 56-58]
3. Calls `createArtifact()` from `shared/gen-engine` [lines 68-89]
4. Calls `scoreResonance()` for PLK scoring [lines 90-98]
5. Calls `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact()` to produce the Codex artifact [lines 100-106]
6. Returns a response with `id`, `title`, `content`, `plk_resonance_score`, `provenance`, `codex` manifest, and `review_required` flag [lines 116-136]

`GET/POST /api/creation-corner/blueprints` — CRUD for blueprints stored in the `blueprints` Supabase table. GET returns all blueprints for the authenticated user (max 180, ordered by `updated_at`). POST upserts a blueprint or deletes one (via `operation: "delete"`). [api/creation-corner/blueprints.ts#129-253](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/creation-corner/blueprints.ts#L129-L253)

A legacy redirect exists at `api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize.ts` which re-exports the synthesize handler directly. [api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize.ts#1](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/codex/legacy/creation-corner-synthesize.ts#L1-L1)

## `shared/codex/creationCorner.ts` — Legacy-to-Codex Bridge

This module bridges Creation Corner's legacy type vocabulary to the Codex artifact system's types. It defines three legacy type sets and provides mapping functions:

### Legacy Type Mappings

`mapCreationCornerCodexKind` — Maps 12 legacy artifact types to 8 `ArtifactKind` values:

| Legacy Type | → Codex `ArtifactKind` |
| --- | --- |
| `session_recap` | `session_recap` |
| `mind_map` | `mind_map` |

### `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact`

The core bridge function at [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#278-319](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L278-L319) It:

1. Maps the legacy type to `ArtifactKind` via `mapCreationCornerCodexKind()`
2. Builds a kind-specific `body` via `codexBodyForKind()` — each kind has its own shape (e.g., `session_recap` has `summary`, `decisions`, `nextActions`; `mind_map` has `nodes` and `edges`; `code_module` has `language`, `entryFile`, `files`) [lines 207-276]
3. Sets `securityClass: "private"`, `templateKey` from `getTemplateKey(kind)`, and `contractVersion: "codex.v1"`
4. Records provenance with `sourceType: "capture"`, `transform: "synthesize"`, `confidence: 0.72`, and a FNV-1a hash of the source text [lines 303-309]
5. Attaches two manifest items (`html` and `json`) via `createManifestItem()` [line 310]
6. Validates the result through `CodexArtifactSchema.parse()` (Zod) [line 318]

Sources: [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#207-319](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L207-L319)

## Artifact Persistence Layer

### `InnerWorldArtifactRecord`

The core artifact type stored in localStorage and synced to the server:

```
type InnerWorldArtifactRecord = {


id: string;


userId: string;


title: string;


summary: string;


sourceFileId: string | null;


html: string;


thumbnailUrl?: string;


createdAt: string;


updatedAt: string;


originRoom: FileRoomOrigin;  // "blackboard" | "creation_corner" | "dynamic_inner_world" | "external_scaffold" | "unknown"


evidenceNodeIds: string[];


tags: string[];


};
```

[client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#26-39](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#L26-L39)

### Storage Architecture

Artifacts use a localStorage-first, server-sync pattern:

- localStorage key: `gestaltview.innerWorldArtifacts.v1` [line 75]
- Max artifacts: 300 [line 85]
- Event bus: `CustomEvent("gestaltview:inner-world-artifacts-updated")` fired on every write [lines 79-82]
- Server sync: Every `appendInnerWorldArtifact()` call writes to localStorage and fires `createInnerWorldArtifactOnServer()` via `POST /api/inner-world/artifacts` [lines 440-444]
- Merge strategy: `mergeInnerWorldArtifacts()` uses last-write-wins based on `updatedAt` timestamp, then sorts by `updatedAt` descending [lines 414-438]

Sources: [client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#73-85](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#L73-L85) [client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#400-444](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#L400-L444) [client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#626-657](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#L626-L657)

### Export System

`buildCreationCornerExportFile()` in `creationCornerArtifacts.ts` generates downloadable files in 3 formats:

| Format | MIME Type | Builder Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | `text/html;charset=utf-8` | `buildCreationCornerHtml()` — full HTML document with Neural-Aurora dark theme |
| `json` | `application/json;charset=utf-8` | `JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)` |
| `markdown` | `text/markdown;charset=utf-8` | `buildCreationCornerMarkdown()` — content with title header |

[client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#99-125](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#L99-L125)

`buildCreationCornerInnerWorldArtifact()` converts an `ArtifactResult` into an `InnerWorldArtifactRecord` suitable for the Dynamic Inner World display, tagging it with `"creation-corner"`, `"dynamic-inner-world-showcase"`, the artifact type, generation mode, and Codex kind. [client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#127-156](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#L127-L156)

## Full Artifact Lifecycle

Artifact Lifecycle: Capture → Synthesis → Display

Sources: [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#311-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L311-L457) [client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#440-444](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/innerWorldFiles.ts#L440-L444) [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#71-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#L71-L84)

### Step-by-step walkthrough:

1. Capture: Raw material enters via the Blackboard Room (as blueprints), Transcriptory (via `sessionStorage` handoff using `TRANSCRIPTORY_CREATION_HANDOFF_KEY`), or direct text entry in the Creation Corner textarea. [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#248-260](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L248-L260)
2. Blueprint Hydration: Blueprints are loaded from localStorage via `readBlueprints()` and merged with server-side data via `loadCreationCornerBlueprintsFromServer()` → `mergeCreationCornerBlueprints()`. [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#274-288](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L274-L288) [client/src/lib/creationCornerContent.ts#107-128](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/creationCornerContent.ts#L107-L128)
3. Synthesis: The user selects an artifact type, synthesis style, and destination, then triggers `handleSynthesize()`. This calls the local gen-engine's `createArtifact()` and `scoreResonance()`. [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#339-372](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L339-L372)
4. Codex Artifact Construction: `buildCreationCornerCodexArtifact()` maps legacy types to Codex kinds, builds a kind-specific body, attaches provenance with a hash, and validates via Zod. [shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#278-319](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/codex/creationCorner.ts#L278-L319)
5. Codex Forge: The artifact is submitted to `POST /api/codex/forge`. On failure, a local manifest is built instead — the artifact still renders and downloads correctly. [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#395-422](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L395-L422)
6. Routing: If destination is `dynamic_inner_world`, `buildCreationCornerInnerWorldArtifact()` converts the result to an `InnerWorldArtifactRecord` and `appendInnerWorldArtifact()` writes it to localStorage and POSTs to the server. [client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#442-448](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/pages/CreationCornerPage.tsx#L442-L448) [client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#127-156](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/creationCornerArtifacts.ts#L127-L156)
7. Display: The Dynamic Inner World reads artifacts from localStorage, `buildWorldPlan()` computes the spatial layout, and `renderWorldNode()` dispatches each node to its component. [client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#71-84](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/dynamic-inner-world/world-renderer/DynamicWorldSpaceRenderer.tsx#L71-L84)

## Blueprint Management

Blueprints are intermediate artifacts that aggregate multiple captures into structured output packages.

### Client-Side

`creationCornerContent.ts` provides:

- `loadCreationCornerBlueprintsFromServer()` — `GET /api/creation-corner/blueprints` [line 130-141]
- `saveCreationCornerBlueprintToServer()` — `POST /api/creation-corner/blueprints` [line 143-161]
- `deleteCreationCornerBlueprintFromServer()` — POST with `operation: "delete"` [line 163-182]
- `materializeCreationCornerBlueprint()` — converts server record to client `CaptureBlueprint` [line 91-105]
- `mergeCreationCornerBlueprints()` — last-write-wins merge of local + remote [line 107-128]

### Server-Side

`api/creation-corner/blueprints.ts` persists to the `blueprints` Supabase table with columns: `id`, `user_id`, `title`, `status` (`"draft"` / `"ready"` / `"exported"`), `content` (JSONB with `summary`, `sourceOrbIds`, `captureCount`, `tags`, `outputs`), `created_at`, `updated_at`. # GATE Commerce System

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md?plain=1)

GATE is GestaltView's bespoke package builder and commerce engine. It allows buyers to configure custom software packages — selecting a pricing tier, data backend, delivery surfaces, operator packs, source bundles, and theme — and then purchase and receive a tailored deliverable. An AI "sidekick" assists throughout the drafting process, recommending configuration changes and scoring asset relevance. Stripe handles payment processing; completed orders trigger a build pipeline that composes a ZIP artifact from Handlebars templates and generated config files.

The barrel export at `shared/gate/index.ts` explicitly notes the constitutional boundary: *"GATE packages may only export reproducible behavioral frameworks, never persistent living DI identities"* ([shared/gate/index.ts#8](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/index.ts#L8-L8)), enforced via the DI-4 compatibility rule in `gateCompatibility.ts`.

Sources: [shared/gate/index.ts#1-82](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/index.ts#L1-L82) [config/gateCompatibility.ts#140-178](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L140-L178)

## Pricing Tiers

GATE offers four pricing tiers, each with a base price and optional add-ons. Prices are stored in cents in `config/gateCatalog.ts`.

| Tier | Base Price | Included Seats | Seat Overage | Recommended For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SOLO_SPARK` | $2,400 | 1 | — | Solo founders, coaches, consultants |
| `STUDIO` | $5,200 | varies | $420/seat | Knowledge-ops teams, developer orgs |
| `GROWTH` | $9,800 | varies | $280/seat | Agencies, white-label studios |
| `ENTERPRISE` | $18,500 | unlimited | — | Regulated/compliance-heavy orgs |

Additional premiums apply for non-default backends (Redis +$350, MongoDB +$420), delivery surfaces (CLI +$160, Windows +$280, iOS/Android +$520 each), operator packs ($150–$260 each), source bundles ($100–$180 each), and native installers (+$260). These are computed by `quoteGatePackage()` in `config/gatePricing.ts`.

Sources: [config/gateCatalog.ts#24-36](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCatalog.ts#L24-L36) [config/gatePricing.ts#14-137](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L14-L137)

## Use Cases and Configuration

Five pre-defined use cases in `config/gateUseCases.ts` provide opinionated defaults for common buyer scenarios:

| Use Case Slug | Label | Default Tier | Default Backend | Default Surfaces |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `founder-operator-companion` | Founder / Operator Companion | `SOLO_SPARK` | supabase | web, cli |
| `knowledge-ops-copilot` | Knowledge Ops Copilot | `STUDIO` | supabase | web, windows |
| `developer-tools-assistant` | Developer Tools Assistant | `STUDIO` | supabase | web, cli, windows |
| `healthcare-compliance-assistant` | Healthcare Compliance Assistant | `ENTERPRISE` | supabase | web, windows |
| `white-label-client-studio` | White-Label Client Studio | `GROWTH` | supabase | web, windows, cli |

Each use case specifies recommended operator packs, source bundles, backend/surface affinities, and a default theme preset. The engine function `applyUseCaseDefaults()` applies these defaults to a draft when a use case is selected.

For details on the full schema definitions, engine functions, and sidekick logic, see [Package Builder, Pricing & Sidekick](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#8.1).

Sources: [config/gateUseCases.ts#3-142](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateUseCases.ts#L3-L142) [shared/gate/engine.ts#49-74](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L49-L74)

## Draft Lifecycle and Sidekick

A GATE package starts as a `PackageConfigDraft` — a Zod-validated object containing every configuration choice. The draft lifecycle progresses through these statuses defined in `GateDraftStatusSchema`:

```
draft → saved → awaiting_payment → paid → provisioning → packaged → delivered


↘ failed


review_requested ↗ (if compatibility blocks)
```

The Sidekick is an AI assistant embedded in the draft editing flow. It operates through the `gate-keeper` embodiment profile with a `wry-precise-custodial` voice tone. Each sidekick session tracks structured state (`GateSidekickStructuredState`) including buyer context, recommendations, and pending clarifications. The sidekick proposes bounded actions (`suggest_field_update`, `suggest_package_component`, `suggest_asset_inclusion`, `propose_safe_transformation`, `approval_required`) that the buyer can accept or reject.

Key sidekick functions from `shared/gate/sidekick.ts`:

- `buildGateSidekickSystemPrompt()` — constructs the embodiment-aware system prompt
- `composeGateSidekickReply()` — generates a sidekick response for a given user message
- `synchronizeGateSidekickState()` — re-scores assets and actions against the current draft
- `applyGateSidekickActionToDraft()` — applies an accepted action to the draft

For details, see [Package Builder, Pricing & Sidekick](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#8.1).

Sources: [shared/gate/schemas.ts#23-33](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/schemas.ts#L23-L33) [shared/gate/schemas.ts#62-97](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/schemas.ts#L62-L97) [shared/gate/schemas.ts#143-145](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/schemas.ts#L143-L145) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L53) [shared/gate/index.ts#73-81](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/index.ts#L73-L81)

## Checkout and Fulfillment Pipeline

Order Lifecycle

The handler at `api/gate/_handler.ts` uses Vercel's catch-all route (`api/gate/[...path].ts`) to implement path-based routing across all GATE endpoints. Key routes:

| Method | Path | Handler Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/drafts` | `createGateDraft` | Create new draft |
| `GET` | `/api/gate/drafts/:id` | `getGateDraft` | Retrieve draft analysis |
| `PATCH` | `/api/gate/drafts/:id` | `updateGateDraft` | Patch draft fields |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/drafts/:id/sidekick` | `sendGateSidekickMessage` | Chat with sidekick |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/drafts/:id/validate` | `validateGateDraft` | Validate draft |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/checkout` | `handleCheckout` | Create Stripe session |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/webhooks/stripe` | `handleStripeWebhook` | Process payment event |
| `GET` | `/api/gate/orders/:id` | `getGateOrderDetail` | Order details |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/orders/:id/redeem` | `redeemGateArtifactAccess` | Get download URL |
| `GET` | `/api/gate/orders/:id/download` | `resolveGateDownload` | Download ZIP artifact |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/build-jobs/:id/run` | `runGateBuildJob` | Admin: trigger build |
| `POST` | `/api/gate/build-jobs/:id/regenerate` | `regenerateGateBuildJob` | Admin: regenerate |

Build jobs and admin endpoints require an `X-Gate-Admin-Key` header in production. Mock payments are available for non-production environments or admin-authorized requests.

For details on the full API, Stripe integration, build pipeline, and fulfillment, see [Checkout, Orders & Fulfillment](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#8.2).

Sources: [api/gate/\_handler.ts#242-395](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L242-L395) [api/gate/\_handler.ts#79-183](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L79-L183) [api/gate/\_handler.ts#185-240](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L185-L240) [api/gate/[...path].ts:1](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main)

| `service.ts` | `createGateDraft`, `updateGateDraft`, `sendGateSidekickMessage`, `createGateOrderForCheckout`, `markGateOrderPaid`, `runGateBuildJob` | Core business logic; delegates to repository or local store based on `hasGateSupabaseConfig()` |
| `builder.ts` | `composeGatePackageArtifact` | Composes the deliverable ZIP: stages dirs, renders templates, writes configs, creates archive, uploads to storage |
| `repository.ts` | `insertGateDraft`, `upsertGateBuyer`, `insertGateOrder`, `upsertGateArtifact`, etc. | Supabase CRUD layer; maps camelCase schemas ↔ snake\_case DB columns |
| `store.ts` | `loadGateState`, `saveGateState` | Local JSON file fallback when Supabase is unavailable; persists `GatePersistedState` |
| `supabase.ts` | `hasGateSupabaseConfig`, `getGateSupabaseAdmin`, `getGateStorageBucket` | Supabase client factory; checks for `SUPABASE_URL` + `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` |
| `zip.ts` | `createZipFromDirectory` | Zero-dependency ZIP creator (custom CRC-32 + PKZIP headers) |
| `constants.ts` | `GATE_TABLES`, `GATE_LOCAL_STORAGE_BUCKET`, `GATE_STORAGE_PATH_PREFIX` | Table names and storage path constants |

The `GATE_TABLES` constant maps logical table names to their Supabase counterparts: `gate_buyers`, `gate_package_drafts`, `gate_orders`, `gate_order_items`, `gate_build_jobs`, `gate_artifacts`, `gate_support_requests`.

## Compatibility Rules and Constitutional Invariants

Before checkout, every draft passes through `evaluateGateCompatibility()` in `config/gateCompatibility.ts`. This evaluates a set of `CompatibilityRule` objects, each with a `when` predicate, a severity (`error`, `warning`, `info`), and an optional `manualReview` flag. If any rule fires with severity `error` or `manualReview: true`, the checkout mode switches to `request_review` instead of `pay_now`.

Notable constitutional invariant guards:

- `di_identity_export_violation` — Blocks packages referencing "living DI", "persistent digital intelligence", or "transfer DI". Enforces DI-4: *"GATE may only export reproducible behavioral frameworks… never a persistent DI instance or private memories."* [config/gateCompatibility.ts#146-178](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L146-L178)
- `missing_provenance_receipt` — Requires provenance references when packages include embodiment profiles [config/gateCompatibility.ts#180-207](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L180-L207)
- `missing_embodiment_compile_run` — Warns when embodiment packages lack a pipeline run reference [config/gateCompatibility.ts#209-229](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L209-L229)

Sources: [config/gateCompatibility.ts#54-364](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L54-L364)

---

## Build Artifact Composition

When a build job runs, `composeGatePackageArtifact()` in `server/gate/builder.ts` creates a staging directory and populates it with:

1. `package.manifest.json` — Full build manifest with buyer profile, configuration, compatibility, quote, deliverables, and provenance
2. Config files — `backend.env.template`, `theme.tokens.json`, `operator-packs.json`, `source-bundles.json`
3. Documentation — Rendered from 5 Handlebars templates in `templates/gate/`:
   - `README.md.tpl`, `ONBOARDING.md.tpl`, `ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md.tpl`, `DELIVERABLES.md.tpl`, `SUPPORT.md.tpl`
4. Branding — Theme preset JSON
5. Install scripts — `install.sh` and `install.ps1` (conditionally based on delivery surfaces)

The sidekick's asset selections control which files are included. Each asset has a `selectionScore` (0–1) computed by `scoreAsset()`, and only assets with `included: true` are packaged. The staged directory is then zipped by `createZipFromDirectory()` — a dependency-free ZIP implementation — and optionally uploaded to Supabase Storage.

For details on the full build pipeline and template rendering, see [Checkout, Orders & Fulfillment](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#8.2).

Sources: [server/gate/builder.ts#252-556](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L252-L556) [server/gate/zip.ts#61-133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/zip.ts#L61-L133) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#456-471](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L456-L471)

## Client SDK

The client-side SDK in `client/src/lib/gateApi.ts` provides typed wrappers around all GATE API endpoints. Each function uses Zod parsing (`GateDraftAnalysisSchema.parse`, `GateCheckoutResponseSchema.parse`, etc.) to validate server responses at runtime. Key exports:

- `createGateDraft()` / `fetchGateDraft()` / `updateGateDraft()` — Draft CRUD
- `sendGateSidekickMessage()` / `applyGateSidekickAction()` — Sidekick interactions
- `validateGateDraft()` — Pre-checkout validation
- `checkoutGateDraft()` — Initiates Stripe checkout
- `fetchGateOrder()` / `redeemGateArtifact()` — Order retrieval and artifact download

Sources: [client/src/lib/gateApi.ts#54-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/lib/gateApi.ts#L54-L170)

# Package Builder, Pricing & Sidekick

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/gestaltview\_gpt\_actions\_comprehensive.openapi.yaml](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/gestaltview_gpt_actions_comprehensive.openapi.yaml)

This page documents the GATE (GestaltView Agent Trainer Engine) package builder subsystem — the deterministic configuration, pricing, recommendation, and AI sidekick engine that powers bespoke software package creation. The system spans four code layers: Zod-validated schemas (`shared/gate/schemas.ts`), pure engine functions (`shared/gate/engine.ts`), an AI sidekick module (`shared/gate/sidekick.ts`), and configuration catalogs (`config/gate*.ts`). Handlebars templates (`templates/gate/`) define the deliverable documents rendered into each package.

## Zod Schemas (`shared/gate/schemas.ts`)

The schema file defines the complete type system for the GATE commerce pipeline using Zod. Every data structure — from tier enums to full order details — is runtime-validated.

| `DeliverySurfaceSchema` | `ios`, `android`, `windows`, `cli`, `web` | Deployment targets |
| `GateDraftStatusSchema` | `draft` → `saved` → `awaiting_payment` → `paid` → `provisioning` → `packaged` → `delivered` / `failed` / `review_requested` | Full draft lifecycle |
| `GateBuildStatusSchema` | `queued` → `running` → `packaged` → `delivered` / `failed` | Build job lifecycle |
| `GateCheckoutModeSchema` | `pay_now`, `request_review` | Checkout routing |

### `quoteGatePackage()` — Pricing Engine

The `quoteGatePackage()` function in `config/gatePricing.ts` computes a deterministic `PriceQuote` from a `PackageConfigDraftInput`. It builds a line-item `breakdown` array by summing:

1. Base tier price — from `gateTierCatalogById`
2. Seat overage — `(seatsRequested - includedSeats) × seatOveragePriceCents` when applicable
3. Backend premium — Supabase: $0, Redis: $350, MongoDB: $420
4. Surface premiums — Web: $0, CLI: $160, Windows: $280, iOS: $520, Android: $520
5. Operator pack premiums — looked up via `gateOperatorPackBySlug`
6. Source bundle premiums — looked up via `gateSourceBundleBySlug`
7. Native installer — $260 if `wantsNativeInstaller`

Each item gets a `kind` tag (`base`, `seat_overage`, `backend`, `surface`, `addon`, `installer`) for breakdown display.

Sources: [config/gatePricing.ts#14-137](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gatePricing.ts#L14-L137)

Pricing Calculation Flow

## Compatibility Engine (`config/gateCompatibility.ts`)

The `evaluateGateCompatibility()` function runs a `PackageConfigDraftInput` through a rule set of `CompatibilityRule` objects. Each rule has an `id`, `severity`, predicate (`when`), message generator, optional `resolution`, and `manualReview` flag.

### Rule Categories

Infrastructure Rules:

| Rule ID | Severity | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobile-surfaces-need-web-note` | `warning` | iOS/Android selected without Web |
| `redis-primary-document-store` | `error` | Redis backend + document-SOT use case |
| `mongodb-fit-warning` | `warning` | MongoDB backend + non-document-oriented use case |
| `seat-cap` | `error` | Seats exceed tier max |
| `native-installer-scope` | `error` | Installer requested for non-Windows/CLI surfaces |
| `pack-backend-mismatch` | `info` | Agent Source Starter Bundle with non-Supabase backend |
| `custom-notes-review` | `warning` | Custom notes contain keywords like `sso`, `hipaa`, `on-prem` |

Constitutional Invariant Guards (DI-4, DI-2, DI-3):

| Rule ID | Severity | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `di_identity_export_violation` | `error` | Custom notes mention exporting a living DI identity |
| `missing_provenance_receipt` | `error` | Embodiment/identity references without provenance |
| `missing_embodiment_compile_run` | `warning` | Embodiment references without pipeline run ID |
| `missing_checksum_manifest` | `warning` | Artifact references without checksum |
| `route_assignment_drift` | `warning` | Route assignments without registry reference |
| `legacy_table_dependency` | `warning` | References to legacy transitional tables |

The function returns a `CompatibilityResult` with `findings`, `blocking` (true if any error-severity findings), `requiresManualReview`, `checkoutMode` (`pay_now` or `request_review`), and lists of `enabledFeatures` / `excludedFeatures`.

Sources: [config/gateCompatibility.ts#12-364](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L12-L364)

## Engine Functions (`shared/gate/engine.ts`)

### `buildDefaultGateDraftInput(overrides?)`

Merges partial overrides into `defaultPackageConfigDraftInput`, deduplicating `deliverySurfaces`, `operatorPackSlugs`, and `sourceBundleSlugs`.

[shared/gate/engine.ts#31-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L31-L47)

### `applyUseCaseDefaults(currentDraft, useCaseSlug)`

Applies a use case's defaults (tier, backend, surfaces, theme) to the current draft. Clamps `seatsRequested` to the tier's `includedSeats` if not unlimited.

[shared/gate/engine.ts#49-74](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L49-L74)

### `recommendGatePackage(draft)`

Builds a `GateRecommendations` object by scoring operator packs, source bundles, and surfaces. Uses the use case's `recommendedOperatorPackSlugs` / `recommendedSourceBundleSlugs` / `surfaceAffinities` as base scores (+5), then applies context-aware boosts:

- `supabase` backend → `persistent-memory-foundation` (+2)
- `cli` surface → `devops-terminal-pack` (+3)
- `web` surface → `product-ops-bundle` (+2)

Results are sorted by score and limited to top 3 per category.

[shared/gate/engine.ts#76-149](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L76-L149)

### `buildGateDeliverablesPreview(draft)`

Returns a list of file paths that will be included in the package ZIP: `package.manifest.json`, config files, docs (`README.md`, `ONBOARDING.md`, `ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md`, `DELIVERABLES.md`, `SUPPORT.md`), install scripts, and a theme branding JSON if the preset exists.

[shared/gate/engine.ts#151-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L151-L170)

### `analyzeGateDraft(draft)`

The top-level analysis function. Calls `evaluateGateCompatibility()`, `quoteGatePackage()`, and `recommendGatePackage()`, then assembles the full `GateDraftAnalysis` response envelope including the price snapshot and an empty sidekick state.

[shared/gate/engine.ts#172-190](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L172-L190)

### Utility Functions

- `sanitizeSelection(values, allowed)` — Filters an array to only allowed keys
- `resolvePackTitles(slugs)` — Maps slugs to human-readable pack titles
- `resolveBundleTitles(slugs)` — Maps slugs to human-readable bundle titles

[shared/gate/engine.ts#192-209](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L192-L209)

## Sidekick AI Module (`shared/gate/sidekick.ts`)

The sidekick module implements a deterministic AI package-builder assistant that helps buyers compose their GATE package through conversational interaction. It operates under the `gate-keeper` embodiment profile and follows strict response contracts.

### Sidekick Response Contract

The `GATE_SIDEKICK_RESPONSE_CONTRACT` array defines 5 invariant rules for sidekick behavior:

1. Keep tone precise, warm, slightly eccentric, and commercially trustworthy
2. Recommend only 5 bounded action types
3. Never imply mutation of protected logic (auth, billing, permissions, runtime)
4. Prefer one sharp clarification over vague filler
5. Every turn should tighten the brief, surface boundaries, or name the next move

### Protected Logic Boundary

A `PROTECTED_LOGIC_PATTERN` regex blocks sidekick auto-mutations touching: `auth`, `billing`, `payment`, `permissions`, `rbac`, `runtime`, `execute`, `deployment pipeline`, `production deploy`, `stripe`, `webhook`, `api key`, `sso`, `oauth`.

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-198](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L198)

### Key Public Functions

#### `buildGateSidekickSystemPrompt(draft)`

Constructs the system prompt by calling `buildEmbodimentSystemPrompt()` with the `gate-keeper` profile, injecting the response contract and runtime directives.

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#904-918](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L904-L918)

#### `createGateSidekickState(draft)`

Initializes a fresh `GateSidekickState` for a new draft:

1. Resolves the embodiment profile via `getGateSidekickProfile()`
2. Builds initial asset selections via `buildAssetSelections()`
3. Computes structured state (recommendations + pending clarifications)
4. Creates a welcome session with a `sidekick` turn containing tier-aware greeting
5. Generates initial suggested actions via `buildSuggestedActions()`

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#920-981](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L920-L981)

#### `synchronizeGateSidekickState(draft, currentState?)`

Re-synchronizes the sidekick state after any draft mutation. Recomputes asset selections, structured state, suggested actions, and transformations while preserving existing turns and session history.

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#983-1015](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L983-L1015)

#### `extractGateBuyerContextPatchFromMessage(message)`

Parses a free-text user message to extract structured buyer context. Uses regex-based detection for:

- Industry: healthcare, finance, agency, education, developer tools
- Channels: web, cli, windows, ios, android, mobile, email, sms, discord, slack
- Deployment constraints: must/cannot/need to/deploy/self-host/on-prem/hipaa/soc 2/sso
- Outcomes: sentences containing need/want/trying to/looking to/must/goal/outcome/launch/ship
- Audience: text following "for ..." patterns

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#1032-1073](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L1032-L1073)

#### `composeGateSidekickReply(params)`

The main conversation handler. Extracts a buyer context patch from the user message, patches the draft, synchronizes state, and composes a reply message. Returns the patched draft, next state, reply text, structured state, and tool calls (`update_buyer_profile`, `select_assets`).

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#1075-1136](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L1075-L1136)

#### `applyGateSidekickActionToDraft(draft, action, currentState)`

Applies a proposed action to the draft. Handles:

- Field updates: `tier`, `themePresetId`, `useCaseSlug`, `deliverySurfaces`
- Package components: `operatorPack` and `sourceBundle` additions
- Asset inclusions: marks the target asset as `included: true`

The action's status is set to `applied` after execution.

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#1138-1217](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L1138-L1217)

### Internal Derivation Functions

The sidekick uses several internal heuristic functions to recommend package configuration:

`deriveRecommendedTier(draft)` — Regex-based escalation logic:

- Compliance keywords (health, hipaa, soc 2, governance) → `ENTERPRISE`
- 25+ seats, white-label keywords, or mobile surfaces → `GROWTH`
- 8+ seats or use case recommends STUDIO → `STUDIO`
- Otherwise keeps current tier

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#300-337](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L300-L337)

`deriveRecommendedUseCase(draft)` — Regex routing:

- Health/clinic/hospital/hipaa/compliance/regulated → `healthcare-compliance-assistant`
- Agency/studio/white label/client workspaces → `white-label-client-studio`
- Otherwise keeps current use case

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#339-359](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L339-L359)

`deriveRecommendedTheme(draft)` — Regex matching:

- Health/clinical/compliance/neutral/conservative → `atlas-neutral`
- Agency/brand/presentation/white label/luxury → `copper-signal`
- Otherwise uses use case default

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#361-381](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L361-L381)

`scoreAsset(draft, asset)` — Computes a 0–0.98 relevance score:

- Base: 0.6 (core) or 0.45 (optional)
- Tag match: +0.06 per matching context token (max 0.28)
- Branding boost: +0.08 if asset has "branding" tag and draft has brand color/logo
- Installer boost: +0.10 if installer asset and Windows/CLI surfaces

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#456-471](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L456-L471)

## API Routes (`api/gate/_handler.ts`)

The GATE API is served through a catch-all handler at `api/gate/[...path].ts` that dispatches to `_handler.ts`. Path segments are parsed from the `path` query parameter and matched to specific operations.

### Route Table

| Method | Path Pattern | Handler | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/gate/drafts` | `createGateDraft()` | Create a new package draft |
| `GET` | `/gate/drafts/:id` | `getGateDraft()` | Fetch draft analysis |
| `PATCH` | `/gate/drafts/:id` | `updateGateDraft()` | Patch draft fields |
| `POST` | `/gate/drafts/:id/sidekick` | `sendGateSidekickMessage()` | Send message to sidekick AI |
| `POST` | `/gate/drafts/:id/sidekick/actions/:actionId` | `applyGateSidekickAction()` | Apply a sidekick-proposed action |
| `POST` | `/gate/drafts/:id/validate` | `validateGateDraft()` | Run compatibility validation |
| `POST` | `/gate/checkout` | `handleCheckout()` | Initiate Stripe checkout or manual review |
| `POST` | `/gate/webhooks/stripe` | `handleStripeWebhook()` | Stripe webhook receiver |
| `GET` | `/gate/orders/:id` | `getGateOrderDetail()` | Fetch order details |
| `POST` | `/gate/orders/:id/redeem` | `redeemGateArtifactAccess()` | Redeem artifact access key |
| `GET` | `/gate/orders/:id/download` | `resolveGateDownload()` | Download package ZIP |
| `POST` | `/gate/build-jobs/:id/run` | `runGateBuildJob()` | Admin: trigger build job |
| `POST` | `/gate/build-jobs/:id/regenerate` | `regenerateGateBuildJob()` | Admin: regenerate build |
| `POST` | `/gate/support-request` | `createGateSupportRequest()` | Submit support request |

Admin routes (`build-jobs/*`) require the `X-Gate-Admin-Key` header.

Sources: [api/gate/\_handler.ts#242-395](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L242-L395)

### Checkout Flow

The `handleCheckout()` function in `_handler.ts` handles three modes:

1. Manual review — If compatibility returns `request_review`, responds with 202 and a redirect URL
2. Simulated — If `mockPayment: true` with valid admin key (or non-production without Stripe), immediately marks order paid and runs the build job
3. Stripe — Creates a Stripe Checkout Session with `payment` mode, attaches `order_id`, `draft_id`, `config_hash`, and `buyer_email` as metadata

The webhook handler processes `checkout.session.completed` events by calling `markGateOrderPaid()` then `runGateBuildJob()`.

Sources: [api/gate/\_handler.ts#79-240](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L79-L240)

## Constitutional Invariant Enforcement

GATE enforces Constitutional Invariant DI-4 at the compatibility layer. The `di_identity_export_violation` rule blocks any package whose custom notes reference exporting a "living DI," "persistent digital intelligence," or similar phrases. The error message explicitly states:

> *"GestaltView Constitutional Invariant DI-4 prohibits packaging or transferring a living DI identity. GATE may only export reproducible behavioral frameworks, scenario libraries, evaluation rubrics, and implementation scaffolds — never a persistent DI instance or private memories."*

Additional governance rules enforce provenance receipt requirements for embodiment profiles (`missing_provenance_receipt`), pipeline run traceability (`missing_embodiment_compile_run`), checksum manifests for artifacts (`missing_checksum_manifest`), registry consistency for route assignments (`route_assignment_drift`), and canonical table usage (`legacy_table_dependency`).

Sources: [config/gateCompatibility.ts#140-310](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/config/gateCompatibility.ts#L140-L310) [shared/gate/index.ts#7-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/index.ts#L7-L9)

# Checkout, Orders & Fulfillment

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/gestaltview\_gpt\_actions\_examples.json](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/chatgpt-apps/actions/gestaltview_gpt_actions_examples.json)

This page documents the GATE commerce flow end-to-end: the REST API handler with catch-all path routing, Stripe checkout integration, draft CRUD with sidekick AI, validation, build job management, order fulfillment (redeem, download), the `server/gate/` business logic layer, and the DI-4 Constitutional Invariant enforcement.

## Architecture Overview

The GATE commerce subsystem is split into two layers:

| Layer | Directory | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| API (handler) | `api/gate/` | HTTP routing, Stripe session creation, webhook verification, CORS, admin auth |
| Service (server) | `server/gate/` | Business logic, persistence (Supabase or local JSON), artifact composition, ZIP creation |

All API routes funnel through a single catch-all handler that parses path segments and dispatches to service functions. The service layer uses a dual-persistence strategy: Supabase when configured, local JSON file when not.

Sources: [api/gate/\_handler.ts#1-399](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L1-L399) [server/gate/service.ts#1-69](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1-L69)

## Catch-All Path Router

The GATE API uses Vercel's catch-all route pattern via `api/gate/[...path].ts`, which re-exports the centralized `_handler.ts`. The handler resolves path segments from `req.query.path` and performs manual segment-based routing in a single `handler()` function.

```
api/gate/[...path].ts  →  re-exports _handler.ts


api/gate/_delegate.ts  →  delegateGateRequest() injects path segments, calls handler


api/gate/_handler.ts   →  resolvePathSegments() + segment matching → service functions
```

`resolvePathSegments()` extracts segments from the Vercel query parameter, handling both array and string forms:

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#45-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L45-L50)

The `allowOptions()` function applies CORS headers for `GET`, `POST`, `PATCH`, and `OPTIONS` methods, and permits the custom `Stripe-Signature` and `X-Gate-Admin-Key` headers:

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#52-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L52-L64)

The `_delegate.ts` module provides `delegateGateRequest()` for individual route files (e.g., `checkout.ts`, `draft.ts`) that need to forward into the centralized handler:

[api/gate/\_delegate.ts#17-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_delegate.ts#L17-L28)

Sources: [api/gate/[...path].ts:1](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main), [api/gate/\_handler.ts#45-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L45-L64) [api/gate/\_delegate.ts#5-28](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_delegate.ts#L5-L28)

## Stripe Checkout Integration

### Checkout Flow (`POST /gate/checkout`)

`handleCheckout()` at [api/gate/\_handler.ts#79-183](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L79-L183) orchestrates the checkout:

1. Calls `createGateOrderForCheckout()` which validates the draft via `GateCheckoutRequestSchema`, creates a `GateOrder` and `GateOrderItem[]` from the draft analysis, and persists them.
2. If `compatibility.checkoutMode === "request_review"`, returns HTTP 202 with `mode: "manual_review"` — no Stripe session is created.
3. If Stripe is not configured in production, returns 503 `gate_payment_not_configured`.
4. Supports mock payments for development: when `mockPayment === true` and the request passes `isAdminRequest()`, it calls `markGateOrderPaid()` and `runGateBuildJob()` immediately, returning `mode: "simulated"`.
5. For real payments, creates a `stripe.checkout.sessions.create()` with `mode: "payment"`, a single line item containing the `totalCents` from the analysis quote, and metadata linking `order_id`, `draft_id`, and `config_hash`.

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#147-172](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L147-L172)

6. Calls `attachStripeSessionToOrder()` to persist the Stripe session ID on the order record.

The Stripe client is initialized at module scope using `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` with API version `2024-06-20`:

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#25-32](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L25-L32)

### Webhook Handler (`POST /gate/webhooks/stripe`)

`handleStripeWebhook()` at [api/gate/\_handler.ts#185-240](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L185-L240) handles Stripe event verification:

1. Verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header against `STRIPE_GATE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` using `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent()`.
2. On `checkout.session.completed` events, extracts the `order_id` from session metadata or `client_reference_id`.
3. Calls `markGateOrderPaid()` with the `payment_intent` string, which transitions the order to `paid` status, creates a build job if none exists, and then calls `runGateBuildJob()` to immediately start artifact composition.

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#214-237](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L214-L237)
