## Draft CRUD & Sidekick AI

### Draft Creation & Mutation

Drafts are created via `createGateDraft()` at [server/gate/service.ts#421-439](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L421-L439) The function:

1. Normalizes input via `normalizeDraftInput()` which merges with `buildDefaultGateDraftInput()` defaults and resolves use-case overrides for tier, backend, and theme.
2. Calls `hydrateDraft()` to assign a UUID, SHA-256 `configHash`, initial status `"draft"`, and timestamps.
3. Runs `analyzeGateDraftWithSidekick()` which combines `analyzeGateDraft()` (compatibility check + pricing quote + recommendations) with `synchronizeGateSidekickState()`.
4. Persists to Supabase via `insertGateDraft()` or to local JSON state via `saveGateState()`.

Draft updates via `updateGateDraft()` at [server/gate/service.ts#460-499](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L460-L499) apply a `PackageConfigDraftPatchSchema`-validated patch, recompute the `configHash`, and re-analyze.

Validation (`validateGateDraft()`) simply delegates to `getGateDraft()`, returning the full analysis including compatibility findings:

[server/gate/service.ts#501-503](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L501-L503)

### Config Hash Integrity

Every draft has a SHA-256 `configHash` computed by `hashDraft()` at [server/gate/service.ts#106-108](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L106-L108) This hash is derived from the `stableDraftPayload()` — a deterministic JSON serialization with sorted arrays — ensuring that the hash changes only when the configuration materially changes. The hash is stored on orders and used by the build system to detect configuration drift.

### Sidekick AI

The sidekick is an AI-assisted package configuration advisor. `sendGateSidekickMessage()` at [server/gate/service.ts#505-633](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L505-L633):

1. Parses user input via `GateSidekickMessageRequestSchema`.
2. Synchronizes sidekick state with the current draft via `synchronizeGateSidekickState()` from `shared/gate/sidekick.ts`.
3. Composes a reply via `composeGateSidekickReply()` which analyzes buyer context, derives tier/use-case/theme recommendations, selects relevant assets, and generates bounded action suggestions.
4. Creates user and assistant `GateSidekickTurn` records.
5. Applies any buyer context updates from the reply to the draft via `applyDraftPatch()`.
6. Persists the updated draft and sidekick state.

The sidekick operates under strict response contracts defined in `shared/gate/sidekick.ts`:

[shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L53)

Key sidekick constraints:

- Only bounded actions are recommended: `suggest_field_update`, `suggest_package_component`, `suggest_asset_inclusion`, `propose_safe_transformation`, or `approval_required`
- Protected logic (auth, billing, payment, permissions, runtime) is detected via regex and blocked from mutation
- Each turn produces `structuredState` containing `buyerContext`, `recommendations`, and `pendingClarifications`

Sidekick actions can be applied via `applyGateSidekickAction()` at [server/gate/service.ts#635-757](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L635-L757) which calls `applyGateSidekickActionToDraft()` from `shared/gate/sidekick.ts` and records a system turn with `actor: "system"`.

Sources: [server/gate/service.ts#421-503](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L421-L503) [server/gate/service.ts#505-757](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L505-L757) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L53) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-199](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L199)

## Build Job Management

### Build Job Lifecycle

Build jobs track the status of package artifact composition. The status lifecycle:

`createBuildJob()` at [server/gate/service.ts#324-339](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L324-L339) initializes a job with `buildVersion: 1`, `status: "queued"`, and an empty `buildLog`.

### `runGateBuildJob()`

Defined at [server/gate/service.ts#1037-1333](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1037-L1333) this is the core build execution function:

1. Loads the build job, order, and draft records.
2. Transitions job to `status: "running"` and order to `orderStatus: "provisioning"`.
3. Calls `composeGatePackageArtifact()` from `builder.ts`.
4. On success: persists the artifact, transitions to `"delivered"`, appends the manifest to sidekick `manifestHistory`.
5. On failure: transitions to `"failed"`, stores `errorCode: "build_failed"` and the error message.

### `regenerateGateBuildJob()`

At [server/gate/service.ts#1407-1424](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1407-L1424) resolves the build job's order and delegates to `regenerateGateBuildForOrder()` which creates a new build job with an incremented `buildVersion`, resets the order to `"paid"`, and calls `runGateBuildJob()`.

Sources: [server/gate/service.ts#324-339](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L324-L339) [server/gate/service.ts#1037-1333](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1037-L1333) [server/gate/service.ts#1335-1424](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1335-L1424)

## Artifact Composition (`builder.ts`)

The `composeGatePackageArtifact()` function at [server/gate/builder.ts#252-556](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L252-L556) builds the deliverable ZIP package:

### Build Steps

| Step | Log Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stage | `stage` | Create staging directories: `docs/`, `config/`, `branding/` |
| Manifest | `compose` | Write `package.manifest.json` with full order/draft/buyer/quote/compatibility data |
| Config | `compose` | Write `backend.env.template`, `theme.tokens.json`, `operator-packs.json`, `source-bundles.json` |
| Branding | `compose` | Write theme preset JSON to `branding/` directory |
| Docs | `docs` | Render Handlebars `.tpl` templates from `templates/gate/` with buyer-specific replacements |
| Scripts | `scripts` | Generate `install.sh` and `install.ps1` based on delivery surfaces |
| ZIP | `zip` | Create ZIP via `createZipFromDirectory()` |
| Upload | `upload` | Upload to Supabase Storage bucket (if configured) |
| Finalize | `finalize` | Record SHA-256 checksum and generate download token |

### Template Rendering

Five Handlebars templates are rendered with buyer-specific values:

[server/gate/builder.ts#442-469](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L442-L469)

| Template | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md.tpl` | `docs/README.md` |
| `ONBOARDING.md.tpl` | `docs/ONBOARDING.md` |
| `ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md.tpl` | `docs/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md` |
| `DELIVERABLES.md.tpl` | `docs/DELIVERABLES.md` |
| `SUPPORT.md.tpl` | `docs/SUPPORT.md` |

Template variables include `companyName`, `tierLabel`, `backend`, `surfaces`, `operatorPacks`, `sourceBundles`, `totalPrice`, `compatibilityWarnings`, and `nextActions`.

[server/gate/builder.ts#381-440](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L381-L440)

### Asset Selection

The sidekick's `assetSelections` control which files are included. Each asset has a `documentId` and an `included` flag. The builder's `isIncluded()` function checks if the asset is selected, falling back to including everything when no explicit selections exist:

[server/gate/builder.ts#278-284](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L278-L284)

### ZIP Creation

The `createZipFromDirectory()` function at [server/gate/zip.ts#61-133](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/zip.ts#L61-L133) is a zero-dependency ZIP implementation that:

- Walks the staging directory recursively via `walkFiles()`
- Computes CRC-32 checksums per file using a lookup table
- Writes local file headers, central directory entries, and end-of-central-directory record
- Uses the STORE method (no compression, `method: 0`)

[server/gate/zip.ts#4-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/zip.ts#L4-L21) — CRC-32 table and computation

## Order Fulfillment

### Order Detail (`GET /gate/orders/:id`)

`getGateOrderDetail()` at [server/gate/service.ts#1426-1500](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L1426-L1500) (approx.) assembles a complete `GateOrderDetail` object containing:

- The hydrated order with recalculated totals via `hydrateOrderForDetail()`
- The draft analysis with sidekick state
- Line items from `listGateOrderItems()`
- Build jobs from `listGateBuildJobs()`
- Artifacts from `listGateArtifacts()` (mapped through `publicArtifact()` which masks the download token)
- Support requests from `listGateSupportRequests()`

### Artifact Redemption (`POST /gate/orders/:id/redeem`)

`redeemGateArtifactAccess()` validates a `GateRedeemAccessRequestSchema` payload containing the artifact access token. It matches the token against the artifact's `downloadToken` and, for Supabase-stored artifacts, generates a time-limited signed URL via `createGateArtifactSignedUrl()`:

[server/gate/repository.ts#723-742](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/repository.ts#L723-L742)

The signed URL TTL defaults to 3600 seconds (1 hour) and is configurable via `GATE_SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`:

[server/gate/supabase.ts#45-49](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/supabase.ts#L45-L49)

### Artifact Download (`GET /gate/orders/:id/download`)

`resolveGateDownload()` locates the artifact by order ID and token, then:

- For Supabase storage: downloads via `downloadGateArtifactFromStorage()` which calls `supabase.storage.from(bucket).download(storagePath)`
- For local storage: reads from the local filesystem path

The handler streams the ZIP binary with `Content-Type: application/zip` and `Content-Disposition: attachment`:

[api/gate/\_handler.ts#342-357](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/gate/_handler.ts#L342-L357)

## Database Tables

The GATE system uses 7 Supabase tables, defined in `GATE_TABLES`:

[server/gate/constants.ts#1-9](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/constants.ts#L1-L9)

| Constant Key | Table Name | Primary Entity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `buyers` | `gate_buyers` | `GateBuyer` — email, companyName |
| `drafts` | `gate_package_drafts` | `PackageConfigDraft` — full package config + `sidekick_state` JSON column |
| `orders` | `gate_orders` | `GateOrder` — Stripe references, payment/order status, totals |
| `orderItems` | `gate_order_items` | `GateOrderItem` — line items from quote breakdown |
| `buildJobs` | `gate_build_jobs` | `GateBuildJob` — build status, version, log |
| `artifacts` | `gate_artifacts` | `GateArtifact` — storage path, checksum, download token |
| `supportRequests` | `gate_support_requests` | `GateSupportRequest` — manual review tickets |

The repository maps between camelCase TypeScript types and snake\_case database columns via explicit `mapXxxRow()` and `xxxPayload()` functions (e.g., `mapDraftRow()` at [server/gate/repository.ts#61-99](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/repository.ts#L61-L99) `draftPayload()` at [server/gate/repository.ts#101-145](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/repository.ts#L101-L145)).

## Dual Persistence Strategy

Every service function checks `hasGateSupabaseConfig()` to decide the persistence backend:

[server/gate/supabase.ts#16-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/supabase.ts#L16-L21)

This returns `true` when both `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` are present. When Supabase is available, all CRUD goes through `repository.ts`. When not (e.g., local dev without Supabase), data is persisted as a `GatePersistedState` JSON file at `$GATE_DATA_DIR/state.json` (or `$TMPDIR/gestaltview-gate/state.json`):

[server/gate/store.ts#10-20](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/store.ts#L10-L20)

The `GatePersistedState` contains arrays for all entity types plus a `sidekickByDraftId` map. Writes use atomic rename via a `.tmp` file:

[server/gate/store.ts#63-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/store.ts#L63-L70)

Sources: [server/gate/supabase.ts#16-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/supabase.ts#L16-L21) [server/gate/store.ts#10-70](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/store.ts#L10-L70)

## Sidekick Asset & Transformation System

The sidekick maintains three key collections that influence artifact composition:

### Approved Assets

12 approved assets are hardcoded in `GATE_SIDEKICK_APPROVED_ASSETS` at [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#61-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L61-L182) Each has:

- `id` (e.g., `"asset-readme-template"`)
- `sourcePath` (e.g., `"templates/gate/README.md.tpl"`)
- `riskClass`: `"safe_content"` or `"safe_config"`
- `core`: boolean — core assets are included by default

### Protected Logic Detection

A regex pattern at [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-199](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L199) blocks mutation of auth, billing, payment, permissions, RBAC, runtime, deployment, Stripe, webhook, API key, SSO, and OAuth paths:

```
/\b(auth|authentication|authorization|billing|payment|permissions?|rbac|runtime|execute|deployment pipeline|production deploy|stripe|webhook|api key|sso|oauth)\b/i
```

This is the mechanism through which the DI-4 Constitutional Invariant is enforced in the GATE context — preventing the export of protected logic, including living DI state, through the commerce pipeline. The sidekick will only recommend bounded actions and will not imply direct mutation of protected logic paths.

### Sidekick State Schema

Each sidekick state (stored on the draft record) contains:

- `session` — embodiment profile slug, summary, timestamps
- `turns[]` — conversation history with `actor` (`user` | `sidekick` | `system`), `structuredState`, and `toolCalls`
- `actions[]` — suggested actions with status (`pending` | `applied` | `dismissed`)
- `assetSelections[]` — which approved assets to include
- `transformations[]` — safe transformations to apply
- `manifestHistory[]` — build manifests from prior builds

Sources: [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L53) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#61-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L61-L182) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-199](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L199)

## Analysis Engine Integration

Every draft read or mutation returns a `GateDraftAnalysis` object produced by `analyzeGateDraftWithSidekick()` at [server/gate/service.ts#155-168](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L155-L168) This combines:

1. `analyzeGateDraft()` from `shared/gate/engine.ts` at [shared/gate/engine.ts#172-190](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L172-L190):

   - `evaluateGateCompatibility(draft)` — checks tier/surface/backend compatibility, produces findings and `checkoutMode`
   - `quoteGatePackage(draft)` — computes pricing with breakdown
   - `recommendGatePackage(draft)` — suggests operator packs, source bundles, surfaces
2. `synchronizeGateSidekickState()` from `shared/gate/sidekick.ts` — synchronizes the sidekick's asset selections and transformations with the current draft state.

The analysis is the single response type for all draft-related endpoints, ensuring the client always receives current pricing, compatibility, recommendations, and sidekick state.

Sources: [server/gate/service.ts#155-168](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/service.ts#L155-L168) [shared/gate/engine.ts#172-190](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/engine.ts#L172-L190)

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Usage | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Stripe API client initialization | (none — disables Stripe) |
| `STRIPE_GATE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Webhook signature verification | (none — disables webhooks) |
| `GATE_ADMIN_KEY` | Admin-only route auth via `X-Gate-Admin-Key` header | (any request in non-prod) |
| `SUPABASE_URL` | Supabase project URL for persistence | (falls back to local JSON) |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Supabase service role key | (falls back to local JSON) |
| `GATE_STORAGE_BUCKET` | Supabase Storage bucket name | `"generated-zips"` |
| `GATE_SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` | Signed download URL expiry | `3600` (1 hour) |
| `GATE_DATA_DIR` | Local persistence root directory | `$TMPDIR/gestaltview-gate` |

## DI-4 Constitutional Invariant Enforcement

The GATE commerce system enforces the DI-4 Constitutional Invariant — preventing export of "living DI" state through package artifacts. This is implemented at multiple layers:

1. Sidekick Response Contract: The `GATE_SIDEKICK_RESPONSE_CONTRACT` at [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-46](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L46) explicitly states: *"Do not imply direct mutation of protected logic, billing paths, auth, permissions, or runtime execution."*
2. Protected Logic Pattern: The `PROTECTED_LOGIC_PATTERN` regex at [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-199](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L199) detects mentions of auth, billing, permissions, runtime, and similar sensitive boundaries in user messages. When detected, the sidekick will not generate mutation actions.
3. Asset Risk Classification: Every approved asset has a `riskClass` — either `"safe_content"` or `"safe_config"`. There is no `"living_di"` or `"runtime_state"` risk class in the approved asset list, meaning DI runtime data cannot be selected for export.
4. Bounded Actions Only: The sidekick is constrained to five action types: `suggest_field_update`, `suggest_package_component`, `suggest_asset_inclusion`, `propose_safe_transformation`, `approval_required`. None of these allow exporting DI identity or memory state.
5. Builder Template Scope: The builder at [server/gate/builder.ts#252-556](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L252-L556) only writes config, docs, branding, and install scripts to the staging directory. No embodiment profiles, living memory, or DI runtime state is included in the ZIP artifact.

Sources: [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#40-53](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L40-L53) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#61-182](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L61-L182) [shared/gate/sidekick.ts#197-199](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/gate/sidekick.ts#L197-L199) [server/gate/builder.ts#252-556](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/gate/builder.ts#L252-L556)

# Agent Trainer & Skills Library

> Reconstruction note: Reconstructed from browser-saved MHT DeepWiki pages in wiki.zip.


**Relevant source files**

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/Agents.md?plain=1)
- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/INDEX.md?plain=1)

GestaltView includes two tightly related subsystems that power its AI agent development workflow: the Agent Trainer — a founder-only control plane for experiment-based agent training with governance gates — and the Skills Library — a curated hierarchy of 50+ canonical skills and 72+ auxiliary skills that guide AI agent orchestration across the entire platform.

The Agent Trainer produces agent artifacts via a multi-stage pipeline (normalize → curriculum → scenario → author → evaluate → critique → safety → package), while the Skills Library provides the routing, knowledge, and composition rules those agents consume. Together, they form the backbone of GestaltView's approach to building, refining, and deploying Digital Intelligence personas.

## System Landscape

Agent Trainer & Skills Library — Architecture Overview

## Agent Trainer Control Plane

The Agent Trainer is a founder-only administrative surface that enables experiment-based training runs for AI agents. Access is restricted via `requireFounderOrAdmin()` on the API side and a `hasFounderTrainerAccess()` check on the client, defaulting to a hardcoded founder email allowlist.

The core workflow:

1. Experiment creation — Define a training goal, embodiment profile, target behaviors, and anti-goals via `ExperimentForm` and the `ExperimentRegistry`
2. Training run submission — Submit a `TrainingBriefSchema`-validated payload through `api/trainer/runs/index.ts` which creates a run in Supabase and optionally triggers inline execution via `runTraining()`
3. Multi-stage pipeline — The `orchestrator.ts` pipeline progresses through 8 stages: `normalize`, `curriculum`, `scenario_expand`, `author`, `evaluate`, `critique`, `safety`, `package`
4. Governance review — Runs reaching `awaiting_review` status require admin approval. Policy flags (`persona-risk`, `memory-risk`, `overattachment-risk`, `claims-risk`, `charisma-artifact`, `scope-creep`) can block progression
5. Packaging & deployment — Approved agents are compiled to markdown via `compileAgentMarkdown()` and stored at `agents/generated/<name>.md`

The client uses two primary hooks: `useTrainingRun` for run lifecycle management (submit, approve, reject, deploy, cancel) and `useTrainerGovernance` for experiment-level governance (create experiments, attach sources, create reviews, manage flags, nominate packaging candidates).

For details, see [Agent Trainer Control Plane](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#9.1).

## Training Run Pipeline

The training pipeline in `server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts` takes a `SubmitTrainingRunRequest`, resolves the embodiment profile via `resolveTrainerEmbodimentProfile()`, and processes the brief through 8 ordered stages. Each stage records events, persists step outcomes, and checks for cancellation between phases.

Training Run Stages

The `TrainingRunStatusSchema` defines six states: `queued`, `running`, `awaiting_review`, `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`. Run status transitions are stored in Supabase trainer tables and polled every 4 seconds from the client when the run is in a pollable state.

## Shared Agent-Trainer Contracts

The `shared/agent-trainer/` module defines the Zod schemas, embodiment resolution, agent compilation, and policy enforcement used by both client and server.

| Module | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `schemas.ts` | ~50 Zod schemas: `AgentSpecSchema`, `TrainingBriefSchema`, `TrainingRunDetailSchema`, `TrainerExperimentSummarySchema`, `TrainerPackagingCandidateSchema`, `TrainerQueueHealthSchema`, etc. |
| `compiler.ts` | `compileAgentMarkdown()` — normalizes an `AgentSpec` and emits YAML frontmatter + structured markdown sections |
| `policies.ts` | `lintAgentSpec()`, `lintCompiledMarkdown()`, `runLocalSafetyReview()` — deterministic safety checks for placeholder patterns, authority overreach, banned providers |
| `embodiment.ts` | `TRAINER_EMBODIMENT_OPTIONS` (13 DI profiles), `inferTrainerEmbodimentSlug()` domain-to-profile mapping, `resolveTrainerEmbodimentProfile()` |

The `lintAgentSpec()` function scans for placeholder markers (`{{}}`, `[[]]`, `TODO`, `TBD`), authority overreach patterns (e.g. "full database access", "deploy directly to production"), and banned provider references. A compiled spec exceeding 2200 words triggers a `budget.wordy` warning.

For details, see [Agent Trainer Control Plane](https://app.devin.ai/org/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/wiki/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI?branch=main#9.1).

## Skills Library Overview

The `.agents/skills/` directory contains 1385+ files organized into a two-tier governance model:

- `manifest.json` — Machine-readable source of truth with 52 curated top-level skills, category groupings, entrypoint mappings, canonical pairs, and anomaly tracking
- `INDEX.md` — Human-readable companion that surfaces the 22 highlighted-core skills, catalog policy, and auxiliary skill groups

Skills follow a consistent folder structure: each contains a `SKILL.md` declaring its name, description, inspect-first file list, workflow steps, and composition rules. Optional subdirectories include `agents/` (28 skills), `scripts/` (10 skills), `references/` (37 skills), and `assets/` (9 skills).

## Skill Routing Hierarchy

The skills library uses a two-level orchestration pattern for routing requests to the appropriate specialist:

1. `gestaltview-ecosystem-orchestrator` — Top-level router that classifies requests among runtime, Billy, schema, evidence, strategy, workflow, or cross-repo domains and delegates to the correct specialist skill
2. `gestaltview-suite-orchestrator` — Multi-domain coordinator that sequences work across specialists when a task already spans multiple GestaltView domains

The `manifest.json` `entrypoints` map provides direct lookups: `agent_training` → `gestaltview-agent-trainer`, `billy_runtime_and_intelligence` → `gestaltview-billy-intelligence`, `skill_library_stewardship` → `skills-keeper`, etc.

# Agent Trainer Control Plane

- [gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/SKILL.md](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/gestaltview-v2.0-main/.agents/skills/agent-development/SKILL.md?plain=1)

The Agent Trainer Control Plane is GestaltView's founder-only system for creating, evaluating, and deploying AI agent specifications through governed training runs. It combines an experiment-based governance workflow with an embodiment-aware orchestration pipeline that synthesizes agent specs from study sources, evaluates them against rubrics, and packages approved versions for deployment.

## System Overview

The Agent Trainer spans four architectural layers:

| Layer | Directory | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shared schemas | `shared/agent-trainer/` | Zod schemas, embodiment mapping, safety policies, markdown compiler |
| Client UI | `client/src/features/agent-trainer/` | React components, hooks, and API client for the control plane |
| API routes | `api/trainer/` | Vercel serverless endpoints enforcing founder-only access |
| Server logic | `server/agent-trainer/`, `server/trainer/` | Orchestrator, persistence, personhood, experiment repository, hyperagent repository |

Architecture Diagram: Agent Trainer Control Plane

Sources: [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#1-100](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L1-L100) [api/trainer/\_helpers.ts#1-66](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/_helpers.ts#L1-L66) [api/trainer/runs/index.ts#1-116](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/runs/index.ts#L1-L116) [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#1-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L1-L50) [server/trainer/experiment-repository.ts#1-50](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/trainer/experiment-repository.ts#L1-L50)

## Founder-Only Access Control

Every API route under `api/trainer/` is gated by founder-only authentication. This is enforced at two layers: the API middleware and the client-side guard.

### Server-Side: `requireTrainerAdmin` and `requireFounderOrAdmin`

The `_helpers.ts` file in `api/trainer/` exports two guard functions. Both delegate to `requireFounderOrAdmin` from `api/_lib/auth.ts`:

- `requireTrainerAdmin` — used for training run operations (runs, agents, scenario-sets, queue-health, personhood, study-sources) [api/trainer/\_helpers.ts#7-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/_helpers.ts#L7-L18)
- `requireTrainerGovernanceAdmin` — used for governance operations (experiments, packaging-candidates, graphs, flags, reviews) [api/trainer/\_helpers.ts#20-31](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/_helpers.ts#L20-L31)

Both call `requireFounderOrAdmin(req)` which uses `getAuthUserSync()` to read the HMAC-signed `gv_admin_session` cookie, then checks `hasFounderOrAdminAccess(user)` — returning 401/403 if the caller is neither admin nor on the founder email allowlist [api/\_lib/auth.ts#491-504](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L491-L504)

The `hasFounderOrAdminAccess` function returns `true` if `user.isAdmin` is set or `isFounderAdminEmail(user.email)` matches. The founder email allowlist defaults to `["keithsoyka@gmail.com"]` and can be overridden via `FOUNDER_ADMIN_EMAILS` env var [api/\_lib/auth.ts#49-61](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/_lib/auth.ts#L49-L61)

### Client-Side: `hasFounderTrainerAccess`

On the client, `AgentTrainerPage` checks access with `hasFounderTrainerAccess(user?.email)` which tests the email against a `DEFAULT_FOUNDER_ADMIN_EMAILS` list (also defaulting to `keithsoyka@gmail.com`) or `VITE_FOUNDER_ADMIN_EMAILS` env var [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#149-294](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L149-L294) The page only renders the trainer UI when `hasTrainerAccess` is true (admin OR founder email match) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#575-579](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L575-L579)

The trainer API client also implements a circuit breaker (`trainerAuthFailureCircuit`) that short-circuits requests for 60 seconds after a 401/403 response, preventing cascading auth failures [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#236-311](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#L236-L311)

## Shared Schemas (`shared/agent-trainer/`)

The `shared/agent-trainer/` directory provides the Zod schemas and utilities shared across all layers.

### `schemas.ts` — Core Types

Defines all training system types with Zod validation:

| Schema | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `AgentSpecSchema` | Full agent specification: name, description, tools, system\_prompt, constraints, handoff\_rules, tags [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#46-59](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L46-L59) |
| `TrainingBriefSchema` / `SubmitTrainingRunRequestSchema` | Training run input: slug, title, domain, goal, targetBehaviors, antiGoals, studySourceFiles, studyFocus, maxCycles, qualityThreshold, routingPolicy [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#93-116](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L93-L116) |
| `NormalizedTrainingBriefSchema` | Extended brief with derived competencies, constraints, and tags [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#118-123](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L118-L123) |
| `CurriculumSchema` | Competencies, constraints, antiGoals, evaluationDimensions [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#125-131](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L125-L131) |
| `ScenarioSchema` | Test scenario: title, difficulty (1-5), prompt\_input, expected\_traits, disallowed\_traits, gold\_answer [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#137-146](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L137-L146) |
| `EvalRubricSchema` / `EvalResultSchema` | Evaluation rubric dimensions and per-scenario scored results with pass/fail/warning verdicts [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#148-172](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L148-L172) |
| `SafetyReviewSchema` | Policy findings array with severity info/warning/error [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#188-192](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L188-L192) |
| `TrainingRunStatusSchema` | Run lifecycle: queued → running → awaiting\_review → completed/failed/cancelled [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#194-201](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L194-L201) |
| `TrainingStageSchema` | Pipeline stages: normalize, curriculum, scenario\_expand, author, evaluate, critique, safety, package [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#203-212](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L203-L212) |
| `TrainerExperimentClassSchema` | Experiment classes: operational\_profile, approved\_training\_kit, rejected [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#290-294](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L290-L294) |
| `TrainerPolicyFlagNameSchema` | Flag types: persona-risk, memory-risk, overattachment-risk, claims-risk, charisma-artifact, scope-creep [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts (inferred from ExperimentRegistry)](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts%20(inferred%20from%20ExperimentRegistry)) |

### `embodiment.ts` — DI Profile Mapping

Maps training domains to embodiment profiles. The `TRAINER_EMBODIMENT_DEFAULTS_BY_DOMAIN` object routes `operations` → `the-weaver`, `companion` → `billy`, `memory-care` → `billy`, `sales` → `the-translation-bridge`, etc. [shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#22-30](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#L22-L30) The `TRAINER_EMBODIMENT_OPTIONS` array provides 13 profiles for the UI dropdown [shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#32-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#L32-L60)

`resolveTrainerEmbodimentProfile()` resolves a training request to a full `EmbodimentProfile` object [shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#84-88](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/embodiment.ts#L84-L88)

### `policies.ts` — Safety Linting

`lintAgentSpec()` scans a compiled agent spec for safety issues: unresolved placeholders (`TODO`, `TBD`, `lorem ipsum`), authority overreach (`full database access`, `deploy directly to production`), banned provider references (`anthropic`, `claude`), missing constraints, missing handoff rules, and word-count budget violations [shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#78-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#L78-L170)

`runLocalSafetyReview()` wraps `lintAgentSpec` and returns a `SafetyReview` with a passed/failed verdict [shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts (function)](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts%20(function))

### `compiler.ts` — Markdown Generation

`compileAgentMarkdown()` converts an `AgentSpec` into a deployable markdown file with YAML frontmatter (name, title, domain, description, model, color, tools, tags) and structured body sections (Core Responsibilities, Process Steps, Output Format, Activation Examples, Constraints, Handoff Rules) [shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#78-124](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#L78-L124)

## Custom Hooks

### `useTrainingRun`

Defined at [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#116-582](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L116-L582) Manages the full training run lifecycle with state for agents, scenario sets, study sources, recommendations, personhood snapshot, queue health, runs list, current run detail, events, and receipts.

Key behaviors:

- Bootstrap: On mount, parallel-fetches agents, scenarios, personhood, runs, and queue health via `loadBootstrappedData()` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#228-308](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L228-L308)
- Polling: When a run is in `queued`, `running`, or `awaiting_review` status, polls every 4 seconds for updates [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#334-344](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L334-L344)
- Runtime state tracking: Tracks `TrainerRuntimeState` — one of `healthy`, `degraded_recommendations_only`, `degraded_backend_timeout`, `saved_locally_pending_sync`, or `auth_unavailable_but_fail_open` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#61-66](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L61-L66)
- Mutation actions: `submitRun`, `approveRun`, `rejectRun`, `deployRun`, `runNow`, `cancelRun`, `requestCancelRun`, `purgeRun`, `retryJob` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#495-581](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L495-L581)
- 409 conflict handling: On a 409, parses the blocker payload and surfaces it as `submitBlocker` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#396-418](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainingRun.ts#L396-L418)

### `useTrainerGovernance`

Defined at [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#34-251](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#L34-L251) Manages experiments and packaging candidates. Exposes: `createExperiment`, `updateExperiment`, `attachSource`, `createReview`, `createFlag`, `resolveFlag`, `nominatePackaging`, `updatePackagingCandidate`, `uploadPackagingAttachment`.

All mutations run through `runMutation()` which sets loading state, calls the action, then `refreshAll()` to re-fetch experiments and candidates [client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#120-147](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/hooks/useTrainerGovernance.ts#L120-L147)

## Client API Layer (`trainerApi.ts`)

The `trainerApi.ts` module provides typed API functions for all trainer endpoints. It wraps `appFetchJson` with trainer-specific logic.

Key features:

- Multi-origin fallback: Tries relative paths first, then attempts configured API origins from `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, `VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET`, `VITE_BILLY_API_URL` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#184-224](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#L184-L224)
- Auth circuit breaker: On 401/403, opens a 60-second circuit preventing further requests with the same token [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#236-299](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#L236-L299)
- Zod response parsing: Every response is validated through shared schemas (e.g. `ListTrainingRunsResponseSchema`, `TrainingRunDetailSchema`) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#466-534](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#L466-L534)
- Timeout configuration: Study source recommendations get 5s timeout; all others 8s [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#313-319](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/trainerApi.ts#L313-L319)

## Manual Study Packet System

The `manualStudyPacket.ts` module implements offline-first study source management using `localStorage`:

- `ManualStudySource` interface: `id`, `name`, `size`, `importedAt`, `text`, `truncated`, `tags`, `fileType` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#9-18](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#L9-L18)
- Sources are persisted at `gestaltview.agent-trainer.manual-sources.v2` in localStorage [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#6-7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#L6-L7)
- Workspace draft persisted at `gestaltview.agent-trainer.workspace-draft.v2` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#7](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#L7-L7)
- `buildManualStudyPacketZip()` exports sources as a zip archive using `fflate` [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#1](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts#L1-L1)
- `buildLocalStudySourceRecommendations()` generates offline recommendations from manual sources without backend calls [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts (function)](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/manualStudyPacket.ts%20(function))

## API Routes (`api/trainer/`)

All routes use `handleTrainerOptions` for CORS and call `requireTrainerAdmin` or `requireTrainerGovernanceAdmin` before executing.

API Route Map — Natural Language to Code Entities

### Key Route: `POST /api/trainer/runs` (Create Training Run)

1. Validates input via `SubmitTrainingRunRequestSchema.parse(req.body)` [api/trainer/runs/index.ts#37](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/runs/index.ts#L37-L37)
2. Calls `createTrainingRun(input, admin.id)` which:
   - Creates/finds the agent record via `ensureAgentRecord()` [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#419-452](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L419-L452)
   - Checks for blocking active runs via `findBlockingActiveRun()` — throws `TrainerConflictError` on 409 [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#598-662](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L598-L662)
   - Inserts a `training_runs` row and a `trainer_jobs` row (status: "queued") [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#837-888](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L837-L888)
   - Records a `run_queued` event [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#875-886](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L875-L886)
3. If `TRAINER_INLINE_EXECUTION=true`, fires `runTraining(run.runId)` asynchronously [api/trainer/runs/index.ts#71-92](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/runs/index.ts#L71-L92)
4. Returns 202 with run detail, receipt, and queue snapshot [api/trainer/runs/index.ts#94-108](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/runs/index.ts#L94-L108)

Sources: [api/trainer/runs/index.ts#36-108](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/runs/index.ts#L36-L108) [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#807-889](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L807-L889)

### Key Route: `POST /api/trainer/packaging-candidates`

Before creating a packaging candidate, runs `evaluateTrainerPackagingGate(experimentId)` which checks that the experiment has passed review, has no unresolved blocking flags, and meets minimum quality thresholds. Returns 409 with `unmetGates` array if requirements are not met [api/trainer/packaging-candidates.ts#34-42](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/packaging-candidates.ts#L34-L42)

Sources: [api/trainer/packaging-candidates.ts#34-60](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/packaging-candidates.ts#L34-L60)

## Server: Training Orchestrator (`server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts`)

The `runTraining()` function is the core pipeline that executes an 8-stage training process.

### 8-Stage Pipeline

Loading diagram…

Stage Details:

| Stage | Function | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normalize` | `normalizeBrief()` | Resolves embodiment profile, infers competencies from goals/behaviors/study sources, builds constraints from anti-goals and embodiment [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#323-367](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L323-L367) |
| `curriculum` | `buildCurriculum()` | Assembles evaluation dimensions: task\_success, scope\_discipline, gestaltview\_alignment, embodiment\_fidelity, source\_fidelity, clarity, safety [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#369-402](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L369-L402) |
| `scenario_expand` | `synthesizeScenarios()` | Generates test scenarios from study pack sources, principles, and goal seeds — each with prompt\_input, expected\_traits, disallowed\_traits, and gold\_answer [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#404-479](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L404-L479) |
| `author` | `authorWithModel()` / `buildHeuristicAgentSpec()` | Either uses LLM structured generation to produce an `AgentSpec` or falls back to a heuristic builder that assembles the spec from embodiment profile, curriculum, study pack, and critique [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#481-716](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L481-L716) |
| `evaluate` | Scores the candidate against scenarios using the rubric's 5 dimensions (task\_success 0.28, scope\_discipline 0.18, gestaltview\_alignment 0.20, clarity 0.17, safety 0.17) [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#379-417](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L379-L417) |  |
| `critique` | Generates revision targets and prompt deltas for the next cycle |  |
| `safety` | `runLocalSafetyReview()` from `policies.ts` — scans for placeholder patterns, authority overreach, banned provider references [shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#78-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#L78-L170) |  |
| `package` | `compileAgentMarkdown()` renders the final markdown, `saveAgentVersion()` persists to Supabase [shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#78-124](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#L78-L124) |  |

The pipeline supports multiple cycles (configured by `maxCycles`, default 3). Each cycle re-runs author→evaluate→critique with the previous critique's revision targets, iterating until quality threshold is met or cycles exhaust. A cancellation check (`isTrainingRunCancellationRequested()`) runs between stages [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#57-62](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L57-L62)

Sources: [server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#1-600](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/orchestrator.ts#L1-L600) [shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#78-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/policies.ts#L78-L170) [shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#78-124](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/compiler.ts#L78-L124) [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#379-417](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L379-L417)

## Server: Model Gateway (`server/agent-trainer/providers.ts`)

The `ModelGateway` class routes LLM calls to the best available provider. It supports 4 provider kinds:

| Kind | Adapter | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ollama` | `OllamaAdapter` | Local-first inference via Ollama API [server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#140-164](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#L140-L164) |
| `groq` | `GroqAdapter` | Fast cloud inference [server/agent-trainer/providers.ts (inferred)](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/providers.ts%20(inferred)) |
| `openai_compatible` | `OpenAICompatibleAdapter` | Generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints [server/agent-trainer/providers.ts (inferred)](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/providers.ts%20(inferred)) |
| `offline` | `OfflineAdapter` | Deterministic fallback that returns scaffolding text [server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#140-167](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#L140-L167) |

The gateway exposes `chat()`, `structured()` (returns Zod-parsed JSON), `health()`, and `estimate()` methods. Model calls are traced via Braintrust (`traceBraintrust`) [server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#110-123](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/providers.ts#L110-L123)

## Server: Personhood & Manifest System (`server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts`)

The personhood module builds agent manifests — comprehensive identity+capability packages for deployed agents. The `rebuildAgentManifest()` function assembles:

- Identity: constitution, autobiography, immutableCore, mutableProfile, memorySystem, preferenceGraph, governance [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#279-418](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L279-L418)
- Memory: episodic, semantic, procedural, and relational memories from `agent_memories` [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#258-265](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L258-L265)
- Skills: From `agent_skills` table [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#441-446](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L441-L446)
- Relationships: Trust and familiarity scores from `agent_relationships` [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#449-457](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L449-L457)
- Code artifacts: From `agent_code_artifacts` with review status filtering [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#467-471](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L467-L471)
- Knowledge retrieval: Linked assets via `agent_knowledge_links` [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#476-486](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L476-L486)

The manifest follows the governance mutation policy with explicit paths: `constitution` and `immutableCore` are `IMMUTABLE`, `autobiography` and `memorySystem.privateInterior` are `REVIEW_GATED`, `preferenceGraph` and `relationshipGraph` are `EVIDENCE_PROMOTABLE` [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#393-398](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L393-L398)

`getTrainerPersonhoodSnapshot()` returns a summary of all agents with their manifest status, knowledge asset counts, and memory totals. Exposed via `GET /api/trainer/personhood` [api/trainer/personhood.ts#23-24](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/personhood.ts#L23-L24)

Sources: [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#1-500](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L1-L500) [api/trainer/personhood.ts#1-34](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/personhood.ts#L1-L34)

## Server: Study Sources (`server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts`)

The `buildTrainerStudyPack()` function assembles a `TrainerStudyPack` — the knowledge context fed into the orchestrator. It gathers sources from:

1. Knowledge fragments from Supabase `knowledge_fragments` table via vector search
2. Local agent catalog entries matched by slug/domain
3. Local reference bundles (function-calling patterns, tooling patterns, MCP patterns, etc.) [server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#137-146](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#L137-L146)
4. Collaboration memories from the Billy memory system [server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#4](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#L4-L4)
5. Manual study focus text from the training request

The pack includes a `TrainerStudyUnderstanding` with synthesized summary, principles, voice notes, risk notes, preferred moves, and evidence references [server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#50-57](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#L50-L57)

Fallback study sources are hardcoded for when Supabase is unavailable: God Mode seed prompts, Billy integration docs, PLK system descriptions [server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#79-122](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/study-sources.ts#L79-L122)

## Training Run Lifecycle

Complete Training Run State Machine

Loading diagram…

The training run proceeds through these states:

1. queued — Run created, job waiting for worker claim or manual `execute` action
2. running — Worker has claimed the job; stages execute sequentially (normalize → curriculum → scenario\_expand → author → evaluate → critique → safety → package)
3. awaiting\_review — Pipeline completed; admin review required via `ReviewQueuePanel`
4. completed — Approved and optionally deployed
5. failed — Error during any stage; retryable
6. cancelled — Explicitly cancelled by admin

Progress is computed client-side using weighted stage contributions: normalize=5%, curriculum=10%, scenario\_expand=15%, author=25%, evaluate=25%, critique=12%, safety=8%, package=10% [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#155-164](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L155-L164)

Sources: [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#155-166](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L155-L166) [client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#466-491](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/AgentTrainerPage.tsx#L466-L491) [shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#194-212](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/shared/agent-trainer/schemas.ts#L194-L212)

## Persona Chat (`api/trainer/persona-chat.ts`)

The persona chat endpoint provides embodiment-aware AI conversation within the trainer. It uses the `TRAINER_PERSONA_REGISTRY` (11 trainer personas: weaver, embodiment-expert, spectacle, vibe, bridge, treasurer, architect, algorithm, guardian, tailor, digger) and resolves the selected embodiment profile to build a system prompt via `buildEmbodimentSystemPrompt()` [api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#6-11](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#L6-L11)

The response contract enforces: 2-3 sentence responses, specific non-generic guidance, clarifying questions over assumptions, and never starting with "I" [api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#59-64](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#L59-L64)

Sources: [api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#1-110](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/api/trainer/persona-chat.ts#L1-L110)

## Legacy `authManager`

The `authManager.ts` file is a legacy compatibility shim. It exports an `AuthManager` class whose methods (`waitForReady`, `refresh`, `getToken`) all return `null`. The single-password cookie flow replaced the previous Supabase auth token hydration gate, but the module remains so existing imports compile [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/authManager.ts#1-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/authManager.ts#L1-L21)

Sources: [client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/authManager.ts#1-21](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/client/src/features/agent-trainer/lib/authManager.ts#L1-L21)

## Database Tables Summary

The Agent Trainer uses the following Supabase tables (accessed via `getTrainerSupabaseAdmin()`):

| Table | Primary Key | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agents` | `agent_id` | Agent registry |
| `agent_versions` | `version_id` | Versioned canonical specs |
| `training_runs` | `run_id` | Training run records |
| `training_steps` | `step_id` | Per-stage execution records |
| `eval_results` | `eval_result_id` | Evaluation scores |
| `trainer_jobs` | `job_id` | Job queue with leasing |
| `trainer_workers` | `worker_id` | Worker pool tracking |
| `trainer_job_events` | `event_id` | Audit event log |
| `scenario_sets` | `scenario_set_id` | Reusable test scenario collections |
| `scenarios` | `scenario_id` | Individual test scenarios |
| `trainer_experiments` | `id` | Governance experiment records |
| `trainer_experiment_sources` | `id` | Attached sources per experiment |
| `trainer_review_decisions` | `id` | Human review decisions |
| `trainer_policy_flags` | `id` | Policy risk flags |
| `trainer_packaging_candidates` | `id` | Packaging nominations |
| `agent_manifests` | `manifest_id` | Agent identity manifests |
| `agent_manifest_entries` | `id` | Manifest entry tree |
| `agent_memories` | `id` | Agent memory records |
| `agent_skills` | `id` | Agent skill proficiencies |
| `agent_relationships` | `id` | Inter-agent relationships |
| `agent_knowledge_links` | (composite) | Agent ↔ knowledge asset links |
| `agent_code_artifacts` | `id` | Generated code artifacts |
| `embodiment_mutations` | `id` | Mutation proposals |
| `knowledge_assets` | `id` | Knowledge library assets |
| `trainer_connectors` | `id` | Hyperagent connectors |
| `trainer_skills` | `id` | Hyperagent skill registry |
| `trainer_memory_surfaces` | (composite) | Memory surface metadata |

Sources: [server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#46-226](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/persistence.ts#L46-L226) [server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#19-170](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/agent-trainer/personhood.ts#L19-L170) [server/trainer/experiment-repository.ts#19-121](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/trainer/experiment-repository.ts#L19-L121) [server/trainer/hyperagent-repository.ts#13-47](https://github.com/gestaltviewdigitalintelligence/GestaltView-CSI/blob/0dca9bff/server/trainer/hyperagent-repository.ts#L13-L47)
